jobs.title: Industry Customer Trainer
jobs.description:
The Industrial Automation Trainer serves as a technical instructor and subject matter expert responsible for developing and delivering high-quality technical training to customers. This role focuses on building customer knowledge and technical capability to safely operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize industrial automation systems. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in at least one core industrial automation discipline, such as Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), or Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems. The successful candidate will also demonstrate the curiosity, aptitude, and commitment to expand their expertise across a broader portfolio of industrial automation technologies. This position is well suited for a technically skilled professional who is passionate about continuous learning, enjoys teaching others, and can translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical instruction for customers with varying levels of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, prepare, and deliver technical training programs focused on industrial automation products, systems, and applications. Serve as a subject matter expert in one or more automation disciplines, including VFDs, PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA systems. Provide clear, engaging, and hands-on instruction that strengthens customers’ ability to safely operate, maintain, and troubleshoot automation equipment and systems. Translate complex technical concepts into practical, easy-to-understand learning experiences for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise. Continuously expand technical knowledge across the broader industrial automation portfolio to support evolving customer and training needs. Maintain and enhance training materials to ensure technical content is accurate, relevant, and effective. Support a positive learning environment that encourages customer engagement, knowledge retention, and practical application of technical skills. Qualifications Strong technical expertise in at least one industrial automation discipline, such as VFDs, PLCs, HMIs, or SCADA systems. Demonstrated ability and interest in developing expertise across additional industrial automation technologies. Strong communication, presentation, and technical instruction skills. Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to individuals with different levels of experience. Passion for teaching, continuous learning, and customer development. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities within an industrial automation environment. If you're passionate about empowering others through great training, we'd love to meet you! jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Technical Writer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Technical Writer will develop and maintain clear, accurate, and accessible documentation that enables VA customers and technical teams to effectively use and support the Summit Data Platform.

This position will work closely with engineers, product teams, and customer enablement specialists to translate complex technical information into practical user guidance, operational procedures, and training materials. Documentation will reflect actual Summit configurations, approved processes, and available capabilities.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop, edit, and maintain technical documentation, including user guides, administrator guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), quick reference guides, and troubleshooting materials.

  • Create customer-facing documentation that explains Summit platform capabilities, available services, access procedures, and common user workflows.

  • Collaborate with data engineers, cloud architects, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) specialists, and other subject matter experts to document technical configurations, processes, and system functionality.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding materials, tutorials, frequently asked questions, and knowledge base articles that support customer adoption and self-service.

  • Document data ingestion processes, data access procedures, governance requirements, and platform operations in coordination with responsible technical teams.

  • Support development of training presentations, exercises, demonstrations, and other instructional materials for Summit customers and support personnel.

  • Review and update documentation following platform releases, configuration changes, process improvements, and changes to approved services.

  • Establish and maintain documentation templates, style standards, version controls, and review processes to promote consistency and accuracy.

  • Validate technical content with subject matter experts and incorporate stakeholder feedback before publication.

  • Organize and maintaindocumentation repositories to ensure materials are current, searchable, accessible, and appropriately controlled.

  • Collaborate with customer support and enablement teams to identify recurring questions, documentation gaps, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Support preparation of technical reports, operational summaries, release notes, and other Government-required documentation.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Technical Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Four or more years of professional experience developing technical documentation for enterprise software, information technology systems, or cloud-based platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate documentation.

  • Experience developing user guides, SOPs, technical procedures, training materials, and knowledge base content.

  • Experience collaborating with engineers, developers, and technical subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and other commonly used documentation and collaboration tools.

  • Experience maintaining documentation standards, version control, and structured review and approval processes.

  • Ability to organize and manage multiple documentation assignments while meeting established deadlines.

  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, interviewing, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.

  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency information technology modernization initiatives.

  • Experience documenting Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, cloud data platforms, or enterprise analytics solutions.

  • Familiarity with data engineering, data governance, AI/ML, and cloud computing concepts.

  • Experience developing technical documentation and instructional content for users with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Experience using documentation platforms such as Confluence, Git-based repositories, or comparable knowledge management systems.

  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and experience producing accessible federal documentation.

  • Experience supporting customer onboarding, technical training, or enterprise technology adoption programs.

  • Certified Professional Technical Communicator (CPTC) or comparable technical writing certification.

Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement
To cut down on falsified applications and to avoid subjecting real candidates to screening by AI assistants, phone interviews at Trilogy require either a landline or a cellphone number backed by a physical SIM. We cannot conduct interviews with candidates who provide VOIP contact numbers (including Google Voice).

jobs.title: Cloud Native / Integration Architect
jobs.description:
Buscamos un/a Cloud Native / Integration Architect con experiencia en diseño de arquitecturas empresariales, microservicios e integración de aplicaciones, capaz de definir soluciones tecnológicas escalables, seguras y resilientes sobre plataformas cloud-native.

El profesional participará en la definición de la arquitectura objetivo para la modernización de servicios de integración, considerando la migración desde IBM App Connect hacia Red Hat OpenShift.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir la arquitectura objetivo de las soluciones tecnológicas.

  • Diseñar arquitecturas basadas en microservicios y principios cloud-native.

  • Establecer estándares técnicos y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.

  • Diseñar patrones de integración entre aplicaciones y servicios empresariales.

  • Definir estrategias de integración síncrona y asíncrona.

  • Aplicar principios de Event Driven Architecture, API First y Domain Driven Design.

  • Evaluar y validar diseños técnicos propuestos por los equipos de desarrollo.

  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los lineamientos de arquitectura empresarial.

  • Diseñar soluciones orientadas a escalabilidad, seguridad, disponibilidad y resiliencia.

  • Definir patrones para integración de servicios mediante IBM ACE, IBM MQ y Kafka.

  • Promover buenas prácticas de arquitectura sobre OpenShift, Kubernetes y Docker.

  • Definir y validar mecanismos de seguridad mediante OAuth2, JWT, TLS y certificados.

  • Participar en decisiones técnicas y actividades de gobierno tecnológico.

  • Incorporar criterios de DevSecOps, observabilidad y alta disponibilidad en los diseños.

  • Brindar orientación y mentoría técnica a los equipos de desarrollo.

Requisitos indispensables

  • Experiencia comprobable de 4años o más en las tecnologías y metodologías requeridas de arquitectura e integración.

  • Experiencia en diseño de soluciones empresariales y arquitecturas de microservicios.

  • Conocimientos sólidos de Event Driven Architecture, API First y Domain Driven Design (DDD).

  • Experiencia en arquitectura de integración de aplicaciones.

  • Conocimientos de IBM ACE / App Broker, IBM MQ y Kafka.

  • Experiencia con integraciones síncronas y asíncronas.

  • Conocimientos de OpenShift, Kubernetes y Docker.

  • Experiencia definiendo estándares y validando diseños técnicos.

  • Conocimientos de seguridad de APIs mediante OAuth2, JWT, TLS y gestión de certificados.

  • Conocimientos de observabilidad, resiliencia y alta disponibilidad.

  • Capacidad de toma de decisiones técnicas y mentoría.

Conocimientos adicionales valorados: Experiencia en proyectos de modernización de middleware, migración de servicios de integración y gobierno de arquitecturas empresariales bajo prácticas DevSecOps.

jobs.title: Vice President, IT Service Management
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

About Live Nation Entertainment

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s largest live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. With 550 million fans and operations in over 40 countries, somewhere in the world every 18 minutes a Live Nation Entertainment event takes place. We manage some of the world’s biggest artists, produce some iconic music festivals, oversee world leading venues and, through Ticketmaster, operate one of the largest ecommerce sites. For additional information, visit . Our Global IT function is a critical enabler of this operation, delivering technology infrastructure, enterprise services, and innovation across every region we operate in.

Job Purpose

The VP, IT Service Management is a senior global leadership role within Live Nation's Global IT organisation, accountable for the strategy, delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of IT service management across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses globally.

Reporting to the SVP / Global Head of IT Operations, this role owns the global service management operating model supporting approximately 25,000 employees and a diverse portfolio of corporate offices, venues, and business operations.

The role has end-to-end accountability for global Service Desks and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support, ITSM processes and platforms, end-user technology, IT asset management, workplace technology, and the employee technology lifecycle. A key priority is to modernise service delivery through AI, automation, self-service, standardisation, strong operational governance, and a relentless focus on employee experience.

Role Description

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive global IT Service Management capability improvement roadmap that aligns with Live Nation's business objectives and incorporates disaster recovery & business continuity goals.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to identify and prioritize technology initiatives that drive growth and efficiency.
  • Envision and implement AI-native practices and tools to drive effectiveness and delivery throughput
  • Implement frameworks and ways of working to ensure regulatory compliance across all technology domains.​
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreements (SLAs), and other metrics to track performance.
  • Own budget management for the function, including forecasting, cost optimization, vendor spend, and capital expenditure planning across security, cloud, and third-party contracts

Global IT Service Management Leadership & Service Excellence

  • Own the global IT Service Management strategy, operating model, roadmap, standards, and governance across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses.
  • Lead global Service Desk and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support services, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across regions, businesses, offices, and venues.
  • Define and govern global service levels, KPIs, CSAT, operational performance, service quality, and continuous improvement programmes.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major service issues and business-impacting support challenges, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and resolution.

ITSM Processes, Governance & Platforms

  • Own and mature core IT Service Management disciplines globally, including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalogue, and Configuration Management.
  • Establish consistent global processes, controls, reporting, and governance aligned to ITIL principles and Live Nation standards.
  • Drive adoption, optimisation, and governance of ITSM platforms and tooling, ensuring they enable efficient workflows, accurate reporting, and a strong employee experience.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Applications, and business technology teams to ensure service management processes support operational resilience, security, and compliance.

AI, Automation & Service Transformation

  • Lead the strategy and adoption of AI, automation, self-service, and digital support capabilities across IT Service Management and Service Desk operations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activity, improve ticket deflection, accelerate resolution, and increase employee self-service.
  • Develop a data-led service improvement roadmap using service analytics, trends, employee feedback, and operational insights.
  • Drive standardisation and simplification across global support services while recognising appropriate business and regional requirements.

End-User Technology & Employee Lifecycle Management

jobs.title: Staff Secure Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

A staff-level program manager to run the operating model between Datavant's security organization and Engineering. Security teams spanning compliance, IT assurance, identity and access management, security operations, and product security all need work from engineering and platform teams across every business vertical. This role owns the quarterly cycle that turns those needs into a planned, prioritized engineering backlog, and holds security leaders and engineering managers alike accountable for their timelines from intake through delivery.

Your focus is coordination and accountability: making sure the right inputs arrive on time, and that committed work lands on engineering teams, moves, and gets closed out. This isn't a check-the-box PMO role. We're looking for someone who builds a cycle that runs better every quarter, not someone who sends more reminders.

What You Will Do

  • Own the quarterly security planning cycle end to end. Set and publish the calendar, adjust it quickly when engineering timelines shift, and manage carryover and close-out between quarters. Align the cycle with the audit and compliance calendar so teams know early when audit-driven work will land in their sprints.
  • Hold security leaders accountable throughout the cycle. Drive on-time submission of their engineering asks, and make sure each one arrives with what engineering needs to act on it: scope, owners, dates, and decisions. Make sure completed work is validated promptly, and escalate when commitments slip. Catch requests that arrive outside intake, and deconflict overlapping asks so engineering teams aren't asked for the same thing twice.
  • Design and run bi-weekly Scrum of Scrums sessions with engineering managers in each vertical. Define a format that ends every session with clear commitments, owners, and dates, and make the forum valuable enough that engineering managers want to attend. Track commitments against delivery, follow up directly on slips and absences, and escalate through vertical engineering leadership when needed.
  • Give leadership a clear, current view of security delivery. Maintain backlog structure in Jira, linked into company-wide roadmap structures. That way, readiness, commitments, progress, and risks can be reported by owner without manual reconstruction.
  • Convene and run working groups for upcoming security initiatives that need engineering input, so engineering helps shape what's asked of them before rollout. Drive each group to a decision and a documented outcome.
  • Continuously improve the cycle. Measure where it stalls, and fix the process, tooling, or incentives behind it rather than adding more process.

What You Need to Succeed

  • A track record of owning a recurring, cross-team planning or delivery cycle at organizational scale. You've run it through multiple iterations and made each one measurably better than the last.
  • Demonstrated ability to hold people accountable without formal authority, on both sides of a handoff, including leaders more senior than you. You're persistent and direct, comfortable escalating, and you keep relationships intact while doing it.
  • Experience bringing structure to a recurring forum or process that had lost focus. You've given a meeting a clear purpose, defined inputs and outputs, and made it something people showed up for because it was useful.
  • Experience coordinating work across a large number of teams and multiple business units at the same time, while keeping the details straight.
  • Fluency in how engineering teams plan and work: sprints, backlogs, capacity, and quarterly planning. Engineering managers see you as someone who makes their lives easier, not harder.
  • Strong Jira (or equivalent) skills, including workflows, issue hierarchies, JQL, and dashboards. You build the tracking and reporting yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.
  • Clear, concise written communication. You can write an ask that gets a usable answer the first time, and a status update a CISO can absorb in two minutes.
  • Comfort operating with little guidance across an enterprise-wide scope, including when deadlines compress and priorities compete.
  • The judgment to tell whether a stall is a process problem, a people problem, or a priority conflict that needs a leadership decision, and to handle each accordingly.

What Helps You Stand Out

  • A security, compliance, or risk background. You understand what a security ask means and why it matters, though you won't be expected to set security strategy.
  • Experience in regulated environments where audit timelines drive engineering work (e.g., HITRUST, SOC 2, FedRAMP, SOX/ITGC, HIPAA).
  • Experience running programs across multiple business units or recently acquired companies with different tooling and ways of working.
  • Experience formalizing an intake process, service-level expectations, or a validation workflow that stuck.
  • Experience building lightweight automation (e.g., Jira automation, scripts, AI-assisted tools such as Claude) to reduce manual follow-up and reporting.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Data Analyst specializing in Financial Operations (FinOps) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Data Analyst (FinOps) will analyze cloud consumption, operating costs, and resource utilization to help VA stakeholders understand expenditures, identify optimization opportunities, and make informed decisions about platform investments.

This position will support financial transparency and cost accountability across the Summit Data Platform by developing cost analyses, forecasts, dashboards, and recommendations that improve resource efficiency while maintaining operational performance and service quality.

  • Develop and maintain financial dashboards, cost reports, and performance indicators that provide visibility into cloud expenditures, usage trends, and cost drivers.

  • Monitor cloud budgets, spending thresholds, and consumption trends to identify potential overruns, anomalies, and emerging financial risks.

  • Develop cost forecasts and budget projections using historical consumption, workload trends, and anticipated platform demand.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary cloud spending through resource rightsizing, workload scheduling, storage optimization, and other cost management practices.

  • Investigate unexpected spending increases and usage anomalies, documenting root causes and recommended corrective actions.

  • Develop and maintain financial analysis models, reporting procedures, and supporting documentation to ensure consistent and repeatable cost assessments.

  • Prepare cost analysis summaries, financial performance reports, and recommendations for VA stakeholders to support resource planning and management decisions.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Four or more years of professional experience in financial analysis, cloud cost management, business analytics, or a related discipline.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Cost Management, cloud billing structures, and resource consumption reporting.

  • Experience analyzing operational metrics, identifying spending trends, and developing actionable cost optimization recommendations.

jobs.title: Strategic Solutions Engineer  (Pre-Sales & Post-Sales)
jobs.description:
Solutions Engineer, Strategic Accounts

Customer Solutions Group | Remote, North America

GrowthLoop is hiring a Solutions Engineer to guide complex enterprise platform transitions for a set of named strategic accounts, from technical strategy and solution design through hands-on implementation. You’ll work alongside our sales team to help these customers chart a path beyond legacy marketing systems, then lead the technical implementation through launch.

This role involves approximately 25% travel for on-site meetings with prospective and existing customers.

What You Will Do

Pre-Sales Solutions Engineering

  • Partner with Account Executives and other Solutions Engineers throughout the sales cycle for named strategic accounts. Shape the technical strategy for each opportunity and lead discovery with marketing, data, and technology stakeholders.
  • Map each customer’s current marketing architecture and workflows, from source data and identity through audiences, destinations, and campaign execution. Show what GrowthLoop would replace, connect to, or leave in place.
  • Design and deliver tailored demos, technical workshops, and proofs of value using the customer’s priority use cases. Answer detailed questions, address technical objections, and build confidence in the proposed solution.
  • Turn the proposed solution into a credible phased plan for migration and launch, including data and integration requirements, validation, dependencies, and risks. Set clear technical expectations before the sale so you can carry the plan into implementation.

Post-Sales Implementation for Named Accounts

  • Own the technical direction and delivery plan for the same named accounts, from kickoff through launch. Translate the solution agreed during the sales process into an executable architecture and implementation plan.
  • Coordinate data mapping, identity decisions, audience migration, destination integrations, testing, and customer validation across multiple teams.
  • Stay hands-on when a data flow, audience definition, or integration does not behave as expected. Lead technical escalations with Product and Engineering, make clear scope decisions, and get stalled work moving again.
  • Align technical and executive customer stakeholders on milestones, architecture decisions, risks, and launch readiness. Communicate changes to assumptions or timing early.
  • Maintain clear communication and documentation on decisions for internal and external project stakeholders

Improve the Next Implementation

  • Partner with the Customer Architect who owns the broader account relationship, with clear ownership of technical delivery.
  • Document the architecture, decisions, and implementation plan so the Customer Architect and customer teams stay aligned on progress, risks, and remaining work.
  • Turn recurring migration and integration challenges into reusable solution patterns and delivery playbooks. Share what works with other Solutions Engineers and Customer Architects.
  • Enable Customer Architects and Solutions Engineers to assess and work alongside customers’ existing marketing platforms, especially Adobe, using guidance from named account transitions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within your first six months, you’ve led the technical work for a strategic prospect from evaluation through go-live, helping the customer navigate a complex migration and start seeing value with GrowthLoop.
  • Within your first year, you’ve used those experiences to build practical guidance the team can reuse and bring customer insights back to Product to inform what we build next.

What You Bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Adobe’s enterprise marketing stack. You can assess how an existing implementation handles data ingestion, identity, audiences, journeys, and activation, then recommend a realistic path for changing or integrating those workflows. Experience with Adobe Experience Platform and Real-Time CDP is especially relevant; familiarity with Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, Audience Manager, and Customer Journey Analytics is valuable.
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-system enterprise marketing technology implementations or platform transitions from discovery through launch, with clear ownership of architecture and technical outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency with cloud warehouses, SQL, APIs, customer data models, identity resolution, audience logic, and downstream activation.
  • The ability to separate a workable first phase from a broader platform vision, with clear assumptions, dependencies, and tests for success.
  • Experience aligning customer and internal teams through high-stakes architecture and delivery decisions, managing risks and escalations, and recovering work when implementation stalls.
  • Executive presence and technical credibility with marketers, data engineers, and senior leaders. You can challenge assumptions constructively, explain tradeoffs plainly, and set expectations the team can meet.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

About You

You see complex customer transitions through, from the sales conversation to launch. You earn trust, make sound technical decisions, stay hands-on when implementation gets difficult, and keep teams aligned. You share credit and communicate honestly about risk. Our values are Love Our Customer, Make It So, Put We Over Me, Be Human, and Aim High.

What We Offer

The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $180,000 - $200,000 or CAD $260-$280,000. Total compensation includes equity and additional opportunities for variable compensation.

Open to candidates based in Canada or the United States. Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, depth of experience, and qualifications.

Rewards

  • See your work make an impact with some of the world’s most important brands.
  • Spot bonuses for major milestones and product feature launches.
  • Clear opportunities for career progression and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Equity in GrowthLoop, so you share in the value you help create.

Flexible, Remote-First Work

  • Remote-first culture with team members and leaders across North America and beyond, with strong communities in New York, San Francisco, and Toronto.
  • Flexible, goal-based work style.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • Monthly company-wide Recharge Days to truly unplug.
  • Annual home office stipend to support your workspace.

Comprehensive Benefits

  • 100% company-paid medical coverage for individual employees with strong dependent contributions, including dental and vision coverage.
  • Full health, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage for Canadian employees (fully employer-paid).
  • 401(k) or RRSP (Canada) program with a generous company match.

Learn and Grow

  • Quarterly hackathons focused on team passion projects.
  • Annual professional development stipend.
  • Work directly with a world-class executive team.
  • A culture of learning.

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Patient Experience
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer, Patient Experience to design, build, and ship AI-powered capabilities that improve how patients interact with Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on bringing large language models, intelligent automation, and machine learning into real patient-facing product experiences. You'll work on practical AI features that help patients understand platform workflows, complete onboarding, navigate treatment-related information, and interact with digital healthcare services more effectively.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, backend engineers, and clinical stakeholders to identify where AI can simplify complicated experiences without introducing unnecessary risk or friction.

The work goes beyond building prototypes or connecting an application to an LLM API. You'll be responsible for production-ready implementations, including model selection, retrieval systems, tool integrations, evaluation, monitoring, and reliable fallback behavior.

Because these systems operate in a healthcare environment, you'll need to think carefully about accuracy, privacy, sensitive information, and the boundaries between helpful AI assistance and decisions that require qualified clinical professionals.

You'll have meaningful ownership over technical decisions and will help establish reusable patterns for delivering dependable AI features across patient-facing applications.

We're looking for someone who enjoys shipping software, experimenting with new AI capabilities, and solving complex engineering problems while maintaining strong standards for product quality and reliability.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered features across Bask Health's patient-facing applications.
  • Build intelligent experiences that help patients navigate onboarding, questionnaires, and digital care workflows.
  • Develop AI-assisted interfaces that simplify complex patient interactions.
  • Integrate large language models into existing frontend and backend applications.
  • Build production services that support patient-facing AI features.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation systems using approved, relevant knowledge sources.
  • Implement structured outputs, tool calling, and workflow orchestration for AI applications.
  • Develop AI-assisted patient support and information experiences within approved boundaries.
  • Collaborate with clinical and product stakeholders to define safe AI behavior and escalation requirements.
  • Ensure AI-generated content does not independently replace clinical judgment or prescribing decisions.
  • Create safeguards for inaccurate, unsupported, or inappropriate AI-generated responses.
  • Build mechanisms for uncertainty handling, human review, and escalation when appropriate.
  • Design evaluation datasets and testing procedures for patient-facing AI features.
  • Measure response accuracy, relevance, latency, reliability, and user experience.
  • Implement monitoring and observability for production AI applications.
  • Investigate model failures, unexpected outputs, and performance issues.
  • Optimize prompts, retrieval pipelines, and application logic to improve output quality.
  • Evaluate AI models and providers based on performance, cost, reliability, and operational requirements.
  • Develop secure integrations between AI services and existing Bask platform APIs.
  • Work with engineering teams to ensure appropriate authentication, authorization, and data access controls.
  • Support privacy-conscious handling of patient information and sensitive application data.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to deliver responsive, intuitive AI-powered interfaces.
  • Build reusable components and backend services for future patient-facing AI features.
  • Write maintainable, well-tested code and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and help establish applied AI engineering standards.
  • Mentor other engineers and share practical knowledge about production AI development.
  • Use experimentation and product feedback to improve AI-assisted patient workflows.
  • Own features from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building AI-powered applications.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping LLM-powered or machine learning features into production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
  • Experience integrating large language models through production APIs.
  • Strong understanding of modern LLM application architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs, and model integration patterns.
  • Experience building retrieval-augmented generation systems or similar knowledge-grounded AI applications.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, semantic retrieval, and search infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing tool calling, workflow orchestration, or multi-step AI processes.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, including API design and service integrations.
  • Experience working with databases, application state, and production data systems.
  • Understanding of model evaluation and AI application testing methodologies.
  • Experience measuring and improving AI response quality, latency, and reliability.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing fallback behavior and error handling for AI-dependent applications.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and data privacy.
  • Ability to design safeguards for sensitive or high-impact AI workflows.
  • Experience collaborating with frontend engineers to deliver end-user product features.
  • Strong understanding of software testing, code review, and deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and production application environments.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working across engineering and product teams.
  • Ability to independently own complex technical projects from design through production.
  • Strong analytical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
  • Interest in building reliable, user-centered AI products.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing AI-powered applications in healthcare, telehealth, or digital health.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience building patient-facing chat interfaces, assistants, or guided workflows.
  • Experience designing AI systems with clinical oversight or human-in-the-loop review.
  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, patient onboarding, and treatment-related communication.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model providers.
  • Experience using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector.
  • Experience developing conversational AI systems.
  • Experience with agentic AI workflows and tool-using assistants.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation frameworks and automated LLM testing.
  • Experience with prompt versioning and experiment tracking.
  • Experience using React, Next.js, or modern frontend frameworks.
  • Experience building backend services with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle, or similar data tools.
  • Experience deploying applications on AWS or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with serverless architectures and event-driven systems.
  • Experience optimizing LLM inference costs and application latency.
  • Experience with AI-powered search, knowledge retrieval, or personalization.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Merchant Platform
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Merchant Platform to lead the design of intuitive, powerful, and scalable merchant-facing experiences across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together the tools merchants need to configure storefronts, manage products, operate subscriptions, monitor business activity, and coordinate workflows across patient experiences, clinical operations, pharmacy services, and commerce.

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll help shape how merchants interact with these capabilities, turning complicated business processes into clear, efficient, and reliable software experiences.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role that combines product thinking, user experience design, interaction design, visual design, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll own the design process from understanding merchant needs and defining problems through prototyping, implementation, and iteration.

Your work will focus on merchant-facing SaaS applications, including administrative dashboards, storefront and website configuration, product catalog management, subscription settings, commerce operations, and business management tools.

You'll design for users who need to complete complex tasks accurately and efficiently. This means understanding workflows with multiple steps, dependencies, permissions, configurations, and operational consequences.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, Customer Success Managers, and operational stakeholders to understand merchant requirements, technical constraints, and opportunities to improve the platform.

You'll also contribute to reusable design patterns and the broader Bask Health design system, helping ensure merchant-facing applications remain consistent as the platform grows.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, merchant interfaces must clearly distinguish business configuration from regulated clinical and pharmacy operations. You'll help design appropriate permissions, confirmation flows, error handling, and safeguards around sensitive administrative actions.

You'll use merchant feedback, usability research, product analytics, and implementation observations to improve existing experiences and identify opportunities for new capabilities.

We're looking for a senior designer who enjoys solving complex SaaS problems, understands how businesses use software to manage operations, and can independently deliver polished, practical product experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end product design for merchant-facing applications across Bask Health.
  • Design intuitive merchant dashboards and administrative interfaces.
  • Create workflows for configuring and managing merchant storefronts.
  • Design product catalog management experiences, including product setup, organization, and configuration.
  • Improve subscription management and recurring commerce interfaces.
  • Design merchant-facing pricing and billing configuration experiences within approved platform capabilities.
  • Create clear workflows for managing business settings and operational preferences.
  • Design interfaces that help merchants understand the status of their businesses and platform configurations.
  • Improve navigation and information architecture across complex administrative applications.
  • Develop user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.
  • Simplify multi-step merchant configuration and setup processes.
  • Design tables, filters, forms, bulk actions, and other components used in data-heavy applications.
  • Improve error messages, validation states, and recovery workflows for merchant actions.
  • Design appropriate confirmation patterns for sensitive or consequential administrative changes.
  • Collaborate with product managers to define merchant problems, requirements, and design objectives.
  • Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.
  • Partner with researchers and customer-facing teams to understand merchant behaviors and pain points.
  • Conduct or participate in usability testing for merchant-facing features.
  • Use product analytics and merchant feedback to evaluate design effectiveness.
  • Design responsive interfaces that support different screen sizes and working environments.
  • Apply accessibility principles to administrative tools and business workflows.
  • Contribute reusable components and patterns to Bask Health's design system.
  • Maintain consistency across merchant-facing applications and configuration tools.
  • Create detailed design specifications and implementation documentation.
  • Participate in product discovery, planning, and technical architecture discussions.
  • Present design concepts, explain tradeoffs, and incorporate stakeholder feedback.
  • Review implemented features and provide design quality feedback.
  • Independently own complex merchant platform design initiatives from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a closely related field.
  • Experience independently leading end-to-end product design projects.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating complex SaaS or web application design work.
  • Experience designing administrative dashboards, business software, or workflow-heavy applications.
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma or comparable product design tools.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles.
  • Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interface designs.
  • Strong visual design skills, including typography, spacing, layout, and hierarchy.
  • Understanding of interaction design and usability best practices.
  • Experience designing complex forms, tables, filters, and administrative workflows.
  • Strong understanding of information architecture and application navigation.
  • Experience designing responsive web applications.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product managers and software engineers.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical design solutions.
  • Experience contributing to design systems and reusable UI components.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research methods.
  • Ability to incorporate research findings and customer feedback into design decisions.
  • Experience designing software for users who perform complex operational tasks.
  • Ability to communicate design rationale clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing detailed design specifications for engineering implementation.
  • Strong attention to detail and interface consistency.
  • Ability to balance usability, business requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Experience improving existing products based on user feedback and performance data.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple design priorities and deliver high-quality work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing B2B SaaS platforms or merchant administration tools.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and online business operations.
  • Experience designing Shopify apps, merchant dashboards, or comparable commerce software.
  • Understanding of product catalog management and storefront configuration.
  • Experience designing subscription management or recurring billing interfaces.
  • Familiarity with payment processing and commerce workflows.
  • Experience designing no-code or low-code configuration tools.
  • Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture and configurable merchant experiences.
  • Experience designing role-based permissions and administrative access controls.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation and business process management tools.
  • Experience designing analytics dashboards and operational reporting interfaces.
  • Understanding of complex data tables, filtering, and bulk management patterns.
  • Experience with design systems used across multiple applications.
  • Familiarity with telehealth, healthcare administration, or pharmacy operations software.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience designing white-label software platforms.
  • Familiarity with React or modern frontend development concepts.
  • Experience collaborating with Customer Success or implementation teams.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted merchant tools or operational copilots.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design or development workflows.

jobs.title: State Government Affairs Associate (East)
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (East) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Eastern states. In this role, you’ll work alongside our State Government Affairs Directors to track bills, manage follow-up with lawmakers, and build materials for the 2027 sessions.

This role is built for someone who wants to win policy fights in more than one state at a time. You’ll have a hand in every Eastern portfolio, from digging into bill data to pitching legislators in statehouses across the region.

The ideal candidate brings three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work. This role is remote and reports to the Senior Director of State Affairs for the Eastern states. Expect frequent travel, especially during session.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1)Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2)Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3)Politically Savvy:Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4)Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5)Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As State Government Affairs Associate (East), you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Support the State Government Affairs Directors

  • Manage bill tracking, meeting follow-up, and back-end data.
  • Build and send the materials directors need for lawmakers and partners.

2) Represent FGA in the States

  • Join stakeholder and committee meetings at the direction of the Senior Director of State Affairs to advance FGA’s reforms.
  • Travel with directors on state trips to meet lawmakers and present FGA’s reforms.

3) Work with FGA’s In-State Contractors

  • Build working relationships with the in-state contractors in each director’s portfolio.
  • Join update and strategy calls and manage the follow-up.

4) Build State Plans and Session Reports

  • Work with the directors on pre-session plans for each state.
  • Draft post-session reports once the 2027 sessions close.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work.
  • Working knowledge of how bills move through a statehouse, from committee to the governor’s desk.
  • Strong communicator with lawmakers, partners, and teammates.
  • Comfortable using AI to speed up research, drafting, and data work. Quorum or other bill tracking experience a plus.
  • Able to travel frequently, especially during session.
  • Live in or near the Eastern states region for frequent travel, especially during session.
  • Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible. Beyond travel to the states, expect legislative fly-ins and quarterly team meetings.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $90,000–$120,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

jobs.title: ML Systems Engineer, Model Architectures (Mid/Senior/Principal)
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

As a ML Systems Engineer, you will be the engineer who gets new model architectures running on our hardware first, in simulation, before RTL or silicon exists. You will work with chip architects, the compiler and SDK teams, and customers to understand what each new architecture demands of the hardware and to make sure our simulators can execute it bit-exactly.

The work is implementation-heavy: new attention variants, mixture-of-experts, embeddings, and quantization formats, implemented in our simulator and verified against reference frameworks. You will set the standard turnaround for bringing up a new model and drive toward making that path fully automated.

Key Responsibilities

Simulator Implementation

  • Implement the operators, numerics, and memory layouts that new model architectures need in our simulator, bit-exact against a reference implementation.
  • Extend simulator coverage across the full inference path, including prefill and decode, embeddings, attention variants (grouped-query, gated, linear, and sparse), mixture-of-experts routing, and quantized formats.
  • Maintain reference comparisons and regression coverage so model support stays correct as the simulator and hardware evolve.

Architecture Evaluation

  • Evaluate new architectures before hardware exists, identifying what they require of compute, memory, and data movement and what the chip would need to change.

Customer Model Bring-Up and Automation

  • Bring customer models up in simulation ahead of emulator and hardware runs, and own the turnaround time for doing so.
  • Partner with the agentic tooling engineer to automate new-model bring-up end to end, from model specification to simulator coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as an ML systems or inference engineer.
  • A strong understanding of transformer internals at the operator level, including attention variants, mixture-of-experts, embeddings, KV cache, and quantization (INT8 and FP8).
  • Demonstrated experience implementing or porting model inference by hand in PyTorch, llama.cpp, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or a custom runtime.
  • Hands-on experience debugging numerical mismatches against a reference down to the operator and the bit.
  • Ability to read a model architecture paper and turn it into a working, verified implementation.
  • Strong Rust skills, or expert-level C/C++ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with strong Python skills for model and reference work.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain what a new architecture needs from the hardware and where the current design falls short.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience mapping models onto accelerator hardware or writing kernels for a non-GPU architecture.
  • Prior experience serving as the technical point of contact for customer model requests.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • You will be the first engineer to run each new frontier model architecture on our hardware, and your findings will feed directly into how our next chips are designed.
  • You will build the path toward fully automated model bring-up, working across chip architecture, compiler, SDK, and customer teams.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is; Mid: $160,000-$220,000, Senior: $220,000–$270,000, Principal: $270,000-$350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the Team:

As the most senior technical engineer on the IT Core Services team, the Sr. Staff Systems Engineer – Identity Governance & Access is Dexcom’s technical authority for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA). This role owns the engineering and long-term health of Dexcom’s SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) platform and serves as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory in a global, regulated environment with more than 14,000 human identities.

We are looking for a hands-on, security-first engineer who has built and operated SailPoint in production and is recognized by peers as the go-to expert. This person will lead Dexcom’s technical work on the SailPoint ISC implementation alongside our implementation partner, own the platform after go-live and raise the technical bar of the team.


Where You Come In:

  • You will serve as the technical owner and lead engineer for SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), overseeing tenant configuration, virtual appliances and IQService, identity profiles, transforms, rules, provisioning policies, and deployment activities across environments.
  • You will lead Dexcom’s SailPoint ISC implementation, partnering closely with implementation vendors to validate architecture, approve technical designs, drive testing efforts, and ensure successful knowledge transfer for long-term platform ownership.
  • You will design and support identity lifecycle automation by managing SailPoint-to-Workday integrations, Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes, and application onboarding across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, SaaS platforms, databases, and REST/SCIM-connected systems.
  • You will configure and enhance identity governance capabilities, including access requests, ServiceNow integrations, role-based access controls, access certifications, separation-of-duties policies, and governance processes for workforce, external, and non-human identities.
  • You will serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Entra ID, providing technical leadership in hybrid identity, single sign-on, provisioning, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, Privileged Identity Management, and Identity Protection.
  • You will provide expert guidance on enterprise Active Directory services, including directory architecture, Group Policy, Certificate Services, Kerberos security, privileged access strategies, and service account management.
  • You will champion a security-first, Zero Trust approach to identity management by enforcing least-privilege access, supporting identity threat detection and response, and partnering with Information Security to meet audit and compliance requirements.
  • You will leverage APIs, scripting, automation, configuration-as-code practices, and AI-powered tools to streamline identity operations, improve efficiency, and advance governance capabilities for both human and non-human identities.
  • You will operate the IGA platform as a highly available service by establishing monitoring, reporting, service levels, operational processes, and serving as the highest technical escalation point for identity-related incidents.
  • You will provide technical leadership across IT Core Services by mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, presenting solutions to architecture and change advisory boards, and establishing identity engineering standards, documentation, and best practices.

What Makes You Successful:

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • You bring extensive experience in systems engineering with deep expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Identity Governance & Administration (IGA).
  • You have hands-on experience leading enterprise SailPoint implementations and possess expert knowledge of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, including identity lifecycle management, workflows, certifications, provisioning, integrations, and automation.
  • You have successfully integrated SailPoint with Workday and other enterprise platforms to automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver processes at scale.
  • You have advanced expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid identity, single sign-on, provisioning, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.
  • You apply a strong security mindset and have experience implementing Zero Trust principles, least-privilege access models, privileged access controls, and identity security best practices.
  • You possess deep knowledge of identity standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and role-based access controls.
  • You have strong scripting and integration skills using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, and SQL.
  • You have experience supporting identity governance programs in regulated environments and partnering with compliance, audit, and security teams to meet SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and similar requirements.
  • You effectively manage implementation partners, influence stakeholders, mentor engineers, and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • You bring additional value through experience with Okta, CyberArk, Microsoft Defender for Identity, Microsoft Sentinel, cloud identity platforms, and non-human identity governance, including service accounts and AI agents.
  • You have experience leveraging AI-powered tools and automation technologies, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI ChatGPT, and related solutions, to enhance productivity and engineering outcomes.
  • You hold or are able to obtain industry-recognized certifications such as SailPoint ISC, Microsoft SC-300, SC-100, CISSP, CISM, or CCSP.
  • You thrive in regulated, fast-paced environments and have experience working within Agile and Scrum delivery models.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology.Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

  • 15–25%

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 13+ years related experience or a Master’s degree and 8+ years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 5+ years of experience.

  • Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

Description

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

Position Overview

BME Strategies is seeking an Advisor, Data Privacy, Security, and Classification to guide a data classification assessment for the Massachusetts Department of Public Health (DPH). The Advisor will assess how DPH classifies its data today and design a consistent, department-wide classification process that meets Commonwealth privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Build a map of the legal, regulatory, privacy, and security requirements that apply to DPH data.
  • Design classification levels, criteria, and decision rules, aligned with NIST SP 800-60 and FIPS 199.
  • Draft the engagement's main deliverables, including the current-state assessment and recommendations.
  • Serve as day-to-day contact for DPH's Privacy and Data Compliance Office and Office of General Counsel: prepare the questions they need to decide and record their decisions in the project decision log.

jobs.description:
About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We offer mainframe-like performance, reliability, and security for hyperconverged infrastructure and services while dramatically lowering overall cost and complexity. Our team combines deep engineering expertise with a relentless focus on performance, scalability, and innovation. We pioneered container-based virtualisation technologies and actively contribute to foundational OSS projects such as OpenVZ, Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, OpenStack, and more.

The Role

Lead Virtuozzo's powerhouse engineering team crafting Virtuozzo Infrastructure System. Guide the development of distributed storage, virtualisation, cluster orchestration, high availability, VM management, monitoring, and seamless updates through UI and REST APIs. As a player/coach, you'll mentor top talent, drive technical excellence, and deliver features that scale to millions—perfect if you love leading complex projects while staying close to the code.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of 5-10 senior engineers: set vision, prioritise roadmaps, and foster a high-performance culture.
  • Architect major features for cluster lifecycle, HA systems, and performance optimisation; contribute hands-on code as needed.
  • Champion code quality by overseeing automated testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and technical debt reduction.
  • Collaborate with product, QA, and support teams to resolve production issues and evolve the platform based on customer feedback.
  • Mentor engineers on best practices in Linux systems, networking, and distributed design; conduct code reviews and grow talent.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading teams.
  • Expert in Python, Rust, Go, or C/C++ for production systems.
  • Authoritative knowledge of Linux kernel architecture (e.g., NUMA, scheduling, I/O) and networking (SDN, TCP/IP stacks).
  • Proven track record of guiding distributed systems projects; strong problem-solving to unblock teams on tough challenges.
  • Leadership chops: experience mentoring, running agile processes, and delivering under deadlines.

Preferred Skills (Standout Plus)

  • Deep experience with hypervisors (KVM), containers (Docker/Podman), Kubernetes, or distributed storage.
  • Background in system programming, kernel internals (Linux/Windows/FreeBSD), or fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Proficiency in automation (Ansible, Bash, Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Web development for UI/REST (JavaScript, HTML/CSS); bonus for performance tuning and observability tools.

What We Offer

    • Remote and flexible working hours anywhere in EMEA
    • B2B contracting friendly
    • Professional growth: training budget, certification support, mentorship, and career progression pathways
    • Inclusive, multicultural team: work alongside talented engineers from across the globe on infrastructure-grade cloud products
    • Employee/Contributor perks: recognition programmes, referral bonuses, and learning initiatives, reward programs
    • Share Options – shares in our success with share options
