About the Role:

As the technical lead for inference performance, you will own end-to-end responsibility for the platform's Token Performance. For models ranging from hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters (including MoE), you will continuously reduce cost per million tokens and increase per-GPU Goodput while meeting TTFT/TPOT SLOs, and prove the gain from every optimization with reproducible data.

What You Will Work On

1. End-to-End Performance Attribution and Benchmarking

  • Establish a unified Token Performance metrics framework (TTFT, TPOT, Goodput, GPU utilization, per-token cost), and build load-testing benchmarks that reflect real production traffic (high concurrency, long context, multi-turn Agent workloads)
  • Perform bottleneck attribution for models such as DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, and MiniMax across compute, memory bandwidth, communication, scheduling, and queuing, and let the data determine which layer is the dominant constraint

2. Kernel-Level Inference Engine Optimization

  • Dive deep into the source code of vLLM / SGLang / TensorRT-LLM, customizing and contributing upstream on critical paths such as the scheduler, Continuous Batching, Chunked Prefill, CUDA Graph, and KV block management
  • Clearly define the responsibility boundary between the inference engine and orchestration layers such as Dynamo / llm-d, and reduce tail latency through request routing and load balancing

3. PD Disaggregation and KV Cache Transfer

  • Lead the core design of Prefill-Decode disaggregation: the KV transfer path (NIXL/RDMA/UCX), transfer-compute overlap, and phase-aware autoscaling
  • Define the failure domains and recovery semantics of cross-instance KV transfer, and answer the key question: under which workloads does PD disaggregation deliver gains, and under which does it make things slower

4. MoE Parallelism and Wide-EP

  • Design hybrid TP/PP/DP/EP parallelism strategies and quantify the trade-offs between EP and TP
  • Tackle expert load imbalance and All-to-All communication overhead, and drive Wide-EP into production

5. Kernels and Quantization

  • Write and tune critical CUDA (and ROCm/HIP) operators: memory access optimization, kernel fusion, and Attention / MoE / communication-related kernels
  • Build a closed-loop "quantization – accuracy – throughput" evaluation: the real-world gains and accuracy regressions of FP8/FP4/INT4/AWQ/GPTQ across different engines and hardware

Requirements

  • First-principles understanding of Transformer inference: the compute vs. memory-bound nature of Prefill and Decode, the KV Cache memory model, the differences among MHA/GQA/MLA, and how MoE routing constrains parallelism
  • Source-level, in-depth experience with at least one mainstream inference engine, with real cases of identifying and fixing bottlenecks in scheduling, kernel selection, or KV management
  • CUDA kernel tuning skills (Nsight profiling, memory optimization, fusion, CUDA Graph) with hands-on practical experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field (HPC systems, ML Systems).
  • Minimum 6 years in systems/Performance Engineering, with at least 2-3 years directly on LLM or GPU performance work

Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with Merged PRs in vLLM
  • Experience operating at cluster sale (hundreds to thousands of GPUs)

Senior Accountant – NetSuite, GAAP & Financial Reporting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible schedule aligned with U.S. business hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a highly detail-oriented Senior Accountant to own key accounting operations, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close activities for a growing U.S.-based business.

This is more than a transactional accounting role. You’ll take ownership of financial accuracy, maintain clean and audit-ready books, improve accounting processes, and provide leadership with reliable financial reporting and insights.

You’ll work closely with finance leadership, operations, and accounting team members across general ledger accounting, month-end close, financial statements, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvement.

If you have strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on ERP experience, and enjoy bringing structure and accuracy to financial operations, this role could be a great fit.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Accounting Operations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, payroll allocations, depreciation, and intercompany transactions
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts
  • Reconcile:
    • Cash and bank accounts
    • Accounts receivable and accounts payable
    • Credit cards
    • Deferred revenue
    • Inventory and other balance sheet accounts
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready accounting records

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close activities
  • Maintain close checklists, schedules, and supporting documentation
  • Prepare accruals and adjusting journal entries
  • Complete balance sheet reconciliations
  • Coordinate with internal teams to collect required reporting inputs
  • Help deliver an accurate and timely close within 5–7 business days

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis
  • Investigate material variances and provide clear commentary
  • Prepare financial schedules and reporting packages for leadership, audits, and executive reviews
  • Help translate accounting data into useful financial insights

NetSuite, ERP & Accounting Systems

  • Maintain accurate financial data within NetSuite or similar ERP/accounting systems
  • Support improvements to accounting workflows and system controls
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual accounting processes
  • Help improve reporting, reconciliations, and financial data integrity
  • Support ERP optimization and automation initiatives

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Support external audits and prepare PBC schedules
  • Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions and reconciliations
  • Assist with applicable tax and compliance reporting
  • Maintain accounting SOPs and internal controls
  • Ensure accounting practices align with GAAP and applicable company policies
  • Keep financial records organized and audit-ready

Team & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Review work completed by staff accountants, bookkeepers, or junior accounting team members
  • Provide guidance on reconciliations, journal entries, and accounting treatment
  • Collaborate with FP&A, operations, sales, and leadership
  • Help improve accounting processes, documentation, and reporting standards

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of financial accuracy
  • You’re highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • You understand the reasoning behind accounting entries, not just how to process them
  • You can identify discrepancies and investigate them independently
  • You work effectively under month-end and reporting deadlines
  • You communicate financial information clearly
  • You proactively look for ways to improve accounting processes and controls

Required Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • U.S. GAAP
    • General ledger accounting
    • Accrual accounting
    • Financial reporting
    • Account reconciliations
    • Month-end close
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or similar accounting/ERP systems
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Conditional formatting
    • Reconciliation and reporting workflows
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent accounting qualification
  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience
  • Multi-entity accounting and consolidations
  • Foreign currency or multi-currency accounting
  • SaaS, real estate, professional services, or other growing-company experience
  • ERP implementation or migration experience
  • Accounting automation experience
  • Experience developing or improving accounting SOPs and internal controls

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing cash activity and completing account reconciliations, then prepare journal entries or investigate discrepancies within the general ledger.

During close periods, you’ll work through the close checklist, post accruals and adjustments, review balance sheet accounts, analyze financial variances, and ensure reporting is completed accurately.

You’ll also collaborate with operations and finance leadership, review junior accounting work, support audit requests, and identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

In short: you ensure the company’s financial records are accurate, compliant, organized, and useful for decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within established deadlines
  • Accurate and timely financial statements
  • Clean and fully supported balance sheet reconciliations
  • Minimal accounting and reporting errors
  • Audit requests completed accurately and on time
  • Strong internal controls and documentation
  • Improved efficiency of accounting workflows

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video via Spark Hire
  3. Practical Accounting Assessment – Reconciliation, Variance Analysis & Reporting

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and show hiring teams how you communicate before the first interview. If there’s a strong fit, your first live conversation can focus on the role rather than starting from scratch.

Don’t overthink it. You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have strong GAAP and general ledger accounting experience
  • Have worked with NetSuite or similar ERP systems
  • Know how to manage reconciliations and month-end close
  • Care deeply about financial accuracy
  • Enjoy improving accounting processes
  • Want meaningful ownership within a growing business

We’d love to hear from you.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);

  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Outcomes
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer outcomes are about helping entrepreneurs and businesses turn our software into meaningful results. We value people who understand customer goals, take responsibility for delivering value, and build lasting relationships through strong execution, practical problem-solving, and measurable progress.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Customer Outcomes to lead Bask Health's customer success strategy with a strong focus on measurable customer value, platform adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

This role is responsible for building a customer success function that understands what customers are trying to accomplish and helps them achieve those goals.

You'll lead customer success operations, develop a high-performing team, and establish processes that connect customer engagement to meaningful business outcomes.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce businesses, merchant operations, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when building and scaling online businesses.

You'll develop a customer outcomes strategy that aligns customer goals with Bask Health's capabilities and business priorities.

You'll define how the team identifies customer objectives during onboarding and tracks progress throughout the customer lifecycle.

You'll establish a consistent approach to customer success planning, account reviews, adoption strategies, and outcome measurement.

You'll help the team understand the difference between customers simply using the platform and customers achieving meaningful value from it.

You'll develop frameworks for evaluating customer adoption, business engagement, account health, and retention risk.

You'll work with customer success managers to ensure customer goals are documented, understood, and revisited over time.

You'll establish clear expectations for account ownership, customer communication, and proactive engagement.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll help team members strengthen their strategic account management, commercial judgment, and problem-solving skills.

You'll create an environment where team members take ownership of customer outcomes rather than focusing only on completing tasks or responding to requests.

You'll work with leadership to develop appropriate customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.

You'll help determine how the team should support strategic accounts, growing merchants, and smaller businesses.

You'll establish meaningful performance metrics for customer success and customer outcomes.

You'll monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, expansion, product adoption, and other relevant indicators of customer health.

You'll develop reporting that helps leadership understand how customer success activities contribute to business performance.

You'll identify patterns in customer behavior that indicate successful adoption, declining engagement, or potential account risk.

You'll create proactive strategies to address customers who are struggling to achieve their goals.

You'll oversee important customer escalations and ensure issues affecting customer outcomes receive appropriate attention.

You'll build relationships with strategic customer stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in executive-level customer conversations when leadership involvement can help strengthen relationships or address challenges.

You'll guide the team in conducting meaningful business reviews focused on customer goals, progress, obstacles, and opportunities.

You'll collaborate with sales leadership to support renewal preparation and identify appropriate account expansion opportunities.

You'll help establish processes for identifying customers who may benefit from additional supported platform capabilities.

You'll ensure expansion conversations are grounded in customer needs and demonstrated value.

You'll work closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback, adoption challenges, and recurring product limitations.

You'll use customer insights to help inform product improvements that strengthen customer outcomes.

You'll collaborate with technical support and customer success engineering teams to address implementation or technical obstacles affecting adoption.

You'll help identify recurring technical problems that prevent customers from achieving important business goals.

You'll support improvements to customer onboarding, product education, and implementation handoffs.

You'll help ensure customers understand how to use Bask Health's capabilities effectively.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll ensure the customer success team understands the platform well enough to connect its capabilities to customer business needs.

You'll establish clear processes for recognizing when customer requests require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure the team follows appropriate security, privacy, and customer information-handling procedures.

You'll develop scalable customer success playbooks and operational processes.

You'll evaluate existing customer success tools, workflows, and reporting practices to identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll create a consistent approach to documenting customer goals, success plans, risks, and follow-up commitments.

You'll collaborate with leadership on organizational planning, staffing needs, and team development.

You'll participate in hiring and evaluating customer success talent as needed.

You'll establish performance coaching and professional development practices that reinforce accountability for customer results.

You'll help create clear collaboration between customer success, sales, product, engineering, and technical support teams.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate customer outcomes performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.

You'll help leadership understand how customer value realization affects retention, expansion, and long-term account relationships.

You'll balance customer advocacy with commercial priorities and operational realities.

You'll develop strategies that strengthen customer relationships while supporting responsible recurring-revenue growth.

We're looking for a leader with substantial post-sale customer success experience, proven team management ability, and meaningful e-commerce experience.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how customer outcomes influence retention and long-term account value.

You'll need to be comfortable building processes, coaching teams, managing strategic relationships, and making data-informed decisions.

Success in this role means creating a customer success function that consistently helps customers achieve meaningful results, improves retention, supports account growth, and demonstrates the value of Bask Health's platform.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's customer outcomes strategy and customer success operations.
  • Establish processes for identifying and documenting customer business goals.
  • Develop customer success plans focused on measurable results.
  • Build frameworks for tracking customer adoption and value realization.
  • Lead and coach customer success team members within the approved organization.
  • Establish clear expectations for account ownership and proactive customer engagement.
  • Develop customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, and expansion performance.
  • Establish customer outcomes metrics and reporting practices.
  • Identify customers who are struggling to achieve expected results.
  • Develop proactive strategies to improve adoption and reduce retention risk.
  • Oversee strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagements.
  • Guide customer success managers in conducting outcome-focused business reviews.
  • Support renewal preparation and appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on account growth strategies.
  • Work with product and engineering on customer adoption challenges.
  • Coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering teams.
  • Improve onboarding and implementation handoffs.
  • Develop customer success playbooks and internal training resources.
  • Establish consistent processes for documenting customer goals and account risks.
  • Build reporting that connects customer success activities to business performance.
  • Identify recurring customer obstacles and recommend improvements.
  • Oversee important customer escalations affecting account health.
  • Coach team members on strategic account management and commercial judgment.
  • Support organizational planning and customer success hiring.
  • Improve customer success tools, workflows, and documentation.
  • Establish clear collaboration between customer success and other departments.
  • Promote accountability for measurable customer outcomes.
  • Ensure appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling practices.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Provide leadership with clear updates on customer outcomes, retention, and risks.
  • Take ownership of the customer success function's effectiveness and long-term results.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a closely related post-sale customer-facing function.
  • At least 4 years of experience directly managing and developing customer success or account management teams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of post-sale customer success strategy and operations.
  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business models, direct-to-consumer operations, and merchant needs.
  • Experience developing customer success strategies focused on measurable customer outcomes.
  • Proven ability to lead customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion initiatives.
  • Experience creating and managing customer success plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and evaluate customer-facing employees.
  • Experience establishing customer success performance metrics and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of customer retention, churn, account health, and renewal performance.
  • Experience measuring customer adoption and value realization.
  • Ability to develop strategies for improving customer retention and long-term engagement.
  • Experience supporting expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts.
  • Strong commercial judgment and understanding of recurring-revenue SaaS businesses.
  • Experience managing relationships with founders, executives, and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead strategic account reviews and customer outcome discussions.
  • Experience handling complex customer escalations.
  • Experience collaborating with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback into operational and product recommendations.
  • Experience building customer success playbooks and scalable processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present customer outcomes and business performance to leadership.
  • Strong analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Experience managing multiple strategic priorities and competing demands.
  • Strong organizational and operational planning skills.
  • Ability to lead teams in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Strong ownership mentality and accountability for customer and team outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading customer success at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience managing customer success teams serving Shopify merchants.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar commerce platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer brands and online entrepreneurs.
  • Personal experience building or operating an e-commerce business.
  • Experience leading customer success for both SMB and strategic accounts.
  • Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
  • Experience developing customer value realization frameworks.
  • Experience creating customer outcome scorecards and success plans.
  • Experience improving gross revenue retention and net revenue retention.
  • Experience developing customer health scoring and churn prediction processes.
  • Experience building customer success dashboards and reporting.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing customer segmentation and account assignment models.
  • Experience building customer success teams during periods of growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional customer retention initiatives.
  • Experience developing account expansion processes with sales teams.
  • Experience improving technical onboarding and customer implementation handoffs.
  • Familiarity with online storefront, checkout, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders and senior company leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Data Architect who enjoys both enterprise-level architecture and hands-on technical design? Do you want to keep our source systems, data platform and AI use cases working together coherently?

At LGC, we're looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect to take on the day-to-day running of our enterprise data architecture, working under the direction of the Head of Enterprise Data & AI Architecture.

This is a hands-on role that combines classic enterprise data architecture, keeping data coherent across ERP, CRM, Finance, Supply Chain and Laboratory Systems, with technical data architecture on our Snowflake platform, including dbt and integration patterns. You will also help drive our strategic semantic architecture and enterprise ontology, so that analytics and AI are built on trusted, consistent business meaning.

We're looking for someone who can see the bigger picture but isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get into the detail.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Engage with source systems: Act as the data architecture representative in ERP, CRM, Finance, Supply Chain and Laboratory Systems programmes, assessing the downstream impact of changes, upgrades and new implementations, and profiling source data before integration begins.
  • Design enterprise data models: Create and maintain conceptual, canonical and semantic data models for key domains such as Product, Customer, Supplier, Finance, Employee and Quality.
  • Define patterns and blueprints: Produce reference architectures, integration blueprints, data contracts and modelling standards for ingestion, medallion and ELT patterns.
  • Work with Snowflake and dbt: Design and guide delivery of data models, semantic views and consumption models in Snowflake, with dbt transformations tested for grain, joins and metric correctness.
  • Guide engineering teams: Review data engineering designs for conformity with architectural standards and contribute to engineering guardrails and platform best practice.
  • Shape our semantic architecture and ontology: Help develop the LGC enterprise ontology by linking source metadata and relationships to governed business concepts, and establish consistent, trusted definitions across the organisation. Manage a controlled lifecycle to propose, validate, approve and retire semantic assertions, and turn them into practical Snowflake semantic models.
  • Support AI innovation: Design governed data products and models that enable AI applications, including RAG and GraphRAG.
  • Drive data quality and governance: Ensure data is reliable, traceable and fit for purpose through data governance, metadata management, Master Data Management designs and quality controls.
  • Turn complex ideas into practical solutions: Translate business requirements into clear architectural designs and documentation, represent the Data & AI team in architecture and demand review forums, and work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • ​​​​​Proven experience in Enterprise Data Architecture, ideally within a complex, multi-system organisation.
  • Experience engaging directly with source systems such as ERP, CRM, Finance or Lab Systems, and translating business data requirements into architectural design.
  • Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, relational and dimensional data modelling.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation design, testing and lineage.
  • Advanced SQL skills across platforms such as Snowflake, SQL Server or Oracle, and experience developing and testing analytical data models.
  • A solid understanding of ETL/ELT, data integration, data pipelines, and medallion or lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience designing semantic models, with a good understanding of enterprise ontologies, data concepts, relationships and business definitions, and how governed semantic models support analytics and AI.
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, lineage and data quality, including controls for data used by AI and ML models.
  • Experience producing architecture documentation, data models, integration blueprints and technical designs.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The following experience would be beneficial:

  • Experience building enterprise ontologies or knowledge graphs, using semantic technologies such as SPARQL or SHACL.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake Semantic Views or Cortex.
  • Understanding of integration patterns (API, event-driven, file-based) and platforms such as MuleSoft.
  • Exposure to Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as Erwin Evolve.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML applications or working with RAG and GraphRAG.
  • A background in life sciences, regulated industries or global organisations.
  • Recognised enterprise architecture, data architecture or cloud platform certifications.

Our values:

Passion: Pride in our achievements engenders passion for our work and it translates into our ambition to make the world a safer place.

Curiosity: We constantly look forward to what's next: our curiosity for today's discoveries makes tomorrow's innovations possible.

Integrity: A commitment to high ethical standards has been at the heart of LGC since we started testing the integrity of products in 1842.

Brilliance: We strive to be the very best in everything we say and do. We exceed customers' expectations through innovation and pioneering science.

Respect: We respect gender, age, nationality, religion and individuality – our diversity is our strength.

We are committed to ensuring that every job applicant and employee is valued for their individual talents. We strictly prohibit discrimination on the basis of age, disability, race, colour, ethnic or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership, pregnancy or parental status, religion, or belief. We proudly support an inclusive work environment where everyone can compete and succeed based on their merits.

For more information about LGC, please visit our website

It works with customers in the pharmaceuticals, agricultural biotechnology, food, environment, and sports sectors as well as with governments and academia to achieve excellence in investigative, diagnostic and measurement science.

LGC has sites across the globe including the UK, the US, Europe, China, and Canada. LGC Group supports the development of clinical diagnostic kits, genomics-based therapeutics, and drought-resistant crops with its genomics capabilities. jobs.title: Customer Growth Manager
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer growth is about helping existing merchants find more value in the platform while building stronger, longer-term business relationships. We value commercial awareness, initiative, clear communication, and people who can identify opportunities and follow through on them.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Growth Manager to help Bask Health's existing merchants expand their businesses and increase the value they receive from our software platform.

This role focuses on identifying account growth opportunities, strengthening customer adoption, supporting retention, and developing long-term relationships with merchants.

You'll work with an assigned portfolio of existing customers using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses that rely on our platform to support their operations.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of each customer's business model, current platform usage, growth goals, and operational challenges.

You'll look for opportunities to help customers make better use of existing capabilities and adopt additional features that support their business objectives.

You'll work closely with customer success managers, sales, product, and other internal teams to coordinate account growth initiatives.

Unlike a traditional new-business sales role, your primary focus will be growing relationships with customers who already use Bask Health.

You'll be expected to identify opportunities that may increase account value, improve platform utilization, and strengthen long-term customer retention.

You'll develop relationships with business owners, founders, and other decision-makers to understand their priorities and plans for growth.

You'll discuss how Bask Health's platform can support new initiatives, changing business needs, and additional operational requirements.

Our software brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll learn how these features connect so you can identify relevant opportunities for additional platform adoption.

You'll analyze available customer data, account activity, and product usage to identify accounts with growth potential.

You'll recognize when customers are underutilizing features that could help them operate more effectively.

You'll work with customers to understand the reasons behind limited adoption and recommend appropriate next steps.

You'll identify opportunities for additional products, services, features, or supported capabilities when they align with customer needs.

You'll help coordinate expansion conversations and collaborate with the appropriate commercial stakeholders when pricing, contracts, or other commercial approvals are required.

You'll contribute to account growth plans that outline customer goals, potential opportunities, and follow-up activities.

You'll conduct regular growth-focused account reviews to discuss business performance, product adoption, and upcoming priorities.

You'll help customers understand new product capabilities and how they may fit into their business plans.

You'll also support retention by identifying account concerns that could limit future growth or put the relationship at risk.

You'll work with customer success and technical teams to help address those concerns before pursuing additional expansion opportunities.

You'll understand that sustainable account growth depends on customers receiving meaningful value from the platform.

You'll avoid recommending unnecessary features or commercial changes that do not align with the customer's needs.

You'll collaborate with customer success managers to maintain consistent communication and avoid overlapping or conflicting outreach.

You'll coordinate with product and engineering teams when customer feedback reveals opportunities to improve functionality or usability.

You'll work with technical support and customer success engineering teams when growth initiatives involve implementation questions or platform limitations.

You'll maintain accurate records of account growth opportunities, customer conversations, next steps, and relevant commercial activity.

You'll use CRM and account management tools to track expansion opportunities and organize follow-up.

You'll monitor account growth performance using available measures such as expansion revenue, product adoption, account retention, and opportunity conversion.

You'll share insights about customer growth patterns and recurring expansion opportunities with leadership.

You'll help improve customer growth playbooks, account planning processes, and internal collaboration between customer success and sales.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when customer requests involve clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or other specialized responsibilities.

You'll coordinate with the appropriate authorized teams without making clinical or pharmacy decisions outside your role.

You'll work in a remote environment where initiative, accountability, and clear communication are important.

We're looking for someone with genuine post-sale customer relationship experience, strong commercial awareness, and recent experience working with e-commerce businesses or merchant-facing software.

You should be comfortable discussing business goals with entrepreneurs and identifying opportunities that create value for both the customer and Bask Health.

You'll need to be organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of managing multiple account growth initiatives independently.

Success in this role means helping existing merchants adopt more of the platform, strengthen their relationships with Bask Health, and expand their accounts in ways that support their business goals.

What You'll Do

  • Identify opportunities to expand account value and platform adoption.
  • Build relationships with entrepreneurs, business owners, and customer decision-makers.
  • Understand each customer's business model, goals, and growth priorities.

Staff DevOps Engineer

Who we are

Action1 is a cloud-native autonomous endpoint management platform that helps organizations automate operating system and third-party patching, assess vulnerabilities, and secure endpoints at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations managing millions of endpoints globally, we are building the infrastructure that supports our continued growth.

The Role

Working hours

  • Working hours close to the CET time zone are preferred to support regular collaboration with your manager and coordination of the team’s workload.
  • Flexibility to adjust working hours for team coordination, planned production changes, and critical incidents. This includes working US time-zone hours for a couple of days when needed to attend team meetings, participate in cross-training, or support handovers.

Job Scope

  • We are looking for a Senior / Staff DevOps Engineer to build and operate Action1’s AWS infrastructure, improve deployment automation, and strengthen production reliability and security.
  • This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will identify problems, make technical decisions, and carry improvements through implementation and validation, with support and input from your manager and peers.
  • You will join a small, collaborative DevOps team where your ideas help shape how we work. There is room to try new approaches, learn from experienced colleagues, and see your work make a difference in production. You will work closely with R&D and QA on releases and production needs.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve our AWS infrastructure. Design and operate secure, resilient infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions. Evaluate architecture decisions against production requirements, operational complexity, performance, and cost.
  • Build infrastructure as code. Develop reusable components, reduce configuration drift, and make environments reproducible. Maintain infrastructure and automation in Git with peer review, testing, documentation, and clear ownership.
  • Improve deployment pipelines. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated checks, deployment controls, and rollback mechanisms to make releases safer and more predictable.
  • Develop reliable automation. Use programming, scripting, and APIs to simplify operations, eliminate repetitive work, and build tooling the team can maintain and support.
  • Apply AI in daily DevOps work. Use approved tools such as Codex or Claude for infrastructure code, scripting, testing, troubleshooting, operational analysis, and documentation. Build reusable workflows, independently review and test outputs, protect sensitive information, and follow established review and change controls.
  • Strengthen observability. Improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts. Investigate performance and capacity constraints, connect telemetry to application behavior, and reduce unnecessary alert noise.
  • Own production reliability. Participate in the on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed. Coordinate recovery, communicate clearly, investigate underlying causes, and verify that corrective changes address the problem.
  • Validate resilience and recovery. Develop and test backup, recovery, failover, and maintenance procedures. Use controlled failure exercises where appropriate to identify weaknesses before they affect customers.
  • Continuously assess AWS platform security. Review access, network exposure, logging, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations across accounts and environments. Investigate security findings and suspicious activity, prioritize work by risk, and drive remediation through implementation and verification, coordinating with Security and the owners of affected systems.
  • Improve AWS security controls. Evaluate and introduce practical improvements to threat detection, automated security checks, and response workflows. Strengthen least-privilege access, network controls, secrets management, encryption, hardening, and auditability. Integrate technical controls into infrastructure and delivery pipelines to meet security and compliance requirements.
  • Improve cloud efficiency. Understand cost drivers, identify waste, and evaluate capacity and architecture improvements using measured workload behavior. Verify savings alongside performance and reliability.
  • Share operational knowledge. Review infrastructure designs and automation code, document decisions, and maintain useful runbooks and technical documentation.

What we’re looking for

  • Substantial hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure engineering for production SaaS environments.
  • A record of independently identifying and solving problems, prioritizing work, and coordinating dependencies while keeping others informed.
  • Deep AWS knowledge and experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting distributed systems across multiple environments.
  • Strong AWS security operations experience, including assessments, incident investigations, and vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation.
  • Hands-on observability experience using metrics, logs, and traces to investigate production issues and build actionable dashboards and alerts.
  • Strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Node.js, or a comparable language for maintainable automation and API integrations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with both Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, supported by Git, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Sound understanding of operating systems, networking, DNS, TLS, identity, storage, and database behavior, with the ability to troubleshoot across system boundaries.
  • Experience with production incident response, root-cause analysis, and recovery planning.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in DevOps, including examples of their benefits, limitations, and how you validated and corrected their output.
  • Analytical thinking and sound judgment: test assumptions, distinguish symptoms from causes, weigh trade-offs, verify results, and recognize when broader review is needed.
  • Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and adjust working hours for team coordination, planned production changes, and critical incidents.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Datadog experience for production troubleshooting and reliability improvement.
  • Experience with Terramate for managing Terraform infrastructure across environments.
  • Experience building operational tools or self-service workflows for provisioning, deployments, and environment management.
  • Practical SRE experience, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, and reliability reviews.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable requirements through technical controls and operational evidence.
  • Experience developing AI agents with appropriate access boundaries, evaluation, and human oversight.
  • Experience mentoring DevOps engineers and leading infrastructure or operational improvements.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work, with flexibility around team collaboration and production responsibilities.
  • Ownership of infrastructure supporting a growing global platform.
  • Challenging DevOps work and opportunities to deepen your technical expertise.
  • Direct collaboration with experienced, supportive peers.

jobs.title: Order Management Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are seeking an Order Management Specialist to join our growing Order Management function. This candidate will play a pivotal role in reviewing customer contracts, facilitating timely and accurate processing of orders, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures. Additionally, this candidate will have the opportunity to participate in key initiatives to improve order and data accuracy.

The Order Management department is part of Samsara’s Finance organization. We are a highly collaborative, global team from a diverse range of backgrounds, focused on making Samsara a great place to work and develop our careers. You will work with Sales, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Business Technology, and Order-to-Cash to deliver a seamless order experience for our customers. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, possesses a strong attention to detail and appreciation for process, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys collaborating with other teams to solve challenges.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Review customer orders prior to shipping, ensuring the products, pricing, and terms are accurate, complete, and compliant with company policy.
  • Reconcile customer order information against the internal system of record.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Sales Ops, and Deal Desk to determine the resolution path for any order discrepancies.
  • Respond to Sales inquiries regarding opportunity status or any questions on the opportunity closure process.
  • Collaborate with your global peers to identify solutions for common order issues and drive global consistency in process.
  • With the support of management, identify and support implementation of improvements to Samsara’s systems and tools to streamline the order review process.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, such as Sales Ops, Order to Cash, and Business Technology, on company projects.
  • Support the generation and ongoing maintenance of reporting dashboards to track order volume and activity.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of professional work experience.
  • Professional-level written and verbal fluency in English.
  • Excellent attention to detail with an emphasis on accuracy and timeliness.
  • Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a larger team.
  • Ability to multitask, adapt, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and openness to feedback.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work during Pacific time zone business hours.
  • Ability to work extended hours during month and quarter end.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Proficiency with CRM and CPQ platform (Salesforce preferred).
  • Experience in a contract specialist, order management, and/or related Finance role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.
  • Appreciation for leveraging data to instigate meaningful business process change.
  • Aptitude for building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders and peers.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Description

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Amgen Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation organization is looking for a Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement to extend web expertise and scale support for new and emerging demand across Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial needs. The role provides strategy, governance, and delivery leadership so teams can apply enterprise web standards and capabilities to their needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio governance and launch readiness - Guide web portfolio governance and provide launch readiness support for Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial web initiatives. Clarify governance requirements, decision points, owners, and readiness needs, and help teams navigate the appropriate web delivery processes.
  • Strategic Web Program Lead - Serve as a subject-matter expert on CMS, Design System, back-end system integrations, pharmaceutical web marketing best practices and emerging trends. Advise business teams on how to apply current web capabilities to business objectives and audience needs, and identify opportunities to strengthen digital experiences. Translate business goals into strategic recommendations and proactively define future-state capability enhancements and roadmaps, partnering with business, technology, content, design, analytics, and agency teams to assess feasibility, value, and dependencies.
  • Standards and platform transitions - Promote adoption of enterprise web standards and governance. Assess externally hosted or custom web platforms and help plan their transition toward global web enterprise standards, including alignment on scope, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder responsibilities.
  • Vendor and procurement enablement - Advise teams on engaging web vendors and agencies. Support statement-of-work development and procurement planning for web services, including Analytics and SEO engagements, in coordination with relevant procurement and business partners.
  • Portfolio Prioritization & Planning: Lead quarterly intake and prioritization of web initiatives with Technology and business stakeholders, aligning investment to enterprise strategy, business value, and resource capacity. Translate prioritized needs into actionable scope, requirements, sequencing, timelines, and delivery plans. Assess cross-project and platform dependencies, clarify ownership, and apply governance to support informed prioritization and delivery.
  • Web Delivery & Release Management: Lead cross-functional web initiatives from approved plans through development, launch, and hypercare. Coordinate creative and content handoffs, development, approvals, QA/UAT, deployment, and production validation. Align timelines, resources, budgets, dependencies, and release requirements; establish launch readiness; facilitate decisions; resolve issues; and communicate status and escalations to support successful, timely delivery.
  • Program Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Monitor program health, governance adherence, documentation, risks, issues, and change impacts across web initiatives. Coordinate business, content, creative, development, technology, analytics, and agency partners to clarify ownership, manage handoffs, and resolve conflicts across concurrent initiatives, platform migrations, technology releases, and regulatory deadlines. Embed legal, regulatory, privacy, accessibility, brand, and operational resilience requirements throughout delivery, escalating material risks as needed.
  • Performance & Continuous Improvement: Partner with analytics and SEO teams to interpret web traffic, user behavior, search performance, and other digital insights, and use findings to recommend website optimization. Lead structured retrospectives and apply performance insights, lessons learned, and emerging trends to recommend improvements to web capabilities, standards, tools, templates, and delivery processes. Scale effective practices to improve consistency, efficiency, collaboration, and speed to market..

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Strategist professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Or

Associate’s degree and 10 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Preferred Experience:


  • Web governance and enablement — Experience establishing or applying web standards, governance, launch readiness, and operating models across multiple business functions, platforms, or markets.
  • Strategy and consultation — Experience advising senior and cross-functional partners, translating business needs into web recommendations, and evaluating platform, vendor, or capability options.
  • Digital Program / Project Management Expertise - 6+ years of experience managing end-to-end digital and website lifecycle projects in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments, including complex, cross-country, and high-impact initiatives.
  • Agile & Program Management - Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (preferably SAFe) with experience managing website roadmaps and continuous improvement initiatives. Proficient in Program / Project Management tools such as Workfront, AEM, JIRA, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Google Analytics.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management - Proven ability to negotiate priorities, manage expectations, and build productive relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Regulatory & Technical Acumen - Experience operating in regulated industries (preferably pharma) with understanding of compliance requirements. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), privacy regulations (GDPR, US consumer laws), web technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS), and industry best practices is a plus.
  • Documentation & Governance - Experience developing detailed project documentation and translating business requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred Competencies:


  • Leadership & Collaboration - Effective communication, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to convey complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking — Connect enterprise web capabilities and standards to business needs, and identify practical ways to support new demand at scale.

Praxis partners with external manufacturers to produce life-changing medicines for patients with central nervous system disorders. This role exists to ensure those partners operate with the same urgency, quality, and accountability that we expect from ourselves.

As Director, Commercial Manufacturing Operations, you will serve as the operational leader for commercial manufacturing of an assigned product. Acting as Praxis's "virtual plant manager," you will own day-to-day manufacturing performance across one or more CDMO partners, ensuring reliable supply, operational excellence, and continuous improvement throughout the commercial lifecycle.

This is not a project management or technical transfer role. It is an operations leadership role focused on delivering consistent commercial execution through influence, partnership, and disciplined operational management. You'll build strong relationships across Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, MSAT, Procurement, and our external partners to anticipate risks, solve problems quickly, and continuously raise performance standards.

Success in this role means patients receive uninterrupted access to medicines because our manufacturing network consistently delivers safe, compliant, high-quality product.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Growth
jobs.description:
Lone Wolf builds the software real estate runs on. Brokerages, agents, MLSs, and associations across North America use our products for forms and transaction management (zipForm, Transaction Desk, Transact), e-signature (Authentisign), comparative market analysis (Cloud CMA), listing advertising (Boost), and brokerage back office.

A large share of North American real estate agents use Lone Wolf products, and many of them buy on their own with a credit card: an e-signature plan, a forms upgrade, a CMA subscription, an ad for a new listing. You’ll be the owner that runs it as one system, with one dashboard and a steady stream of experiments along the way.

You’ll wear two hats:

  1. Product manager for Brand Management (Boost). Boost automates listing and brand advertising on Facebook, Instagram, and Google for agents and brokerages. You’ll own its roadmap, its metrics, and the priorities of its engineering team.
  2. Growth lead for every agent-purchased product. You’ll own the path from first touch to purchase to expansion across Boost, Cloud CMA, Authentisign, zipForm and Transaction Desk upgrades, and more.

This is your business to run. You’ll report to the Chief Innovation Officer, who sets direction, holds the number with the executive team, clears cross-functional blockers, and makes the calls that need executive weight: major pricing changes, tradeoffs across product pillars, and scale-or-stop decisions. Everything else is yours: the backlog, the experiments, the funnels, the roadmap, and the weekly review. You won’t be executing someone else’s plan. You’ll write it.

This is a builder’s role with a wide surface. Most of the funnel runs through teams you won’t manage: marketing’s website and SEO, CX’s in-app messaging and onboarding, other product teams’ engineering time, and sales conversations with brokerages. Your leverage is data, speed, and the ability to bring people with you.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the agent revenue number. Build the dashboard yourself (SQL, Metabase), run the weekly review, and make it what everyone else looks at. Bring a monthly readout to the executive team alongside the CIO.
  • Find and fix funnel leaks in landing pages, pricing pages, checkout, trials, and in-product upgrade prompts.
  • Run lifecycle email as a growth channel. Iterable triggers at listing events, onboarding, upgrade, and win-back. Write the copy, set up the tests, and read the results.
  • Ship your own variants. Build landing pages and messaging variants yourself with AI tools. Work hand in hand with Marketing’s website lead on lwolf.com agent pages and SEO, where Boost now sits alongside our other agent products.
  • Run experiments end to end: hypothesis, instrumentation, launch, readout, and decision, at a high tempo.
  • Own agent pricing and packaging: bundles, trials, annual plans, auto-renewal, and cross-product offers. Bring recommendations to the CIO for the big moves.
  • Shape how agents buy Transact. As agents move from zipForm and Transaction Desk to Transact, make sure the products they pay for today, like Authentisign and forms upgrades, still have a clear path to purchase.
  • Run the Boost roadmap. Balance growth work against reliability and commitments to brokerage and partner customers. Sales owns brokerage Boost deals; you make sure the product and the team behind it support them.
  • Test paid acquisition on a small budget, and scale only what pays back.
  • Get things done across the business. Win engineering time from other product teams, in-app placements from CX, page changes from Marketing, and agent offers in Sales conversations, without owning any of them.
  • Stand up lean product analytics that don’t require hand-instrumenting every event.

Requirements:

  • A track record of growing a purchase funnel with a product-led mindset. Bring the before-and-after numbers and explain what you personally did to move them.
  • Range across disciplines. You might come up through product management, growth marketing, or e-commerce. Either way, you’ve done the work of all three: shaping product, writing and testing messaging, and optimizing checkout and pricing.
  • You build things yourself. Landing pages, email variants, dashboards, prototypes. You use AI tools to build what used to take a team, and you can show us.
  • Data self-sufficiency. You write your own SQL, build your own dashboards, and design and read your own experiments without waiting on an analyst.
  • Ownership. You’ve run a number, not just a backlog. You set your own priorities, make the calls in front of you, and bring your manager decisions rather than questions.
  • Influence without authority. Concrete examples of getting important work done through teams you didn’t manage.
  • Experience: typically 7+ years across product, growth, or e-commerce roles, with direct ownership of revenue or conversion metrics.

    • Nice to have:

  • Real estate or proptech experience, or SaaS sold to independent professionals and small businesses.
  • Lifecycle platforms and paid social or search (Meta, Google Ads).
  • Pricing and packaging work on self-serve subscriptions, including e-commerce or billing migrations when products are replaced.
  • Setting up product analytics from scratch on a budget.
  • Working across multiple product lines, legacy systems, or a post-acquisition portfolio.

    • Compensation:

  • Base salary
  • A meaningful performance incentive tied to agent revenue growth
