jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization to build and improve intelligent systems that help Bask Health deliver more relevant and personalized experiences across our platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, bringing together merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As merchants grow, we want to help them create digital experiences that are responsive to user needs, preferences, and interactions.

You'll develop machine learning models and recommendation systems that support personalized content, relevant platform experiences, and intelligent discovery within approved product workflows.

This is a hands-on machine learning engineering role that combines model development, data processing, backend integration, experimentation, and production monitoring. You'll work with application data, user interaction signals, machine learning algorithms, and platform services to build personalization capabilities that operate reliably at scale.

Your work may include developing ranking models, recommendation algorithms, user preference representations, behavioral feature pipelines, and systems that adapt application experiences based on relevant, authorized signals.

You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, frontend engineers, data specialists, and other machine learning engineers to identify personalization opportunities and translate them into production-ready features.

You'll also help design experiments to measure whether personalization improves user experience, engagement, and relevant product outcomes. You'll evaluate model quality, investigate performance issues, and continuously improve algorithms based on measured results.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, personalization must respect privacy, data access permissions, and clinical boundaries. You'll ensure that models do not independently determine medical eligibility, recommend treatments, change prescriptions, or override approved clinical workflows.

This position emphasizes practical machine learning, strong software engineering fundamentals, and measurable product improvements. You'll contribute to model design, implement production systems, and own features through deployment and ongoing optimization.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys working with recommendation systems, understands the challenges of real-world personalization, and wants to build intelligent product experiences that are useful, reliable, and responsible.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that support personalized experiences across Bask Health.
  • Build recommendation systems for approved platform content and user experiences.
  • Develop ranking algorithms that improve the relevance of information presented to users.
  • Implement personalization models using behavioral, contextual, and preference-related signals.
  • Build feature engineering pipelines that transform application data into model-ready inputs.
  • Develop systems for representing user preferences and interaction patterns.
  • Implement personalized content ordering and discovery capabilities within approved workflows.
  • Build backend services and APIs that deliver personalization results to applications.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to integrate personalization into user-facing experiences.
  • Develop baseline models and compare them against more advanced personalization approaches.
  • Experiment with collaborative filtering, content-based recommendation, and learning-to-rank methods.
  • Implement model training, validation, and evaluation workflows.
  • Develop offline evaluation methods for recommendation and ranking quality.
  • Support online experimentation and A/B testing for personalization features.
  • Analyze engagement and interaction data to identify opportunities for model improvements.
  • Monitor production model performance, latency, and reliability.
  • Investigate changes in recommendation quality and unexpected model behavior.
  • Develop strategies for handling sparse data and new-user cold-start scenarios.
  • Implement appropriate fallbacks when personalization signals are unavailable.
  • Optimize model inference speed and resource usage.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to support scalable model serving.
  • Work with product managers to define personalization goals and success metrics.
  • Evaluate model performance across relevant user groups and application contexts.
  • Implement privacy-conscious data processing and feature access controls.
  • Ensure personalization features respect tenant boundaries and approved platform permissions.
  • Document model assumptions, evaluation results, and known limitations.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.
  • Own assigned personalization features from model development through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, applied machine learning, software engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python or comparable machine learning development languages.
  • Understanding of recommendation systems, ranking models, or predictive modeling.
  • Experience working with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
  • Familiarity with supervised learning and common model evaluation techniques.
  • Experience developing data processing and feature engineering pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SQL and structured application data.
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis and experimental design.
  • Experience integrating machine learning models into production applications.
  • Understanding of backend services and API development.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based machine learning deployment.
  • Experience evaluating model quality using appropriate offline metrics.
  • Understanding of model overfitting, data leakage, and generalization.
  • Familiarity with model training, validation, and testing workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting machine learning performance issues.
  • Understanding of data quality and feature reliability.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring and production observability.
  • Experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure data handling.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into machine learning solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, data specialists, and software engineers.
  • Ability to independently own machine learning projects from development through deployment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building recommendation systems for e-commerce or SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with collaborative filtering and content-based recommendation algorithms.
  • Experience with learning-to-rank techniques and ranking optimization.
  • Understanding of embeddings and vector similarity methods.
  • Experience building personalized search or content discovery features.
  • Familiarity with user behavior modeling and preference prediction.
  • Experience developing real-time personalization systems.
  • Understanding of contextual bandits or reinforcement learning approaches to recommendations.
  • Experience with A/B testing and online experimentation platforms.
  • Familiarity with recommendation metrics such as NDCG, MAP, precision@k, and recall@k.
  • Experience working with sparse interaction data and cold-start problems.
  • Familiarity with feature stores and machine learning data pipelines.
  • Experience with AWS SageMaker or comparable ML platform services.
  • Experience building low-latency model inference services.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js backend development.
  • Experience with React or Next.js application integrations.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Experience applying personalization in healthcare-related software while respecting clinical boundaries.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

This is an exciting opportunity to help protect, secure, and modernize the Army's global enterprise network, ensuring critical military communications remain reliable and mission-ready.

In this remote role, you'll focus on identifying, analyzing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across enterprise network devices. You'll work with network engineers, cybersecurity teams, and mission partners to implement security patches, configuration updates, and risk mitigation solutions.

What You'll Do

Preferred Qualifications

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to apply your network engineering and cybersecurity expertise to a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's global operations.

O que vamos construir juntos?

Nosso time é guiado por excelência técnica, mindset ágil e cultura de colaboração. Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece a inovação e queremos pessoas curiosas, comprometidas e em constante evolução.

Você atuará em um time de referência em tecnologia, participando de testes de segurança e exercícios de Red Team, contribuindo para transformar descobertas técnicas em melhorias concretas de segurança nos produtos e infraestrutura da empresa.

Nos ajude a desenhar a solução!

  • Conduzir testes completos de segurança em aplicações Web, APIs, Mobile e Infraestrutura;
  • Liderar exercícios de Red Team simulando TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos) de ameaças relevantes ao negócio;
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e técnicos orientados ao negócio, adaptando linguagem e nível de detalhe conforme o interlocutor;
  • Colaborar consultivamente com o times de Produto e Blue Team para fortalecer mitigações e a capacidade de detecção e resposta;
  • Propor melhorias nas metodologias de testex, automatizando tarefas e contribuindo para a maturidade técnica do time;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas e disseminando conhecimento sobre ameaças emergentes e novas técnicas.

É esperado que você tenha:

  • Sólida experiência em testes de penetração em ambientes reais: Web, APIs REST/GraphQL, Mobile iOS/Android e infraestruturas on-premises/cloud;
  • Domínio de frameworks e metodologias: OWASP TOP 10, OWASP MASTG, PTES, NIST SP 800-115 e MITRE ATT
  • Profundo conhecimento em Linux e Windows, redes (protocolos, firewalls, ZTNAs, VPNs), autenticação e autorização, ambientes de plataforma de engenharia e defesa em camadas;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts e ferramentas em Python, Go, Shell Script ou similares;
  • Comunicação clara para traduzir riscos técnicos em linguagem de negócio para diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Autonomia na gestão de demandas com clareza sobre prioridades, riscos e acordos;
  • Adaptabilidade para transitar entre contextos distintos e aprender continuamente em um cenário de ameaças em evolução;
  • Rigor ético no trato com informações sensíveis e resultados de testes, dentro e fora da organização;
  • Compartilhamento proativo de conhecimento, abertura para feedback e postura construtiva em revisões técnicas.

Será legal se você tiver:

  • Certificações: OSCP, OSWE, OSED, CPTS, CPENT, eMAPT, eWPTX ou equivalentes;
  • Experiência com code review orientado à segurança (Java, , Python, Go, Shell Script);
  • Produção de conteúdo técnico: blogs, whitepapers, writeups de CTF ou palestras em eventos como H2HC, ROADSEC, DEF CON, BSides;
  • Participação ativa na comunidade: CTFs, Hack The Box, TryHackMe, bug bounty ou contribuições open source voltadas à segurança.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer - Next.js & Python
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer – Next.js & Python

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build and maintain production web applications across a modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud stack.

This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

Frontend Development

  • Build production web applications using Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, and strict TypeScript.
  • Work with server/client boundaries and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
  • Build interfaces using Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui + Radix, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, and AG Grid Enterprise.
  • Work with Framer Motion and Socket.IO.
  • Write frontend tests using Vitest + Testing Library.
  • Build end-to-end tests using Playwright.

Backend Development

  • Build and maintain backend services using Python 3.13 and FastAPI.
  • Work with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel, Alembic, Celery, Redis, and uv.
  • Work with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
  • Work within a multi-service codebase using HTTP between services, Redis, and workers.

Database & Data

  • Work with relational modeling and migrations using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.
  • Work with Azure SQL (MSSQL) and PostgreSQL.
  • Work with Neo4j for family / heirship graphs.
  • Work with PostgreSQL + pgvector.
  • Work with MongoDB for logs.

Cloud & Operations

  • Work with Azure services including Blob, Identity, Key Vault, SQL, and Container Registry.
  • Work with Docker Compose.
  • Work with Prometheus / Grafana.
  • Work with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.

Advanced Features & Integrations

  • Work with graph databases or non-trivial graph UIs such as trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.
  • Work with complex data UIs including AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, and rich text using Tiptap.
  • Work with real-time technologies such as Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony platforms such as Telnyx or similar.
  • Work with LLM/RAG features including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.
  • Work with chatbot services; you do not need to be an ML engineer.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years shipping production web apps.
  • 3+ years as the person who owns a slice across UI and API.
  • Strong TypeScript and React experience.
  • Comfortable with App Router, server/client boundaries, and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
  • Strong Python and FastAPI experience, or Django/Flask at a similar depth.
  • Experience with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
  • Strong relational modeling and migration experience using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.
  • Experience with MSSQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience in a multi-service codebase with HTTP between services, Redis, and workers, not only a single monolith.
  • Tests as a habit: unit/integration on the backend and component tests on the frontend.
  • Clear written communication.
  • Ability to leave the next engineer a module they can change without a walkthrough.

Strongly Preferred

  • Graph databases such as Neo4j or non-trivial graph UI using trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.
  • Azure experience with SQL, Blob, Key Vault, or a comparable cloud.
  • Experience with complex data UIs such as AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, or rich text using Tiptap.
  • Real-time experience with Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony with Telnyx or similar.
  • LLM/RAG experience including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.

Nice-to-Haves We Actually Use

  • WebRTC calling.
  • DocuSign / PKCS#7 signing.
  • GEDCOM.
  • Google Maps.
  • Campaign/inbox graph models.
  • Prometheus metrics.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have extensive experience shipping production web applications and owning a slice across both UI and API.
  • You’re comfortable working across TypeScript/React and Python/FastAPI.
  • You can confidently reason about relational modeling, migrations, and multi-service architecture.
  • You’re comfortable working with Redis, workers, and HTTP communication between services.
  • You treat testing as part of development rather than something to add later.
  • You communicate clearly in writing.
  • You leave the next engineer with a module they can change without a walkthrough.

What Success Looks Like

  • You can independently own a slice of the product across UI and API.
  • Production features are supported by appropriate backend and frontend tests.
  • Relational models and migrations are reliable and maintainable.
  • Multi-service communication, Redis, and workers operate effectively.
  • Complex data UIs and graph-based functionality are implemented effectively where required.
  • Real-time, cloud, and third-party integrations work reliably.
  • Your code is clear enough for the next engineer to understand and modify without a walkthrough.

Tech Stack

Frontend

  • Next.js 16 (App Router)
  • React 19
  • TypeScript (strict)

  • shadcn/ui + Radix
  • TanStack Query
  • Zustand
  • React Hook Form + Zod
  • AG Grid Enterprise
  • Framer Motion
  • Socket.IO
  • Vitest + Testing Library
  • Playwright

Backend

  • Python 3.13
  • FastAPI
  • Pydantic v2
  • SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel
  • Alembic
  • Celery
  • Redis
  • uv

Data

Cloud & Operations

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - AI Developer Productivity (Dev Agents and
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

AI is changing how our R&D organization builds and runs software. This is a new role: one leader for Samsara's AI bets across the software development lifecycle. You'll own two efforts that started and whatever comes next.

Dev Agents builds in-house and integrates vendors such as Claude and Codex. That includes an Agent Gateway that serves internal MCPs, managed access to skills, and cloud runners that fan work out to cloud agents.

SRE AI is an agent that does the first-line work of an on-call engineer. It already runs on real incidents in production: it writes a root cause analysis, escalates severity when it has proof, and can roll back the deployment it identified as the cause.

This is a new role. You'll lead a team of five to 10 senior engineers, from Senior to Staff. You'll work directly with every R&D leader and with the developers who use what you build.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in North America.

What makes this unique

  • One leader across the lifecycle. You own AI for the whole software development lifecycle, for our R&D organization.
  • Room to try things. Try, fail, learn. One bet in five landing is a good outcome.
  • Already in production. SRE AI runs on live incidents today, and two teams use it as first responder.
  • A senior team. Principal, senior staff, staff and senior engineers who work without a roadmap.
  • Build, don't hand off. This is hands-on leadership. You'll work from the details, not from a PRD.

Why this role matters

Real-world impact at scale

  • Engineers on every team take turns on-call, which costs roughly 10 to 15 percent of headcount. The goal is an agent that is first responder to every page, so people are only woken up when a human is needed, and arrive with the root cause in hand.
  • Make SRE AI first responder for five teams, and the default for every team by the end of 2027.
  • Within 12 months, the median developer ships as fast as today's 90th percentile.

Unique technical challenges

  • Choose which experiments to run for a root cause analysis agent when no playbook exists.
  • Decide when to build, integrate or buy as model prices and capabilities shift roughly every quarter.
  • Earn trust for automated actions, such as severity escalation and rollbacks.
  • Raise output without raising load on engineers, with cost per pull request (token spend plus infrastructure) as the measure.
  • Be on the founding team of AI agent factories: Within three months, stand up an end-to-end system for campaign-style work: backfilling tests, fixing recurring logging problems, and drive changes, etc.

You should apply if:

  • You want to own an AI bet at scale. You'd like one leader's view across how an entire R&D organization builds, ships and runs software.
  • You build to learn. You'd rather try the latest technology than read about it, and you can say what failed.
  • You like working without a roadmap. You set direction yourself, and you move when nobody has told you to.
  • You lead senior engineers by earning their trust. Principal and staff engineers follow you because you're in the details with them.
  • You care what things cost. Tokens and infrastructure are part of the design, not an afterthought.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Dev Agents and SRE AI, and decide what comes next.
  • Set direction and choose the experiments for agent infrastructure: the gateway, internal MCPs, skills and cloud runners.
  • Make build, integrate and buy calls across vendors such as Claude and Codex as models change.
  • Drive cost per pull request down while output goes up.
  • Take SRE AI from two teams to every team, and build the trust that lets it take more automated actions.
  • Work directly with every R&D leader and with the developers who use what you build, without a product manager.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Manage and grow a team of five to 10 senior engineers, from senior to principal, setting a high bar and clear priorities without a roadmap.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role

Experience:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of people management experience.
  • Has led a team of about six to 10 engineers. Scope matters more than title.
  • Has led senior and staff-level engineers.
  • Has built something with current AI tools or agents, at work or at home.
  • Has set direction where no playbook existed, without a product manager.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or another technical degree.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A methodical, systems-level mind. You work through problems nobody has solved, with a clear view of which experiments to run.
  • A connection to what industry leaders build. You follow it closely and apply it.
  • Relevant background. Developer productivity, agentic AI, incident response or on-call tooling.
  • Cost awareness. You can reason about token spend and infrastructure as models and prices change.
  • An advanced degree. MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

What makes Samsara different:

  • Mission-driven impact. We improve safety, efficiency and sustainability for the industries that power the global economy.
  • A unique data advantage. IoT data at a scale few companies can match: 10+ trillion data points a year.
  • Fast decisions, limited bureaucracy. Work directly with senior leadership and ship solutions that matter.
  • Growth and learning. Work alongside talented engineers, scientists and operators. We invest heavily in R&D and in building for the long term.
  • Scale with startup energy. A public company (NYSE: IOT) with the resources and reach of scale, and the agility and pace of a high-growth technology company.

See Samsara in action

If you like, we would like to invite you to spend ten minutes getting to know us.

  • A quick video introducing our business (click herefor the Youtube Video).
  • 2026 Agent Studio reveal at Beyond, our annual customer event (click here for the Youtube Video and fast forward to 59:36)

Ready to lead AI across the software development lifecycle?

We would love to hear from you.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Accommodations

jobs.title: Implementation Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About Empower Community Care

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

Position Summary

The Implementation Support Specialist provides cross-model implementation, operational, and customer success support for Functional Family Therapy (FFT), Multisystemic Therapy (MST), and Brief Strategic Family Therapy (BSFT). This position leads assigned provider organizations through onboarding and launch and continues to provide support alongside clinical model staff to ensure sustainability, fidelity, and customer success.
The Specialist coordinates implementation plans, workforce and referral readiness, technical assistance, project milestones, program monitoring, and partner relationships. The position works collaboratively with EBP model teams, which retain responsibility for model-specific clinical consultation, fidelity coaching, certification, and clinical decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding and Launch

  • Provider Onboarding: Lead assigned providers through onboarding, workforce readiness, launch preparation, and early operations for FFT, MST, and BSFT.
  • Planning and Project Management: Develop and maintain implementation roadmaps, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and launch-readiness documentation, and coordinate project management and technical assistance to keep launches on time, in scope, and responsive to emerging barriers.
  • Workforce Planning: Collaborate with recruiting and provider leadership to support staffing plans, candidate sourcing needs, role readiness, and workforce preparation for launch.
  • Readiness Assessment: Assess readiness related to leadership, staffing, training, service capacity, operational infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Referral and Access: Design and strengthen referral and access processes so appropriate populations can reach available program capacity.
  • Organizational Change: Support operational and organizational change required to adopt new practices and reduce implementation drift.
  • Launch Coordination: Coordinate launch logistics with EBP clinical technical assistance teams while maintaining clear boundaries between operational implementation support and model-specific clinical responsibilities.
  • Documentation and Escalation: Document decisions, risks, action items, and progress; promptly elevate barriers requiring leadership or model-specific expertise.

Sustainability and Customer Success

  • Partner Relationships: Maintain ongoing relationships with assigned provider organizations through proactive check-ins, account health monitoring, responsive support, and escalation management.
  • Program Monitoring: Monitor staffing stability, referrals, caseloads, utilization, access, financial sustainability, fidelity indicators, outcomes, and other applicable measures, and identify early warning signals related to vacancies, turnover, capacity, referral volume, access barriers, reimbursement, budget pressures, or renewal risk.
  • Risk Response: Lead the operational response to implementation risks and coordinate joint problem-solving with EBP clinical leadership when clinical or fidelity action is required, including workforce retention, referral pathway troubleshooting, implementation improvement plans, and other actions that strengthen program viability.
  • Renewal and Expansion: Coordinate renewal and expansion support, identify opportunities to connect partners with other appropriate organizational offerings, and promote partner satisfaction, retention, high-quality service delivery, and long-term program sustainability.
  • Reporting and Records: Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates that communicate implementation progress, account health, risks, and outcomes; maintain accurate records and provide regular updates to the Director of EBP Implementation.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Relationships: Build collaborative relationships with provider leaders, supervisors, clinicians, funders, referral sources, and community stakeholders while maintaining clear expectations and shared accountability.
  • Facilitation and Training: Facilitate provider and stakeholder training and/or meetings, including provider implementation training on best practices, timelines, and expectations for successful implementation, with agenda development, documentation, decision-making, and follow-up.
  • Data-Informed Decisions: Use data to guide implementation decisions, monitor readiness and program health, and support continuous quality improvement.
  • Portfolio Management: Manage multiple programs, priorities, deadlines, and special projects across the EBP portfolio, and participate in EBP initiatives as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health, social work, psychology, public health, human services, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience: At least three (3) years of relevant experience in program implementation, project management, provider support, customer success, behavioral health, or human services, including demonstrated experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, monitoring program performance, and supporting implementation from launch through sustainability.
  • Core Skills: Strong implementation, project coordination, organization, and time-management skills; excellent written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Change and Data Skills: Ability to support organizational change, resolve operational barriers, and maintain accountability through a collaborative approach; ability to interpret program and account-health data, identify risks, and translate findings into action.
  • Judgment and Independence: Sound judgment regarding when to act directly and when to engage clinical, model-specific, funding, recruiting, or leadership partners; ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide reliable follow-through.
  • Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Work Requirements: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, reside in the United States, work Eastern Time business hours, and be able to travel up to 50% of the time.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in one of the fields above or a related field.
  • EBP Experience: Experience with evidence-based or evidence-informed programs, including FFT, MST, BSFT, or another structured evidence-based practice.
  • Subject Knowledge: Knowledge of evidence-based practices, behavioral health, human services, customer success, or implementation science.

Additional Requirements

  • Background Check: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices.
  • Confidentiality: This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
  • Work Environment: This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 50% of the time for in-person provider onboarding, meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
  • Other Duties: This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: Director of MEP Project Management
jobs.description:
The Director of MEP Project Management (Logistics) is responsible for leading the end-to-end management of OFCI Mechanical and/or Electrical Equipment procurement and logistics activities across multiple projects or large-scale strategic programs. This role serves as a subject matter expert and senior leader within the MEP Procurement & Logistics organization, providing strategic oversight of vendor performance, project execution, risk management, budgeting, scheduling, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement initiatives. In addition to managing project portfolios, the Director of MEP Project Management (Logistics) is responsible for the direct leadership, development, and performance management of Logistics Project Managers and Assistant Logistics Project Managers. This includes assigning workloads, establishing priorities, mentoring team members, driving accountability, supporting professional development, and ensuring consistent execution of logistics and project management best practices across all projects. The Director of MEP Project Management (Logistics) drives successful project outcomes by ensuring equipment is delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual, technical, and operational requirements. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
SmartWorks, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager who will join their team.

The Project Manager is responsible for driving customer projects forward to achieve milestones and manage project scope while ensuring a high degree of customer satisfaction. The Project Manager is responsible for managing project resource assignments, project profitability, timely realization of revenue and ensuring that both they and consultants maintain an expected level of billable utilization. Finally, The Project Manager will work closely with Project Management Office (PMO) Manager on improving the consistency, predictability and efficiency of the organization project delivery capability.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 25%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.

Salary:

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Work closely with the Customer Project Manager to ensure successful completion of the software implementation project.
  • Develop, negotiate and finalize Statements of Work to ensure the most efficient delivery of SmartWorks solutions for new and existing customers.
  • Consistently manage client expectations and ensure delivery of highest quality service.
  • Oversee execution of the multiple solution implementation work streams; and at times run parts of the execution.
  • Run client kick-off, customer functionality workshops and regular status update meetings.
  • Create project deliverables, including acceptance criteria, training plan, testing plan, change requests.
  • Provide mentoring to team members and contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of the Project Management Methodology.
  • Conduct post implementation reviews to identify and measure results. Capture and apply lessons learned for continuous process improvement.
  • Responsible for reporting project forecast and financials to senior management on an ongoing basis.
  • Perform project administration such as approval or routing of expenses, project timesheet review, Project updates and invoice processing.
  • Interface with other departments and with third party vendors.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of direct Project Management experience.
  • Experience with the management of risk, change, issues, time, scope, resources, budget, and quality.
  • In depth understanding of all major activities for a system implementation such as analysis, design, development and deployment.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to motivate a team.
  • Assertive and outgoing you have the natural ability to get things done.
  • Knowledge of project management tools and software packages similar to MS Project and Clarizen.
  • Experience with a formal project management methodology.
  • Ability to travel in North America up to 25% of the year is desired.
  • Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Know that a positive attitude is a must.

What would make you stand out:

  • College diploma or University degree in a related technical field.
  • Previous experience in the Utilities industry.
  • Can work independently, but most importantly, as a team player.
  • PMP certification is nice to have.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About SmartWorks:

SmartWorks is a division of N. Harris Computer Corporation. For over a decade, SmartWorks has been providing best-in-class meter data management and analytics software solutions to more than 300 utilities throughout N. America.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and contribute to the software that powers our telehealth platform.

This internship is designed for students and early-career developers who enjoy building software, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into working product features.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers on clearly defined projects across our platform. Depending on the team's priorities, your work may involve merchant-facing tools, patient experiences, internal applications, frontend development, or backend functionality.

You'll receive technical guidance, participate in the engineering development process, and gain practical experience building and improving production software.

We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive, willing to ask questions, and excited to develop their skills while contributing meaningful work.

jobs.title: AI Development Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Development Engineer who is passionate about solving complex engineering problems and using AI to improve the speed, quality, and cost efficiency of software development.

The role involves rethinking the traditional approach to software engineering — moving from coding and implementation-heavy workflows to solution orchestration, structured thinking, detailed specifications, system design, and validation.

You will work on building intelligent, agentic applications that combine AI capabilities with traditional engineering systems. The focus is on using AI effectively while ensuring that the solutions we build remain reliable, secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities

Requirement Clarity and Engineering Design

  • Develop a deep understanding of technical requirements and system-level design to minimise rework and reduce the risk of AI-generated errors.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business ideas into clear, structured technical specifications.
  • Create specifications that serve as a reliable source of truth for both engineering teams and AI systems.

Engineering Excellence

  • Establish practices to minimise functional defects and operational issues caused by AI-generated code.
  • Identify and eliminate code bloat, redundant logic, dead code, and unnecessary complexity.
  • Ensure AI-generated code remains understandable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to navigate.
  • Build the right documentation and engineering artefacts so that AI-generated code does not become a black box.
  • Incorporate security best practices into prompts, context, and code-generation workflows.

Agentic Applications

  • Build, maintain, and scale production systems that leverage Generative AI to transform user experiences.
  • Design and monitor agentic workflows where AI components interact with traditional microservices to solve complex business problems.
  • Explore and implement ways to move from manual workflows to intelligent, agent-driven applications.

Operational Excellence

  • Focus on rigorous validation as AI accelerates development and output.
  • Ensure automated outputs meet high standards of security, performance, reliability, and intended functionality.
  • Build deep observability into services and systems to identify and address production issues.
  • Explore self-healing production workflows where AI can interpret logs, identify issues, and suggest real-time fixes.

Cost Efficiency

  • Optimise inference costs through effective prompt engineering, model selection, tool usage, and workflow design.
  • Balance model performance, token consumption, and overall business ROI.
  • Identify and reduce technical debt caused by AI-generated code and redundant implementations before they affect system performance or cloud costs.

Organisational Leadership and Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Production Engineering, Security, and other stakeholders to align AI capabilities with business goals and responsible AI practices.
  • Encourage a culture where engineers can experiment with new AI workflows, learn from failures, and continuously improve.
  • Mentor junior engineers and help drive the shift from traditional coding practices towards AI-assisted engineering and system orchestration.

Requirements

  • Strong foundations in Machine Learning and AI, including linear algebra, probability and statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, and standard MLP/DNN architectures.
  • Understanding of bias-variance trade-offs, model fitting and selection, hyperparameter tuning, and model performance evaluation.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience and working knowledge of Generative AI foundation models and LLM building blocks, including:
    • Transformers for vision and text
    • Tokenisation and attention mechanisms
    • Prompting techniques
    • Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) concepts
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Hands-on experience with prominent ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face.
  • Experience building or working on AI applications across one or more domains, including text, vision, speech, audio, and video.
  • Ability to understand complex engineering requirements and translate them into structured specifications, implementation plans, and validation workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in exploring how AI can improve engineering workflows and application development.

Benefits

  • Proximity Talks: Meet and learn from designers, engineers, product leaders, and AI practitioners.
  • Continuous learning: Work with a world-class team and stay close to the latest in AI, engineering, and product development.
  • High-impact work: Build AI-first systems and products used at scale by global clients.

Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media and Entertainment companies in the world! We’re headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore. Since 2019, Proximity has created and grown high-impact, scalable products used by 370 million daily users, with a total net worth of $45.7 billion among our client companies.

Accounting & Reconciliation

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.

Remote & Availability Requirements

You’ll report to the CPO and own product and design end to end: strategy, roadmap, team and execution. You’ll be hands-on, setting direction, making calls and shipping, while you build the team around you.

What Success Looks Like

  • You know BusRight’s users, market and product deeply.
  • The product strategy is sharper and clearer, built on what exists and backed by evidence.
  • You’ve shipped bets you owned from framing through delivery, and they moved customer and business outcomes.
  • Product drives BusRight. The right team is in place, and every function builds from its direction.
  • Customer value is measured and reported across BusRight’s products and services, and that evidence drives roadmap and commercial decisions.
  • The CPO, CEO and Engineering treat you as a trusted thought partner on where the product goes next.

What You Will Do

  • Work with the founders to define and pressure-test where BusRight wins.
  • Translate strategy into a living roadmap where every priority and commitment is tied to the value it delivers.
  • Own the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and outcome measurement.
  • Own product analytics, defining how BusRight measures adoption and usage and partnering with CS and Commercial to put those measures to work.
  • Report on the value customers get from BusRight’s products and services, and use it to guide roadmap and commercial decisions.

  • Represent product in board conversations, partner discussions, and recruiting
  • Hire, develop and retain a world-class product and design team as we scale.
  • Hold the product team to a high bar of rigor, craft and accountability to outcomes, not output.

  • Leadership experience: 3–5 years in product leadership, with meaningful time at early-stage or high-growth companies.

jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.description:
Web Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own

Visual Design & Prototyping

  • Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
  • Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

Responsive Web Design

  • Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

Design System Maintenance

  • Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
  • Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
  • Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

  • Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
  • Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

Feedback & Iteration

  • Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
  • Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
  • Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
  • Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
  • Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
  • Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own AI-driven short-form video creative for a well-established clinical skincare brand with a strong presence across Southeast Asia. Sometimes the starting point will be a vague concept, and you will turn that into a finished video too.

This role sits closer to a creative director or creative manager who also makes the work than to a pure editor. The brand team is short on capacity, which is why they are hiring overseas, so they need someone self-sufficient who does not need babysitting. You will study the brand's website and Instagram on your own, pick up its look and voice quickly, and get it right the first time. Constant rework costs time and AI generation credits, so a fast read on the brand matters. If you are fluent in AI video editing, have the tools you need, and can take a loose idea to a polished, on-brand video without hand-holding, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • Work on content for a globally recognized skincare brand with an active and growing Southeast Asian social media presence
  • High-ownership creative role with real autonomy over concept, storyboard, and finished output

What You'll Work On

Creative Direction and Storyboarding

  • Start from a script or outline for each video and develop it into a clear concept and storyboard
  • Take a vague video concept and turn it into a finished video without waiting for detailed direction
  • Storyboard from the brand's product and video catalog so every video is grounded in real products and existing brand assets
  • Study the brand's website and Instagram on your own to understand its look, tone, and audience, and apply it correctly the first time

AI Video Production

  • Produce AI-driven short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other platforms in the style beauty and skincare brands are publishing now, matched to the brand's look
  • Use AI video and image tools fluently across ideation, generation, editing, and finishing
  • Cut, reformat, and enhance assets into finished, platform-ready content with motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design
  • Produce approximately 100 finished videos per month consistently and on schedule
  • Do not use AI to generate human faces, skin, or realistic human imagery of any kind; all human and skin visuals must come from brand-provided assets

Quality, Efficiency, and Self-Management

  • Get the brand right the first time to avoid constant rework that burns time and AI generation credits
  • Work with your own AI tools and platforms and keep your workflow current as new tools emerge
  • Run your own projects with minimal supervision and flag asset gaps or brief issues early
  • Organize files and deliver finished videos in the correct formats for each platform

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Fluency in AI video editing and generation tools, with a portfolio of AI-driven short-form content
  • Proven ability to take a vague concept and turn it into a finished, on-brand video
  • Creative direction instincts including concepting, storyboarding, and the taste to make confident creative decisions
  • Ability to study a brand's website and social presence and quickly absorb its look and voice
  • Self-sufficiency: you need little training and do not need babysitting
  • Your own AI tools and platforms, ready to use from day one
  • Strong short-form editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar platforms
  • Understanding of the limits on AI use, including no AI-generated human faces or skin
  • Speed and efficiency at high volume without sacrificing quality
  • Organized and reliable with consistent on-time delivery
  • Available to work during Southeast Asia business hours

Nice to Have

  • Beauty, premium skincare, or makeup experience, since those candidates tend to know how to tell the story
  • Experience creating AI content for beauty or consumer lifestyle brands
  • Mandarin language skills for supporting Chinese-language content production
  • Familiarity with Southeast Asian social media audiences and platform trends
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic animation for social media content
  • Background producing content for Instagram Reels or TikTok at scale

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 finished AI-driven short-form videos, ideally in a beauty or premium consumer style
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your AI video workflow and tools, and walking through one video you took from a vague concept to a finished piece, including your storyboard and creative decisions

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short homework assignment: take a loosely defined video concept and turn it into a finished video.

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a self-sufficient creative who can turn a loose idea into an on-brand AI video without hand-holding, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.
