jobs.title: Senior Patient Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, the patient experience is an important part of how telehealth businesses operate. We value thoughtful communication, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and people who can help patients navigate administrative and technical challenges while respecting the responsibilities of licensed healthcare professionals.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Patient Experience Specialist to help deliver a clear, responsive, and supportive experience for patients using telehealth services powered by Bask Health.

This role focuses on patient communication, administrative assistance, service-related troubleshooting, and coordinating the resolution of complex patient experience issues.

You'll help patients navigate supported platform workflows and understand the next steps in their service experience.

Our platform supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses by connecting patient experiences, online questionnaires, checkout processes, clinical workflows, and pharmacy-related operations.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how these workflows connect and where patients may encounter confusion, delays, or technical difficulties.

You'll respond to patient questions through approved communication channels and provide accurate information within established support guidelines.

You'll assist patients with nonclinical questions related to account access, platform navigation, questionnaire completion, checkout processes, and administrative status updates.

You'll help patients understand what information they need to provide and where they can find relevant instructions.

You'll investigate reported platform difficulties and work with internal teams to identify appropriate next steps.

As a senior member of the patient experience function, you'll take ownership of more complex service cases that require additional coordination or careful communication.

You'll help resolve situations involving multiple teams, unclear responsibilities, or repeated patient contacts.

You'll be expected to remain organized and communicate clearly when patients are frustrated or uncertain about what happens next.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams when patients encounter software errors or difficulties completing supported platform workflows.

You'll work with authorized clinical or pharmacy stakeholders when a case involves medical, prescription, medication, or dispensing-related questions.

You'll understand that patient experience specialists do not provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, determine treatment eligibility, or independently resolve prescription-related clinical concerns.

You'll follow established procedures for escalating safety concerns, urgent clinical questions, and other matters outside the patient support team's scope.

You'll provide administrative updates only when the information is verified and appropriate to share.

You'll maintain accurate records of patient communications, reported issues, actions taken, and follow-up commitments.

You'll use approved systems and follow internal privacy and security procedures when handling patient information.

You'll help identify recurring patient questions, common points of confusion, and workflow challenges that affect the overall experience.

You'll share those findings with customer success, product, technical support, and operations teams.

You'll contribute to improvements in patient-facing instructions, support resources, and communication templates.

You'll help develop clear responses to frequently asked questions and identify where additional guidance may reduce unnecessary support contacts.

You'll support quality improvement efforts by reviewing common service issues and recommending practical changes to support processes.

You'll assist with identifying cases that require escalation because of repeated delays, unresolved technical problems, or communication breakdowns.

You'll coordinate follow-up activity so patients receive consistent information and understand the status of their administrative requests.

You'll help establish consistent standards for case documentation, escalation, and communication quality.

You'll also support the training and guidance of less-experienced patient support team members when appropriate.

You'll be expected to demonstrate sound judgment when deciding whether an issue can be resolved through standard support procedures or requires specialist involvement.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders while maintaining clear boundaries between administrative support and licensed healthcare responsibilities.

You'll contribute to a patient experience that is organized, respectful, and responsive without making promises about medical outcomes, prescriptions, treatment timelines, or pharmacy fulfillment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for complex patient experience cases and support process improvement.

It is not a licensed clinical position, pharmacy position, or formal people-management role.

We're looking for someone with strong customer or patient support experience, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.

Experience supporting healthcare-related services, digital health platforms, or other complex service environments is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable working with multiple systems, managing detailed case records, and coordinating across teams.

Success in this role means helping patients receive accurate administrative support, reducing avoidable confusion, improving issue resolution, and identifying opportunities to strengthen the overall service experience.

What You'll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative and technical support to patients through approved communication channels.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex patient experience cases.
  • Help patients navigate supported telehealth platform workflows.
  • Assist with account access, platform navigation, and general usability questions.
  • Support patients experiencing difficulties with online questionnaires.
  • Help investigate checkout and other nonclinical platform-related issues.
  • Provide accurate administrative status information when authorized and available.
  • Identify when patient questions require clinical, pharmacy, or specialist involvement.
  • Escalate medical and treatment-related questions to authorized healthcare professionals.
  • Route prescription and dispensing concerns to the appropriate authorized teams.
  • Follow established procedures for urgent or safety-related concerns.
  • Coordinate with technical support teams on patient-facing software issues.
  • Work with operations stakeholders to resolve administrative service challenges.
  • Take ownership of assigned complex cases and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with patients experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Maintain accurate records of patient communications and support actions.
  • Follow privacy and security procedures when handling sensitive patient information.
  • Use approved support systems to track cases and escalation activity.
  • Identify recurring patient questions and sources of confusion.
  • Recommend improvements to patient-facing instructions and help resources.
  • Assist with developing and updating support communication templates.
  • Support quality reviews of patient experience interactions.
  • Help improve case documentation and escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate internal follow-ups to reduce repeated or unresolved patient contacts.
  • Track recurring service issues and share findings with relevant teams.
  • Collaborate with product teams on patient-facing usability concerns.
  • Work with customer success teams when patient experience issues affect merchant operations.
  • Help develop internal patient support knowledge resources.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced support specialists when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service consistency and communication quality.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between administrative support and clinical responsibilities.
  • Take ownership of patient experience issues through appropriate resolution or handoff.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, patient experience, healthcare administration, customer service, or a closely related service role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer or patient support cases.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with people experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Experience resolving service-related issues through established support processes.
  • Ability to identify when a case requires escalation to another team.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience maintaining accurate customer or patient case records.
  • Ability to manage multiple active cases and follow-up commitments.
  • Experience using customer support, ticketing, or case management systems.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating software platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic account access and platform navigation issues.
  • Strong judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.
  • Understanding of the importance of patient privacy and appropriate data handling.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures and communication guidelines.
  • Ability to distinguish administrative support from clinical decision-making.
  • Willingness to escalate medical, prescription, and pharmacy-related concerns to authorized professionals.
  • Ability to communicate accurate information without making unsupported promises.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple internal teams.
  • Ability to document recurring problems and recommend process improvements.
  • Comfortable handling challenging conversations professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Commitment to consistent service quality and appropriate follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • Background supporting patients through online healthcare services.
  • Experience working in healthcare customer service or patient coordination.
  • Familiarity with patient intake and online questionnaire workflows.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based healthcare services.
  • Familiarity with customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or similar tools.
  • Experience handling escalated or high-priority service cases.
  • Experience developing patient support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare privacy considerations.
  • Experience coordinating with clinical or pharmacy operations teams.
  • Experience supporting online checkout or payment-related administrative issues.
  • Experience working with customer success or technical support teams.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance reviews for customer support interactions.
  • Experience tracking support metrics and recurring service issues.
  • Experience improving escalation workflows or case management processes.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior support specialists.
  • Familiarity with patient experience improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working in a fast-changing SaaS or healthcare services environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse patient populations.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to reduce repeat support contacts.

Job Title: Junior Customer Success Administrator

Location:Remote

The Role:

At CyberOne, Customer Success plays an important role in ensuring our customers receive a professional, consistent and well-supported experience across their managed services.

As a Junior Customer Success Executive, you will support the Customer Success team with day-to-day customer and partner communications, service reporting, service review preparation and general customer administration. This is a junior role suited to someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and confident communicating with customers in a professional manner.

You will work closely with the wider Customer Success, Operations and Service Delivery teams to help ensure customer and partner updates are clear, service reports are accurate, and actions from service reviews are tracked and followed through.

This role is remotely based and would suit someone looking to develop their career in customer success, service delivery or account support within the cyber security and managed services sector.

Service Reporting

Service Reviews

Customer Administration & Coordination

  • Support the creation and updating of welcome packs, service schedules, customer information documents and other standard materials.

  • Help coordinate customer/partner requests across internal teams, ensuring visibility and follow-up.

jobs.title: VP Sales, Europe
jobs.description:
VP Sales Europe

Based out of the UK.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

  • Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

  • Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

  • Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

  • Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

  • Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

  • Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

  • A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

  • Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

  • The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

  • Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

  • A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

  • Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

  • Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

  • 12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

Our platform brings together merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

As a Product Marketing Intern, you'll help our team communicate what Bask Health's products do, how they work, and why they're valuable to customers.

You'll work with product marketing and collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, sales, customer success, and other internal stakeholders.

A major part of this internship will involve learning about our platform and helping turn product information into clear, useful marketing materials.

You'll support the development of feature descriptions, product overviews, presentations, launch announcements, and customer education resources.

You'll help research the businesses that use Bask Health, including entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, healthcare providers, and organizations building direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

You'll learn how customers evaluate software products, which problems influence their decisions, and how product marketing communicates value.

You'll conduct competitive research on SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology platforms.

You'll help identify how competitors describe their products, which capabilities they emphasize, and how they differentiate themselves.

You'll organize research findings into summaries, spreadsheets, and presentation materials that the team can use.

You'll assist with product launches by preparing draft content, organizing deliverables, tracking deadlines, and gathering feedback.

You'll work with product managers to understand upcoming features and help document their intended use cases.

You'll collaborate with technical stakeholders when additional product information is needed.

You'll help create materials that sales teams can use to explain features and answer common customer questions.

You'll also support customer success teams by developing educational content that helps customers understand and adopt new capabilities.

You'll assist with maintaining product marketing documentation, messaging libraries, competitive research, and launch resources.

You'll have opportunities to contribute ideas for improving product messaging, customer education, and internal communications.

You'll learn how product marketing teams evaluate their work through customer feedback, launch results, content engagement, and product adoption.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll also learn the importance of accurate product communication and appropriate review of sensitive claims.

This internship is designed to provide meaningful project experience while allowing you to learn from team members across different functions.

You'll receive direction on your assignments and have opportunities to take increasing ownership as you develop your skills.

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, comfortable asking questions, and willing to take initiative.

You don't need previous full-time product marketing experience. What matters is your ability to learn, communicate clearly, follow through on assignments, and produce thoughtful work.

What You'll Do

  • Support product marketing projects across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with drafting product descriptions and feature summaries.
  • Help translate software functionality into clear customer-facing messaging.
  • Support the development of product positioning materials.
  • Conduct research on customer needs and business challenges.
  • Research competing SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology platforms.
  • Organize competitive research into summaries and comparison documents.
  • Assist with preparing product launch announcements and supporting materials.
  • Help track launch deliverables, deadlines, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Collaborate with product managers to learn about new features.
  • Gather product information from engineers, designers, and other stakeholders.
  • Assist with creating product presentations and feature overviews.
  • Support the development of sales enablement resources.
  • Help draft website and landing page content for product features.
  • Assist with preparing customer education materials.
  • Support the creation of tutorials, guides, and feature walkthroughs.
  • Help organize customer feedback and recurring product questions.
  • Research industry trends related to SaaS, e-commerce, telehealth, and AI.
  • Assist with maintaining product marketing documentation.
  • Organize messaging libraries, launch resources, and research notes.
  • Support internal communications about product updates.
  • Review draft materials for clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Help coordinate feedback and revisions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Assist with preparing product demonstrations and supporting content.
  • Support the tracking of product marketing performance indicators.
  • Help summarize launch results and customer engagement findings.
  • Contribute ideas for improving product messaging and educational materials.
  • Complete assigned projects and share progress with the team.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree, recently graduated, or developing early professional experience in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Interest in product marketing, software products, and technology.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Basic understanding of marketing concepts or willingness to learn.
  • Ability to research topics and organize findings.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Product & Technical Communications
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses.

  • Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world.

  • Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers.

  • Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team.

  • Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action.

  • Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances.

  • Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products.

  • A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them.

  • Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives.

  • Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents.

  • Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators.

  • A track record of excellence, be that building products, running superb campaigns, or some other entrepreneurial endeavor.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT-4 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$170,180—$188,940 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, US [IC5]
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.

Preferred location:

  • USA

Why this job is exciting

As an Enterprise Account Executive [IC5], you will have more responsibility, upside, and growth potential than anywhere else with a comparable role. At Sourcegraph, we strive to create the best environment for exceptionally talented people to thrive. If you join us, you’ll make a meaningful impact on how engineering organizations operate at scale.

Here’s what you can expect in your first year:

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Begin 1:1’s with your manager, understand your 30-60-90 plan, shadow current team members, review your quota, and dive into your territory.
  • Build a territory plan targeting net-new logo accounts with a strong emphasis on outbound engagement and expanding existing customer relationships.
  • Start to hold new business meetings and build pipeline
  • Meet key partners across Customer Engineering, Technical Success, Product, Legal, and Engineering teams—relationships that will be critical throughout your deal cycles.

📅 Within three months, you will…

  • Be well versed in Sourcegraph’s Value Framework.
  • Understand the unique capabilities of Sourcegraph products and develop compelling strategies to align their value with your prospect’s engineering and business objectives.
  • Hone your storytelling skills, clearly articulating use cases, sharing real-world customer success stories, and conveying outcomes that matter to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify champions, influencers, and decision makers, building trusted advisor relationships that accelerate adoption across engineering organizations.
  • Execute a disciplined, repeatable sales process to continuously build and advance pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasting.
  • Negotiate complex enterprise proposals and contracts and surface market insights to the Product team to influence our roadmap.
  • Consistently hit your activity and pipeline goals.

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Own the full sales cycle, consistently meeting and exceeding pipeline and revenue objectives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, Legal, and Engineering to successfully close technically complex and strategically significant enterprise deals.
  • Deliver actionable customer feedback across teams, ensuring engineers and product teams remain tightly aligned with customer needs.

📅 Within one year, you will…

  • Be recognized as a top-performing Account Executive, consistently exceeding goals and setting the standard for excellence.
  • Mentor and support new Account Executives, assisting with onboarding, training, and motivation to elevate the entire team.

About you

You are a results-oriented, strategic hunter who thrives in enterprise environments and has a proven track record selling to developers and engineering leaders. You excel at uncovering needs through rigorous discovery, navigating complex multi-stakeholder deals, and building consensus across technical and executive audiences.

You are highly motivated, self-directed, and energized by creating new opportunities and expanding your footprint within accounts. You take ownership of your pipeline and performance, and you hold yourself accountable for achieving ambitious goals.

Your Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS or software sales experience
  • 3+ years of selling as an Enterprise Account Executive
  • Proven track record of exceeding quotas while leading with empathy and credibility
  • Experience selling complex solutions with ASP ≥ $100k
  • Comfortable engaging with both individual contributors and VP/C-level executives
  • Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills across all levels and personas
  • Passion for our mission and belief in the transformative power of developer productivity

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling developer or engineering-focused products
  • Familiarity with software development concepts, CI/CD, version control, or DevOps tooling
  • Experience managing complex multi-year contracts
  • Knowledge of security, licensing, and compliance requirements
  • Vertical expertise in Financial Services, Insurance, Semiconductors, Auto-Manufacturing, or Retail.

Level

📊 This job is an IC5. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate. To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world.

💰The compensation for this role is outlined below:

  • IC5: $165,000 USD base + $165,000 USD variable ($330,000 USD on-target-earnings).

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take 5 hours in total.

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically

  • [30 min] Leadership with Global Head of Sales
  • We check references and conduct your background check

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

About Mashgin
Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.
Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.
We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.
Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

Position Overview

Mashgin is seeking a technically skilled, resourceful, and customer-focused Sales Engineer to support both prospective and existing customers throughout their journey with Mashgin. This is a full-lifecycle, customer-facing technical role spanning discovery, solution design, technical demonstrations, integrations, pilot execution, deployment readiness, and complex technical initiatives.

You will collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, deployment teams, and external technology partners to evaluate requirements, resolve technical challenges, and align Mashgin solutions with customer workflows. The ideal candidate combines technical curiosity and independent problem-solving with clear communication and sound business judgment.

What We Value:

  • Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

What You'll Do

    Technical Discovery & Sales Enablement

  • Partner with Sales and existing account teams to understand customer workflows, technical requirements, infrastructure, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery, product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and feasibility discussions with operational and IT stakeholders.

  • Identify technical dependencies, limitations, and potential blockers early; recommend appropriate configurations or alternatives.

    • Solution Design & Third-Party Integrations

  • Collaborate with internal Product teams to design and validate customer workflows involving Mashgin hardware, software, cloud services, and third-party platforms.

  • Coordinate integration requirements and testing payments, POS, loyalty, stored value, campus dining, and other enterprise systems.

  • Collaborate with external providers and internal Product and Engineering teams to resolve integration issues and establish repeatable testing practices.

    • Pilots, Deployments & Existing Customer Initiatives

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for pilots, complex implementations, account expansions, and new capabilities for existing customers.

  • Coordinate technical validation and readiness checks with customers, deployment teams, Support, and third-party providers.

  • Identify and help resolve technical blockers before go-live; participate in onsite testing or customer visits when needed.

    • Complex Technical Escalations

  • Investigate high-impact issues beyond standard support procedures, including configuration, connectivity, and integration problems.

  • Use logs, diagnostics, API testing, and issue reproduction to distinguish operational issues, defects, and enhancement requests.

  • Coordinate escalations with Support, Product, Engineering, and partners; communicate findings, workarounds, and next steps.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

  • Translate customer needs and field observations into actionable technical requirements and product feedback.

  • Help prioritize technical dependencies and communicate feasibility, tradeoffs, and customer impact across teams.

  • Create and maintain integration guides, testing procedures, troubleshooting notes, and reusable implementation documentation.

  • Share technical knowledge with internal teams and contribute to scalable Sales Engineering processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Technical ownership: independently move complex technical work toward a clear outcome.

  • Integration quality: validate workflows thoroughly and surface issues before customer impact.

  • Deployment readiness: identify and resolve technical blockers early.

  • Communication: provide timely, accurate, actionable updates and dependable handoffs.

  • Customer trust: build credibility with IT teams, operators, and external partners.

  • Scalability: create documentation and repeatable processes that reduce recurring work.

  • Product impact: surface recurring needs and help validate improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, systems integration, customer-facing technical support, or a related role.

  • Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technologies.

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and firewalls.

  • Experience with APIs, web services, or third-party software integrations.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple initiatives across teams and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, pilots, events, or onsite technical validation as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payment terminals, gateways, POS, loyalty, or stored-value integrations.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, authentication, and tools such as Postman.

  • Experience with Linux, command-line diagnostics, logs, or scripting (Python/Bash).

  • Experience in retail, hospitality, foodservice, sports and entertainment, healthcare, or higher education technology.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and multiple external technology providers.

Growth & Development

    Growth & Development

    This role offers exposure to enterprise customers, diverse technical systems, and cross-functional initiatives. Growth may include greater ownership of strategic integrations, technical mentorship, Senior Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Sales Engineering leadership responsibilities. Advancement does not require transitioning into account management.

Salary

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

  • Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.

  • Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.

  • Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.

  • Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

What you bring

  • Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.

  • Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.

  • Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

This role is NOT a good fit if

  • You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.

  • You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.

  • You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

Your first 6 months

  • Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.

  • Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.

  • Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Our tech stack context

  • Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)

  • Transformation: dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude

  • BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)

  • Languages: SQL

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).

  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.

  • Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.

  • Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.

  • Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

The interview process

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner

  2. SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager

  4. Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal

  5. Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Commercial Legal Counsel (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is looking for a Commercial Legal Counsel that will assist the in-house legal department with Insertion Orders (Agreements), third party contracts and other legal needs. This position will support the Commercial, Finance and Accounting teams, located around the world.

As a Commercial Legal Counsel at Liftoff, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of contracts that drive our business forward. You will be at the intersection of legal expertise, meticulous organization, and collaborative teamwork. Your responsibilities will encompass contract drafting, negotiation, process improvement and training. As an essential part of our team, you'll contribute to the foundation of our business relationships and help us navigate the complex world of contracts with precision and efficiency. If you're passionate about detail-oriented work, contract law, and making a meaningful impact, this role is your opportunity to shine. Join us in shaping the way we manage contracts and elevate our commitment to excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including vendor agreements, customer contracts, and licensing agreements, to ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, sales/commercial, product, engineering, finance and accounting to understand contract terms, resolve issues, and provide guidance on contractual matters.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date contract ticketing system, respond to each contract ticket in a timely manner and track contract milestones and deadlines.
  • Assist in contract compliance, addressing any deviations or breaches.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of contract templates and standard clauses.
  • Support the contract approval process, ensuring proper authorization and documentation.
  • Provide guidance and training to employees on contract-related matters and best practices.
  • Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations impacting contract management.

Requirements:

  • 5-10 Years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Contracts Counsel/Legal Counsel or in a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of contract law and legal terminology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and time management abilities.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

jobs.title: VP, Deputy General Counsel (Energy)
jobs.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a VP, Deputy General Counsel (Energy) to lead the company's energy legal work, negotiate commercial agreements across the business, and support the continued development of the legal function as we scale our hyperscale data center portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, this position is one of three planned functional roles, each ultimately responsible for a distinct area of the business (Job Level M7 — VP or SVP).

Power is a critical-path factor in the development of every campus, influencing site viability, energization timelines, and the commitments Montera can make to its customers. This position is responsible for the agreements that secure power, the regulatory engagement that protects it, and the allocation of power-related risk within customer agreements. The role is broad rather than specialized: in addition to energy matters, the Deputy General Counsel is responsible for commercial contracts across development and operations, support for customer agreements, and certain templates, playbooks, outside-counsel panel, and systems that enable a small team to support a growing portfolio. The position partners with the Development, Design & Construction, Delivery, Procurement, Finance, and Commercial teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Exercise delegated authority from the Chief Legal Officer across energy and commercial matters, and represent the Legal function directly with the business, counterparties, and regulators.
  • Build the legal department in partnership with the CLO — contract templates and negotiation playbooks, matter intake, contract lifecycle management, the outside-counsel panel, and the obligations and change-of-control registers.
  • Define, recruit, and mentor other attorney and director roles added as the legal function scales; select, scope, and manage specialist outside counsel, running the panel to budget and bringing recurring work in-house as the function matures.
  • Own the negotiation and execution of electric service agreements, large-load tariffs and special contracts, and capacity reservation and deposit structures across Montera's development pipeline.
  • Lead large-load interconnection and transmission matters — queue strategy and evidencing, network-upgrade cost allocation and reimbursement, transmission service, and substation and facilities ownership boundaries.
  • Structure power procurement across utility, wholesale, and behind-the-meter sources — take-or-pay and minimum-demand terms, credit support, contribution in aid of construction, and energization milestones and remedies.
  • Advise on on-site and bridge generation (gas, turbines, fuel cells, and storage), together with the supply, EPC, and operating agreements behind them and the parallel-operation and permitting interfaces.
  • Lead energy regulatory strategy before FERC and state commissions — large-load tariff proceedings, cost-allocation dockets, interventions, and regulatory audit and information requests.
  • Negotiate and close commercial agreements across the business (MSAs, equipment procurement, technology and vendor, consulting and professional services, confidentiality and teaming), and support customer-facing agreements in partnership with the CLO and the Real Estate & Development DGC — allocating power risk inside customer agreements (capacity and availability commitments, SLA exposure, utility cost pass-through, curtailment and demand response, excusable delay tied to utility performance).
  • Support power and real estate diligence on site acquisition and land enablement; support lender, sponsor, and customer diligence across the contract portfolio (consents, direct agreements, assignability, change of control); provide training to the business on key terms and escalation protocols; and contribute to Board and sponsor reporting on contracted capacity, energy risk, commercial exposure, and the development of the legal function.

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; admitted to practice and in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar, and able to register as in-house counsel where required in the state of residence.
  • 15–20 years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, a utility, developer or operator, or in-house. Candidates with 10+ years and exceptional depth will be considered.
  • Deep energy transactional and regulatory experience, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of interconnection, electric service, and power purchase agreements as the responsible attorney rather than in a supporting role.
  • Strong command of U.S. wholesale and retail power markets, FERC and state-commission practice, and large-load tariff structures.
  • Demonstrated commercial negotiation ability across a broad range of agreement types, with a track record of taking on unfamiliar subject matter and reaching a defensible answer quickly.
  • Sound judgment on when to bring in outside counsel and when to decide, with the discipline to run specialist firms to defined scope and budget.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to balance legal risk, schedule, and commercial priorities.
  • Exceptional negotiation, drafting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, founder-led environment without established precedent or process.
    •

Preferred

  • Data center, large-load, or other energy-intensive industrial development experience.
  • Experience negotiating directly with investor-owned utilities, cooperatives, or municipal providers.
  • Experience with behind-the-meter, bridge, or on-site generation, including gas, storage, or fuel cells.
  • Experience building legal-department infrastructure, including templates, playbooks, delegation of authority, contract lifecycle management, and outside-counsel panel management.
  • Hyperscale leasing exposure, from either side of the table.
  • Project finance and lender diligence.
    •

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this role is $325,000 – $350,000, plus an annual performance bonus.

Benefits

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you’ll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.
