jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Robotics)
jobs.description:
We are an AI research lab building foundational intelligence for the physical world.

Our models are designed to solve complex real-world challenges, powering everything from intelligent robots to next-generation wearables and media.

We work at the intersection of world models, video generation, and robotics, building systems that represent complex environments, reason about objects and dynamics, and translate high-level AI intentions into smooth, efficient, safe, and responsive actions across a variety of robotic embodiments.

You will collaborate closely with ML researchers developing multimodal world models and generative systems, and with hardware teams and partners to ensure robotic platforms, sensing, and system dynamics behave optimally in real-world operation.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the Foundation: Collaborate with our world model team to build state-of-the-art training and simulation platform for robotics.

  • Build the "World": Develop persistent 3D/4D scene representations that maintain temporal consistency.

  • Drive Intelligence: Unlock advanced robotics planning and decision making through our in-house, cutting-edge world models.

  • Sim2Real: Ensure sensing and system dynamics perform reliably in high-stakes, real-world operations, where models think, simulate, and act.

  • Push Boundaries: Partner with top ML researchers to innovate on generative models and physical AGI.

Areas of Interest

We are particularly excited about candidates working on topics such as:

  • World models for embodied systems

  • 3D / 4D generative models

  • Robotics manipulation

  • Embodied AI

  • Multimodal AI

What We’re Looking For

  • Background in robotics, or computer vision

  • Experience with 3D perception, scene representations, or world models

  • Experience working with robotic systems, simulation, or real-world platforms

  • Strong programming skills (Python, C++, or similar)

  • Located in London or willing to relocate to London, UK

Ability to work across machine learning, perception, and robotics

Reka's Mission

Reka's mission is to build useful multimodal artificial intelligence and use it to empower organisations and businesses. We are a globally distributed foundation model startup, headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Embracing a remote-first approach, our team brings together top talent from around the world. Our founding team, along with many of our team members, has contributed to many of the breakthroughs in AI over the past decade.


Why Reka?

  • An Elite Team: Collaborate with top-tier engineers, researchers, operators from renowned organizations like Google DeepMind and Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and successful startups, driving innovation in cutting-edge AI technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Be part of a rapidly growing industry poised to transform multiple sectors globally, offering the chance to make a significant impact.

  • Mission-Driven Environment: Work alongside a collaborative, mission-focused team dedicated to advancing AI for meaningful applications.

  • Inclusive and Open Culture: Thrive in an open and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and fosters creativity.

  • Generous Benefits: Enjoy 5 weeks of paid leave to recharge, comprehensive healthcare benefits including vision and dental, and additional perks that support your well-being.

  • Visa Support: We provide visa assistance for UK employees to ensure a smooth transition and support your career with us.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive UKI
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As an Account Executive working remotely in the UK and focused on the UK region, you manage target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 501 - 2,500 employees based in the United Kingdom. Your primary focus is hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the Commercial sector. You are also responsible for upselling into the existing account base, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role

This is a hybrid role with a regular travel component. You will be expected to work from 1Password’s London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days per week based on business needs.
You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 4+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Commercial accounts OR top performance in SMB and ready to step up.

  • Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within EMEA.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs, including consistent experience closing deals with $50k+ ARR and the ability to clearly articulate deal strategy, execution, and outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared.

  • Proven track record of leveraging executive stakeholders throughout deal cycles, effectively multi-threading opportunities, and securing in-person meetings with key decision-makers.

  • Experience conducting regular in-person customer engagement multiple times per month, with a willingness and ability to travel within your region for client meetings and industry events.

  • Proficient skills in:

    • Outbound prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target.

    • Business acumen, relationship building, solution selling, negotiation, & presenting to C-Suite.

    • Written and verbal communication skills across email and communication tools such as Slack and Zoom, with the demonstrated ability to make technical concepts accessible to non-technical parties.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Resilient, self-motivated, and committed to achieving targets while thriving in a remote and fast-paced environment where products and value propositions evolve rapidly, including comfort selling against future vision while products are still in development.

  • Demonstrated success managing high workloads and competing priorities without sacrificing quality of execution.

  • A proven team player, eager to collaborate and achieve shared goals rather than working in isolation.

  • Curious and coachable, with a proven ability to apply feedback, adapt, and continuously improve.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with channel resellers (enabling, account mapping, relationship building).

  • Experience with the MEDDPPICC sales methodology or other rigorous qualification frameworks preferred.

  • Preferred: Proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator & Outreach.

  • Willingness to travel within your region for client meetings and industry events.

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated territory in the UK region, focusing on acquiring new Commercial clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, inbound leads, cold calling, and networking, utilizing our formalized sales process (MEDPICC preferred).

  • Drive New Business Growth: Design and implement effective sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets by:

    • Consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly sales quotas.

    • Maintaining a high volume of outbound activity, including calls, emails, and meetings.

    • Identifying and engaging key decision-makers within target accounts.

    • Developing and closing new business opportunities within your territory.

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts, leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Close Multi-Product Deals: Identify opportunities and close large value deals with multiple product SKUs.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers. Interact with CISOs, CIOs, and other VP level-contacts, demonstrating excellent executive presence and knowledge of the cybersecurity industry.

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Build collaborative relationships with internal teams (e.g. BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, Customer Success) to develop tailored solutions that meet client needs and drive satisfaction, optimize client engagement, and identify growth opportunities.

    • Cultivate multi-threaded relationships within client organizations to enhance overall account health and long-term success.

    • Strategically leverage Partner, Alliance, and MSP relationships to create and close opportunities.

  • Focus on Solution Selling:

    • Implement selling strategies to align our solutions with client needs and objectives, focusing on their pain points and positioning our solutions as essential, strategic tools.

    • Demonstrate a deep understanding of client pain points and position our offerings as strategic solutions.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to C-suite executives, using a consultative approach while articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Lead high-stakes negotiations with a focus on driving mutually beneficial outcomes.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £53,000 GBP and £74,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

This is an opportunity to build the AI-first accounting and finance backbone of a rapidly scaling business from the ground up. You’ll be backed by a leadership team focused on defining the future and an internal team of engineers, architects, and visionaries supporting that path. This role offers more than traditional controllership: it is an opportunity to grow into a commercial leader by building a modern, AI-first and highly scalable back office that will serve as the basis for future practice serving Emergent Software clients. That means you get to do the best work of your life and build the skillset of a senior leader.

This leader will be responsible for all aspects of accounting and controllership, as well as commercial influence over the organization. Reporting to the CFO and with broad exposure to both executive leadership and our private equity sponsors, this role will be a key member of the Emergent leadership team.

Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software

  • Design a modern finance function from the ground up, with executive backing and real investment in tools

  • Work directly with the CFO, who has led finance, accounting, strategy, corporate development, and all aspects of shared services functions, in both public and private technology companies

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the United States

  • Flexible work schedule built around outcomes, not hours at a desk

  • Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software

  • 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development, plus training costs. We invest in your growth!

  • Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave

Responsibilities

  • Own a fast, accurate monthly close with GAAP financial statements, non-GAAP reporting controls, reconciliations, and flux analysis

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting for leadership, our board and our lender, including covenant compliance support

  • Lead our first financial statement audit and direct the auditor relationship

  • In partnership with the CFO, build a world-class finance, accounting, and operational system that inspires clients and establishes the basis of a future commercial practice

  • Partner with revenue and delivery leaders to define revenue recognition across T&M, fixed-fee, managed-services, cloud subscription resale, and future business lines

  • Lead the design of our new ERP and the cutover from our current ledger; oversee surrounding supporting financial infrastructure and data

  • Design and run the internal control environment

  • Own billing accuracy and the subledger for partner resale and incentive relationships

  • Build a multi-entity-ready close and lead accounting integration for acquisitions

  • Lead financial and accounting due diligence in acquisition processes; lead integrations of acquired assets

  • Lead the accounting team and operations of an exit-ready business

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience designing or running accounting and back-office processes in an AI-first way, with agents doing the preparation and people owning review and judgment

  • Deep US GAAP knowledge, especially revenue recognition for complex arrangements in product, services and resale, and confidence making and documenting judgment calls

  • PE-backed company experience, including lender reporting and acquisition integration

  • A healthy ruthlessness about skating to where the puck is going, not accepting good enough

  • Experience with modern cloud ERPs and data platforms

  • Comfort with modern engineering workflows, such as version control and change review, or eagerness to learn them

Our Vetting Process

At Emergent Software, we work hard to find exceptional people who bring deep expertise and high standards. If you believe you’re one of them, we ask you to invest in our vetting process with us. That effort is what allows us to surround you with other talented people who have demonstrated that same level of capability.

  1. Application (5 minutes)

  2. Online Assessment (50-70 minutes)

  3. Initial Phone Interview (30-45 minutes)

  4. Hiring Manager Interview (3-45 minutes)

  5. Executive Team Interview (60-90 minutes)

Benefits Package Details

About Emergent Software

Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. jobs.title: Event Production & Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
About From Day One:

The business landscape is changing fast. From Day One is a media outlet and conference series that helps companies navigate all that change in ways that put people first.

Since our beginning in 2018, we've reached over 150,000 attendees, hosted over a thousand speakers, and produced conferences in more than 20 major U.S. cities–and counting. We take a unique, cross-disciplinary approach, convening leaders in CSR, HR, marketing, and communications, as well as civic leaders, authors, and journalists, to share business strategies that benefit workers, customers, and communities.

We also publish reporting and opinion pieces by a network of notable journalists, led by the company's editor in chief, veteran journalist Stephen Koepp.

At From Day One, we hire people who have a high degree of self-motivation and the potential to grow into active leaders. We call team members like these "drivers". If you are a passenger, From Day One will not be a good fit for you.

As you apply, think about whether these attributes describe you:

  • You motivate and energize colleagues rather than waiting for inspiration.
  • You're relentlessly resourceful and take ownership rather than seeking excuses. .
  • You look to consistently deliver great outcomes, and work to improve processes as you engage with them.
  • You are excited about your work and bring urgency to your mission.
  • You approach challenges with enthusiasm and optimism.

Our work is driven by our mission to improve the relationship between business and society, and our efforts are intended to contribute to a brighter future. By maintaining this optimistic outlook, we not only motivate ourselves but also uplift those around us. We believe that believing that the future will be better is the first step towards making it better -- for others, and for ourselves personally.

Please note that diversity and inclusion are absolutely core to our mission, and we are committed to those values in our hiring process.

About This Role:

The Event Production & Client Success Manager manages the logistical needs of our production calendar for both live and virtual events, and owns the relationships with the sponsors who attend them.

Production is the larger share of the job, and volume is what defines it. In the next twelve months we are producing thirteen live conferences and a virtual conference every month. Several events sit at different planning milestones at once, and you would carry them without being told what is due next.

Key tasks include managing A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, review and management of rental orders, vendor requirements and temporary staff hiring, creation of venue layouts and detailed run-of-show schedules, execution of vendor contracts, and construction of the event budget. Much of the work is reconciliation — the A/V order against the current slate of content, the final catering guarantee against the projection it came from, the printed program against the website and the run of show.

Alongside production you would be the point of contact for a roster of our sponsors, administering their deliverables and making sure their experience on site earns a renewal. Producing the event and serving the client are the same job here, done by the same person, which is what makes both halves work.

This is a remote position, and also includes regular travel to other cities for in-person events.

Responsibilities:

Event Production

  • Run the full production process for assigned conferences from the 180-day milestone through post-event wrap-up, and lead the milestone production meetings along the way
  • Create detailed run-of-show schedules and venue layouts, and manage room capacity against the final slate of content and expected attendance
  • Manage A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, walking the order line by line as content changes
  • Review and manage rental orders and vendor requirements, and hire and coordinate temporary event staff
  • Own vendor contracts across venue, catering, A/V, rentals, video, and photography, including deadlines and certificates of insurance
  • Manage catering selections and final guarantees, and compare final numbers against projections
  • Build and maintain the event budget from signed contracts and estimates, and track costs against it as scope changes
  • Place badge, program, and signage orders against their drop-dead dates, and coordinate shipping and staff travel
  • Produce our virtual events on platforms such as Zoom — setting up templates, managing schedules, and ensuring staffing of key roles

Client Success

  • Act as point of contact for a roster of sponsors on their event logistics, escalating as needed
  • Administer all sponsor deliverables — advance materials, shipping of display items, presentation media
  • Assign sponsor table locations, and confirm sponsor and speaker registrations against the production plan
  • Conduct post-event feedback calls, and contribute to renewal rate and customer satisfaction scores

Requirements

  • This position requires a 4-year college/university degree at minimum
  • Candidates should have a strong academic background and a minimum of 3 years of full-time, professional post-graduation experience
  • Direct experience producing complex events — corporate or marketing events, executive gatherings, conferences, trade shows, festivals, or arts events — where you were accountable for the event coming off
  • Experience as a named point of contact for external clients, sponsors, or partners
  • Experience working in-house at a corporation at some point in your career, in any function. Our sponsors are corporate leaders, and the people who serve them best here have worked inside that environment themselves.
  • Experience carrying many concurrent events against fixed deadlines, and owning event budgets and vendor contracts
  • Comfort with project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, or Monday as a daily working tool
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills, and excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

Benefits

  • This is a full-time salaried position. Starting salary is $75,000 CAD per year with opportunities for regular advancement and raises.
  • This position is remote, but please be available to meet with stakeholders based in or near the greater Toronto area if requested.

jobs.description:
About Fusemachines
Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Join our team now!

Work at Home Bilingual Nepali-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

jobs.title: Account Executive, New Business & Expansion
jobs.description:
About the role

You'll own the full sales cycle, focused on mid-market companies, our core customers. New deals typically land at $5K–$30K in annual value with 30–90 day cycles, and you'll also help grow accounts across our full customer base. Your pipeline comes from three places: inbound leads, expansion opportunities from our Customer Success team, and your own outbound prospecting.

You'll run discovery through close and work with Customer Success to grow existing accounts. Many of your buyers will be IT and security leaders evaluating cloud versus on-premise deployment, so you'll be comfortable in technical conversations and procurement processes.

The role is remote, but we get together in person every so often, so we'd prefer candidates near Austin, TX.

What you'll do

Win new business

  • Run the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, demo, business case, negotiation and close.
  • Get past features in discovery: uncover the business impact for the customer and the event or deadline that drives a decision through true curiosity.
  • Multi-thread every deal: engage IT, security, finance and the budget holder, and equip your champion with a written business case they can take to the decision-maker.
  • Qualify rigorously and set honest expectations, so the customers you sign stay and grow.
  • Protect deal value: trade concessions for commitments such as contract length or agent minimums rather than discounting.
  • Guide IT, security and procurement stakeholders through on-premise and hybrid deployments.

Build pipeline and grow accounts

  • Work inbound leads and expansion opportunities from Customer Success, and generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting and marketing-supported campaigns.
  • Partner with CSMs on expansion, from upgrades to cross-selling into new departments: build on their handoff notes, treat these opportunities with the same urgency as inbound, and hand the account back cleanly.

Run a disciplined pipeline

  • Keep many deals moving at once, with agendas, recaps and prompt follow-up. Keep every deal current in HubSpot (use case, timeline, success criteria, risks and forecast).
  • Build a working knowledge of the help desk, ITSM and self-hosted software market, and share what you hear with product and marketing.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • 2–4+ years as a quota-carrying AE closing $5K–$30K deals with 30–90 day cycles.
  • A track record of hitting quota that you can walk us through.
  • Real examples of the pipeline you created yourself, not only meetings booked for you.
  • Examples of deals you won by working several stakeholders and equipping a champion.
  • Comfort selling to technical buyers: IT, security, infrastructure and procurement.
  • Experience with land-and-expand selling, including cross-selling into new departments, and working closely with Customer Success or Account Management.
  • A consultative style built on the customer's problem, its business impact and what's driving their timeline, not feature tours.
  • Discipline with CRM, forecasting and a qualification framework such as BANT, SPICED or MEDDPICC.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling help desk, ITSM, customer service or other self-hosted / hybrid software.
  • Experience with public-sector or regulated buyers.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience.

Benefits

Compensation & benefits

  • $200K OTE: $100K base salary plus $100K variable at target.
  • Ramp support while you build pipeline: your quota steps up gradually, you earn commission on every deal you close, and monthly activity bonuses tied to goals you set with your manager make up the difference.
  • Commission on both New Business and Expansion deals.
  • Benefits: health, retirement, PTO and equipment.

Why join Deskpro

We're sharpening our focus on the customers we serve best and investing in our product to serve them even better. You'll join an agile team with a direct line to leadership and real room to shape how we work.

You'll also have a quota built around deals you can actually win. If you sell honestly, like owning your pipeline, and want your work to visibly move the business, we'd like to talk.

About Deskpro

Deskpro helps organizations deliver exceptional customer and employee support with modern help desk software that brings ticketing, automation, self-service, and AI capabilities together in one platform. We help support teams work more efficiently without losing the human element that makes great service possible.

Equal opportunity

Deskpro is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive team.

jobs.title: Director, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

About the role

As the search landscape shifts and our market gets more crowded, Help Scout is investing more than ever in paid and performance marketing to accelerate signups, expand brand awareness, and diversify how we reach customers.

It's an exciting time to be here. We've got a best-in-market product story, strong creative assets, and stellar copywriting. What we need now is a strategic owner to take our performance marketing motion from early-stage to a durable growth engine that fuels our self-serve, product-led, and sales-assisted growth. You'll report to the VP of Marketing, setting and executing the strategy for how Help Scout invests in paid channels while building deep partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Product, Support, and company leadership.

In this role, you will:

  • Own performance marketing strategy. Set the quarterly and long-term strategy for how paid, lifecycle, and conversion work together to hit the signups number, defining what's needed from each channel and building the plan B when something's off. You'll be the person leadership turns to for the full picture of paid performance.

  • Move Help Scout upmarket. Own iteration of ad copy, creative, bidding strategy, and budget allocation across paid search and display, and set the bar for how we drive both our horizontal motion for volume and our vertical motion for larger deals.

  • Build the business case for new channels. Identify and evaluate new channel investments, paid social, affiliate, direct mail, OOH, and drive alignment with leadership on where to place new bets and how to measure them.

  • Partner on pipeline outcomes. Work closely with Sales and RevOps to connect paid spend to pipeline and revenue, not just top-of-funnel volume, and make sure channel investment decisions reflect what's actually converting downstream.

  • Partner to grow organic and paid in harmony. Work with content, social, SEO, and AEO to make sure paid and organic acquisition reinforce each other rather than compete for the same ground.

  • Represent Help Scout's performance marketing point of view. Bring an informed perspective on where the paid landscape is heading, and use that expertise to keep Help Scout ahead of a crowded, competitive market.

  • Own our presence in AI-driven discovery. As search shifts toward AI overviews and LLM-based answers, you'll define how Help Scout shows up in that landscape alongside traditional paid and organic search.

  • Shape the future of the function. This is currently an individual contributor role with agency support. You'll build the roadmap for what performance marketing needs to look like over the next 12-18 months, including where headcount should come in as the motion scales.

About you

  • You have at least 7+ years in performance or growth marketing, including experience owning strategy for a B2B SaaS company.

  • You have significant experience in paid/performance marketing, with a track record of owning strategy for B2B SaaS companies – not just executing campaigns.

  • You're an expert across paid channels and know the search landscape and the benchmarks that matter (PPC, CPM, ROAS), and you can identify which channels and investments matter most for the business right now.

  • You have a scrappy, results-driven mindset. You're comfortable working with ambiguity, a modest budget, and a lean marketing team, and you know how to out-creative the competition while also spending in the right way to drive results.

  • You have strong analytical skills, with deep experience in tools like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and attribution platforms, and you know how to turn data into a clear recommendation for leadership.

  • You know how to run rapid experimentation and adapt strategy based on what the data tells you – and you have a plan B ready before you need it.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Majors Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will serve as the strategic business partner for a select portfolio of our most important financial services customers. You will be the post-sales primary point of contact, responsible for driving outcomes, building executive relationships, and ensuring customers realize measurable value from Chainguard. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, and Sales, with the SA owning technical implementation so you can stay focused on business outcomes, relationship depth, and long-term account health.

This is a high-touch, consultative role. Your book of business will be intentionally smaller so you can invest deeply in each account, understand each customer's business priorities, and position Chainguard as a strategic partner rather than a vendor.

What you'll do:

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain trusted relationships across customer organizations, from practitioner teams to CISOs and executive sponsors. Understand each customer's business objectives, risk priorities, and regulatory environment to align Chainguard's value accordingly.
  • Customer Onboarding and Success Planning: Lead the business-focused elements of onboarding, including success planning, stakeholder alignment, and value delivery milestones. Partner with Solutions Architects who own technical implementation, ensuring business and technical workstreams stay coordinated.
  • Executive Engagement: Lead and facilitate executive business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and escalation conversations. Know when to bring in Chainguard's executive team and how to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics in large financial institutions.
  • Renewal and Expansion: Work closely with your sales counterparts to identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and build multi-year account strategies grounded in demonstrated value.
  • Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating customer needs into product and roadmap feedback. Influence cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Sales on behalf of your accounts.
  • Issue Management: Coordinate with Technical Support and Engineering on escalations, serving as the business-facing lead while the SA manages technical resolution.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in enterprise customer-facing roles, with a strong preference for experience in or adjacent to financial services. Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Consulting backgrounds are all relevant.

  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following domains: software supply chain security, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, container security, or application security. You do not need to be a technical implementer, but you need to speak credibly to business and security outcomes in these areas.

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, both written and verbal.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the security and compliance obligations that shape procurement and adoption cycles in regulated industries

Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you

NTT Data seeks high-achieving team players who quickly adapt to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to work with our global client for a fully remote opportunity in LATAM working EST hours.

Position Summary

Data integration engineer specialized in designing, developing, and operating enterprise data pipelines on ETL tools; Informatica IDMC (Intelligent Data Management Cloud / IICS) as the primary platform, with strong capabilities in feeding the Databricks Lakehouse. Able to work across cloud-agnostic environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and to apply AI-assisted development with CLAIRE GPT and CLAIRE Copilot to accelerate the build cycle and reduce time-to-delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and distribution pipelines with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion.
  • Build and optimize ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse using IDMC for Databricks and Delta Lake patterns.
  • Migrate PowerCenter workloads to IDMC using structured methodology and internal accelerators.
  • Operate and maintain integration infrastructure (Secure Agents, runtimes) on Azure and AWS under SLA standards.
  • Apply CLAIRE GPT/Copilot to optimize the mapping development cycle and reduce delivery time.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Informatica IDMC · Integration Core

    • Cloud Data Integration (CDI): Mapping Designer, SQL ELT with pushdown optimization (full/source/target), Taskflows, mapping partitioning, Dynamic Mappings, parameterization, file listeners, intelligent structure models (CLAIRE-powered), and performance tuning.
    • Cloud Mass Ingestion (CMI): batch and near-real-time ingestion from heterogeneous sources across its variants: Mass Ingestion Databases (CDC), Files, Applications, and Streaming.
    • Cloud Application Integration (CAI): Process Designer, service connectors, guides, and business processes; API and microservices integration.
    • PowerCenter to IDMC: migration and modernization of on-premises pipelines using structured methodology, CDI-PC, and migration accelerators.
    • Platform operations: administration of Secure Agents and runtime environments (Secure Agent Groups), monitoring, and SLA management.

    Databricks Integration

    • IDMC for Databricks: ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion, Delta Lake load patterns, and SQL ELT pushdown to Databricks SQL.
    • Connectivity through the Databricks connector (Partner Connect), Unity Catalog awareness, and parameterized job orchestration.

    AI-Assisted Development (CLAIRE)

    • CLAIRE GPT / CLAIRE Copilot: assisted generation of mappings, debugging of transformations, and automatic pipeline documentation through natural language within IDMC.
    • Awareness of the new agentic capabilities (CLAIRE Agents, Fall 2025 release) for headless ingestion and transformation flows.

    Platform FinOps

    • Understanding of the IPU (Informatica Processing Units) consumption model and per-service cost optimization.

    Cloud-Agnostic (Complementary)

    • Azure: Azure Data Factory (ADF), Data Lake Storage Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Databricks.
    • AWS: Glue, S3, Step Functions, Redshift, Athena, EventBridge.
    • GCP (desirable): BigQuery, Cloud Composer.
    • IaC & CI/CD for pipelines: Terraform, CloudFormation; GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins.

    Databases & Platforms

    • Advanced SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Databricks SQL).
    • NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB; desirable).
    • Data Warehouse, Data Lake, and Lakehouse architecture patterns.

Certifications:

  • Informatica Cloud Data Integration Developer, Professional Certification (ICP) (core to the role).
  • Informatica Cloud Application Integration Developer, Professional Certification (desirable).
  • Informatica IDMC Foundation / Data Engineering Foundation.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (desirable).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (complementary).
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer / Data Analytics Specialty (complementary).

Why NTT Data?

Empowerment and rewards are the cornerstone of our career development model. We are a young, fast-growing company, with a highly innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, because of this professional experience and growth will be unmatched. Our talent and positive attitude allow us to transform our goals into achievements, and projects into realities.

NTT Data is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action-Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. NTT Data is an Equal Opportunity Employer Male/Female/Disabled/Veteran and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

jobs.title: Risk Governance Officer (18 months FTC)
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Risk Governance Officer to help strengthen and embed effective risk management across Our Future Health.

Working closely with the Risk Governance Manager, you'll play an important role in identifying, assessing, monitoring and reporting on strategic, enterprise and organisational risks that could affect our ability to achieve our objectives.

This role focuses on the bigger picture of organisational risk, including financial sustainability, data security, delivery of strategic objectives, funding, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and reputational risks. You'll work with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure risks are understood, appropriately managed and considered in decision making.

Despite big improvements in healthcare in our lifetimes, today millions of people in the UK still live in poor health as they get older. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.

Our Future Health is the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. We are a charity, supported by the UK Government, in partnership with charities and industry. We work closely with the NHS and with public authorities across all nations and regions of the UK.

This is a Fixed Term contract position for 18 months.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you’ll work collaboratively with colleagues across Our Future Health to coordinate risk governance processes and help embed a positive and pragmatic approach to risk management.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Coordinating day-to-day risk governance activities and regular risk review and reporting cycles.
  • Working with risk owners and stakeholders to maintain accurate risk information, monitor agreed actions and follow up on progress.
  • Supporting the implementation and ongoing embedding of Our Future Health’s Risk Management Framework.
  • Facilitating risk identification, assessment and review workshops with teams and stakeholders.
  • Coordinating the development, maintenance and review of organisational and operational risk registers, including tracking actions and escalating risks through the appropriate governance routes.
  • Reviewing risk information for completeness, consistency and alignment with the Risk Management Framework, providing constructive challenge where appropriate.
  • Producing clear, high-quality risk reporting, analysis and management information to support governance forums and decision making.
  • Supporting assurance activities and maintaining accurate governance records and documentation.
  • Building effective relationships across the organisation and helping colleagues take a pragmatic and proportionate approach to risk.
  • Supporting continuous improvement across risk governance and the wider Assurance function.

What this role is not focused on:

This is a risk governance role, not a specialist health and safety or clinical safety assessment role. It does not primarily involve carrying out technical assessments such as COSHH or infection prevention and control assessments, workplace safety inspections or site-level assessments. Experience managing clinical or healthcare risks through risk registers, agreed actions, review and escalation is relevant.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone with practical experience in enterprise, corporate or organisation-wide risk management. This could include experience in a clinical or healthcare setting, provided it involves managing risks and supporting risk governance, rather than focusing mainly on carrying out specialist health and safety or clinical safety assessments

We recognise that candidates may have developed relevant experience through different career paths and welcome applications from those who can demonstrate many, though not necessarily all, of the skills and experience listed below:

  • Experience in enterprise risk management, corporate governance or organisation-wide risk and assurance activities, with an understanding of how risks can affect strategic objectives and organisational performance.
  • Experience coordinating recurring governance, risk review or reporting processes.
  • Experience facilitating meetings, workshops or stakeholder discussions.
  • The ability to review and analyse risk information, identify gaps or inconsistencies and provide constructive challenge.
  • The ability to analyse information and communicate it through clear, concise reports and recommendations.
  • Experience producing management information, reports or governance papers.
  • Effective organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow activities through to completion.
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively with stakeholders across an organisation.
  • Excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to recognise when issues need to be escalated.
  • A proactive, curious and adaptable approach, with an interest in continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence would be advantageous.
  • A relevant professional qualification, or working towards one such as those offered by the Institute of Risk Management (IRM), would be advantageous but is not essential.

Hiring Process

We feel hiring should be transparent and give you a real sense for what Our Future Health is like. Here's what you can expect from our remote process:

  • Initial chat with our Talent team (30 min) to get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have.
  • Competency based interview with a small cross-functional panel with your potential new manager and some of your stakeholders (60 min). It is designed to get a sense of how you collaborate and with stakeholders, and how you'd approach the real-world responsibilities of this role.

Benefits

  • From £40,000 per annum basic salary.
  • Generous Pension Scheme – We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12%.
  • 30 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays – Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you.
  • Enhanced Parental Leave – Supporting you during life’s biggest moments.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme – Save 25-39% on a new bike and accessories through salary sacrifice.
  • Home & Tech Savings – Get up to 8% off on IKEA and Currys products, spreading the cost over 12 months through salary sacrifice.
  • £1,000 Employee Referral Bonus – Know someone amazing? Get rewarded for bringing them on board!
  • Wellbeing Support – Access to Mental Health First Aiders, plus 24/7 online GP services and an Employee Assistance Programme for you and your family.
  • A Great Place to Work – We have a lovely Central London office in Holborn, and offer flexible and remote working arrangements.

Join us – let’s prevent disease together.

Support fundraisers before, during, and after campaigns. Ensure community members have a positive experience and see the impact of their participation.

jobs.title: Founding Marketer
jobs.description:
Infilla is looking for a Founding Marketer to make Infilla the name government leaders already know and trust before the first sales call, and to build the stories, messaging, and events that turn that trust into pipeline.

As our first marketing hire, you’ll build marketing from scratch: product messaging, customer stories, our event strategy, and the pipeline they generate. There’s no inherited playbook or legacy stack, so the systems you set up now will shape how Infilla goes to market for years.

Infilla’s mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We’re backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who’ve built products at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER

  • Each Infilla product has clear, buyer-tested messaging that sales uses on every call

  • Every conference Infilla attends produces booked meetings and pipeline tracked through to closed deals

  • Prospects can find named customer stories with real numbers that prove Infilla works

  • Infilla tells one consistent story across the website, sales collateral, social media, email, and stage, and buyers can repeat it back

  • Newsletters, social media postings, and webinars are tested as a marketing channel

  • Marketing-sourced pipeline is measured, attributed, and a meaningful share of new pipeline

WHAT YOU’VE DONE BEFORE

  • Personally run at least one conference or trade show end-to-end, and you can show the pipeline it produced

  • Worked at a startup where you handled marketing operations yourself

  • Built positioning and messaging for a B2B product that sales actually used

  • Published customer case studies

  • Partnered closely with sales and been measured on pipeline

  • Made AI a core part of how you work, not an occasional assist

WHAT YOU’RE GREAT AT

Field marketing and sales enablement are where you must be great; product marketing is a close second.

  • Field marketing: You treat conferences and webinars as revenue channels. You pick events based on where buyers actually are, book meetings weeks ahead, get Infilla onto panels, follow up within 48 hours, and report meetings and deals, not badge scans.

  • Product marketing and positioning: You translate features into the outcomes government buyers care about. “AI-powered search” becomes “fewer counter calls.” You know what the planning director, the building official, and the counter clerk each need to hear, and you can take a launch from “shipped” to “sales can pitch it” with one clear message.

  • Writing for buyers: You lead with the point, use real numbers instead of adjectives, and write in a plain, calm, nonpartisan tone government buyers trust. You can write a one-pager, a landing page, an event invite, and a case study, each in the right register.

  • Sales partnership: You hold yourself to pipeline and revenue. You ship materials sales actually uses, check whether they use them, and treat pushback from the field as input.

  • Scrappy, AI-leveraged execution: You’re a team of one who ships a good-enough version and iterates. You handle light design (Canva, Figma) and CRM hygiene yourself, and you say no to good ideas that won’t move pipeline this quarter.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

  • Experience as the first marketer at seed or Series A vertical SaaS company

  • Public sector or GovTech experience, especially selling to cities, counties, or states

  • Familiarity with planning, permitting, housing, or building codes

  • Webinars or content programs that generated pipeline

  • Led a new product launch, not just feature launches

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we’re ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

  • This is a remote US-based role. We prefer to start on a part-time or full-time contract-to-hire basis.

    • You will be expected to travel to US conferences 1-2 times a quarter

  • You will join the GTM team and report to the CEO

  • Full-time benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays.

  • We cannot sponsor visas at this time

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 1-2 weeks:

  1. Initial call with Savanna, our recruiter, to assess mutual fit (20 min)

  2. Field marketing deep dive with Jeff, our founding account executive, to assess field marketing skills (45 min)

  3. Artifact review & messaging exercise with Jenny, the CEO, to assess product marketing and positioning skills (60 min)

  4. Roadmap jam with Jenny to assess sales partnership and execution (60 min)

  5. 3+ reference checks

HOW WE WORK

  • Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

  • Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

  • Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

  • Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not “eventually.” Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

  • Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don’t wait for someone else to.

WHAT THIS ROLE ISN’T

  • You won’t own the core company narrative. You’ll carry it into every product and channel.

  • You won’t be our designer. Light one-pagers and booth materials, yes. Anything beyond that can be handled by design.

  • You won’t need to find case study customers. We’ll make the intros, and you’ll turn them into great stories.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we’ll make it work.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Project Manager
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

This role is only open to current residents of the UK. No relocation or visa support is provided, but there may be routes to visa sponsorship for suitable candidates in the future. It is important that you possess full working rights within the UK at the time of your application. Candidates who do not meet this requirement may not be responded to.

We are a specialist project management consultancy supporting the development and delivery of major energy and infrastructure projects across England, Wales and Scotland.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Environmental Project Manager to lead the environmental work-streams of complex infrastructure projects from early concept and feasibility through consenting, pre-construction and Final Investment Decision (FID).

Working as part of integrated client and project teams, you will coordinate environmental strategy, surveys, assessments and technical inputs, ensuring environmental considerations are embedded within project planning and decision-making. You will provide clear oversight of programme, risk, cost and deliverables while managing relationships with developers, technical specialists, regulators and other stakeholders.

This role would suit someone who understands both the technical and project management requirements of environmental delivery and can confidently operate in a client-facing consultancy environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead environmental work-streams from early feasibility and site selection through consenting, pre-construction and FID
  • Develop and manage environmental strategies, scopes, programmes, budgets and delivery plans
  • Coordinate Environmental Impact Assessments and associated technical disciplines
  • Manage environmental consultants, survey providers and specialist subcontractors
  • Oversee the commissioning, delivery and quality assurance of environmental surveys, assessments and reports
  • Ensure environmental activities are integrated with engineering, planning, land, grid, commercial and project delivery work-streams
  • Identify and manage environmental risks, constraints, dependencies and opportunities
  • Monitor progress against programme, budget and project milestones
  • Support consenting strategies across the relevant planning regimes in England, Wales and Scotland.
  • Coordinate environmental inputs into DCO, DNS, Section 36, TCPA and other consent applications, where applicable
  • Engage with planning authorities, statutory consultees, regulators, landowners and community stakeholders
  • Support procurement, consultant appointments and commercial management of environmental work packages.
  • Prepare clear progress reports, risk updates and recommendations for clients and project governance forums
  • Support projects through due diligence, investment approvals and readiness for FID
  • Contribute to the continued development of the consultancy’s environmental project management capability

Requirements

You will have experience managing environmental work-streams within the development of major infrastructure, energy or other complex projects. You may come from an environmental consultancy, developer, engineering consultancy or client-side project delivery background.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of multiple work-streams, working with limited supervision and translating complex environmental information into clear actions and decisions.

Essential Experience
  • Experience managing environmental delivery for major infrastructure, energy or development projects
  • Knowledge of one or more UK consenting regimes, including DCO, DNS, Section 36 or TCPA
  • Knowledge of the environmental requirements associated with project development and consenting
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary environmental assessments, surveys and technical specialists
  • Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment processes
  • Ability to develop and manage programmes, budgets, risks and consultant scopes
  • Experience working with developers, technical consultants, regulators or statutory stakeholders
  • Ability to identify interfaces and dependencies across environmental, planning, engineering and commercial work-streams
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Confidence operating in a client-facing consultancy environment
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and geographically distributed team

Benefits

You will join a specialist consultancy working on complex, nationally important infrastructure projects during the development stages when effective environmental leadership can have the greatest influence on project outcomes.

The role offers variety, autonomy and the opportunity to work closely with clients and multidisciplinary project teams across the UK. You will also have the opportunity to help shape our environmental project management offering as the business continues to grow.

Benefits include:

  • A fully remote role to be based from anywhere in the UK
  • An autonomous, mature, and completely flexible working environment.
  • An entrepreneurial and supportive environment to help you develop your career in the direction that works for you.
