jobs.title: Healthcare Data Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Ursa Health

We're Ursa Health, an 11-year-old, growth stage company. We straddle the line between being a software company and a tech-enabled consultancy, driving transformation via actionable insights. We've developed our healthcare data platform over the last decade combining deep industry IP with a flexible and powerful software product. Thanks to our unique, methodical approach, we're able to make sense of data in a way nobody else in the industry is able to – generating analytics that are trusted enough to change how care is delivered.

What we've found to work is a combination of hard-earned human intelligence powering our core, combined with an AI layer that accelerates insight and action. It's the very stability and resilience of our core that allows us to be so dynamic and creative in the last mile. The work of taking healthcare data in its messy, raw format, turning it into results that accurately describe what is actually happening to patients, and then using those insights to drive action; very few organizations can do this well. And, because of that, we serve as the core data and analytics engine for many of the most innovative companies in healthcare.

It's in our DNA that the people building our software and analytics products should also be on the front line of client-facing work. It's a hybrid role, and you'll have to be comfortable billing hourly on idiosyncratic client deliverables. But you'll also be channeling that work back into our products and platform, including our longstanding Ursa Studio and our newer AI-assisted tools like Compass and Sentinel.

Ursa Health is fully remote. We've been fully remote since our founding and have a strong remote-only culture.

We believe in a very human application process — and are leaning further into this given the volume of AI-generated and fraudulent applications we're seeing across the industry. If you want to apply to join our team, submit your complete application including current personal contact information, an updated LinkedIn profile, and an updated CV. Qualified candidates will be asked to submit a 2-minute intro video and complete a technical puzzle, which shouldn't take more than a couple hours. The puzzle is drawn straight from our work and will give you an honest sense of the real-life challenges you'll be expected to tackle. After that, you'll interview with our team. We look forward to learning about your experience, getting to know you as a person, and giving you a real window into life at Ursa.

We're excited to meet candidates who are already authorized to work in the U.S., as we are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Ursa Health is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about achieving diversity on our team because we know that different backgrounds and points of view fuel innovation and creativity, and will therefore help us reach our goal of making healthcare better and more equitable for all. We foster an inclusive environment where we can celebrate our differences. We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply to this and all of our open positions. All applicants will be considered for employment without consideration of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

About the Role

Role Department: Delivery

Reports to: AVP, Integration Engineering

The Healthcare Data Solutions Architect role is ideal for an experienced data professional eager to put their domain knowledge and engineering expertise to work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment. Your efforts to organize, transform, and automate the flow of healthcare data will unlock actionable insights for our clients, enabling them to move from raw data to meaningful analysis in hours rather than weeks. You'll interpret and integrate client payer claims, ADT, clinical/EMR, provider billing, and other operational datasets into the Ursa Core Data Model, building reusable, enduring data models that clients rely on to drive clinical, operational, and financial decisions.

You will work closely with Ursa colleagues across analytics engineering, product development, and customer success, as well as directly with client teams including data architects, analysts, clinicians, and other healthcare professionals to understand their data and their needs. You'll leverage Ursa Health's data platform to design and build integration pipelines, data models and increasingly, work alongside AI-assisted tooling that accelerates the process.

About You

  • You're looking for a role that will allow you to apply your experience to a "blank canvas" to design and create elegant and enduring data models.
  • You have great attention to detail and enjoy the process of investigating and interpreting raw data. You anticipate dataset-specific inconsistencies and edge cases before they become problems.
  • You are a consultative partner by nature, comfortable working directly with a range of stakeholders (clinical, operational, data/technology, and actuarial) to understand how data was generated, what its limitations are, and how it will be used.
  • You are looking to join a collaborative team that is passionate about healthcare and strives to build best in class healthcare analytics.
  • You're curious by nature and excited to use technologies that allow you more time to explore, test, and iterate on the data model you design rather than worry about maintaining fragile code.
  • You have a deep understanding of health information systems, medical claims and/or billing data across payors and/or clinical data from your experience as a data architect and/or engineer.
  • You balance technical rigor with pragmatic elegance building solutions that are durable without being overcomplicated.
  • You've worked with AI tools and have developed a clear-eyed sense of where they help and where they don't especially in a domain where the cost of a wrong answer is high.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the integration of healthcare data packages including medical claims, pharmacy claims, revenue cycle billing, ADT, clinical/EMR, FHIR and value-based care financial datasets into custom or Ursa Studio standard data models through collaboration with client and Ursa Health teams.
  • Own end-to-end data solution architecture for ingesting, transforming, standardizing, and integrating complex healthcare datasets from multiple sources.
  • Design and maintain scalable, standardized healthcare data models.
  • Operationalize rigorous validation checks that preserve data integrity, prevent analytics degradation, and maintain client trust.
  • Engage with clients to understand their data, its limitations, and analytical use cases, enabling actionable insights and informed business decision making.
  • Collaborate with analytics engineers, customer success, and product teams to align delivery with client expectations and to surface product opportunities informed by client needs and data behavior.
  • Partner with customer's leadership team to define and execute strategic roadmaps for enterprise data architecture, integration modernization and AI adoption.
  • Thoughtfully leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate and improve delivery, applying domain knowledge and human judgment to ensure sound output.
  • Keep your knowledge current regarding data security and privacy procedures and policies. Comply with HIPAA procedures and collaborate with the Incident Response Team as directed.

Qualifications

Required 

  • Bachelor’s degree. 
  • 4+ years of experience working with any of the healthcare data domains ( e.g. claims, provider billing, clinical or pharmacy).
  • Familiarity with healthcare data integration concepts, common data sources (payer data files or clinical/ EMR systems), data formats (claims, provider billing or HL7 ADT/ FHIR).
  • 4+ years implementing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and processes. 
  • 4+ years of experience in end-to-end data integration (data discovery, scoping, data cleansing and curation, analysis, transformation, validation and maintenance). 
  • Demonstrated expertise in SQL, relational database technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), enterprise data modeling with a strong focus on designing scalable, optimized and reusable data architectures.
  • Availability to work during U.S. Eastern (EST) or Central Time (CST) business hours.

Preferred 

  • Knowledgeable in healthcare interoperability / integration engines.
  • Experience with ELT or workflow orchestration tools such as Fivetran, dbt, SQLMesh, Dagster, or Airflow. While this role applies those concepts within Ursa Studio rather than using those tools directly, the ability to think in systems is a plus.
  • Experience building data models that support healthcare outcome measurement. Familiarity with value-based care data and financial models a plus.
  • Working understanding of Python or JavaScript to manipulate and transform large datasets and data science fundamentals.
  • Experience working with AI tools in a professional context, with the judgment to apply them appropriately in healthcare data environments where output accuracy is critical.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational change, influence leadership, communicate effectively across technical and business stakeholders, deliver measurable business value through strategic technology initiatives.

Location

  • United States, Position is Remote

Please apply to this job on your actual computer, not through a VPN, with your actual email address and actual phone number. We promise we will not misuse this personal information! This should allow your application to sail through our fraud filters, which are unfortunately struggling to differentiate real candidates from the avalanche of fraudulent candidates we're seeing. If any of these fraud alerts are triggered, we will verify that your LinkedIn page has a robust, credible history and we will reach out directly through LinkedIn DM to confirm your identity. Please be on the lookout for this message!

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bask

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

About the Role:

Reporting to the Customer Success & Engineering, the Customer Success Engineer's responsibilities include resolving customer concerns, creating and improving internal tooling, and engineering solutions to help Bask customers get the most out of the platform.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager, Product Value Realization
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge is scaling its BPaaS operations and must demonstrate quantifiable returns on its product investment decisions. This role exists to own that proof.

The Sr. Business Operations Manager, Product Value Realization owns collaboration and value creation between HealthEdge's product organization (structured by product line) and its delivery organization (structured by function). This role drives high-priority delivery-originated requests through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), ensuring that enhancement opportunities are properly framed, prioritized, and delivered, and that the value they were projected to create is rigorously validated after the fact.

Following delivery, the Sr. Business Operations Manager, Product Value Realization compares estimated vs. realized value to sharpen future assessments and inform prioritization. Requestors whose value estimates prove inaccurate will face heightened scrutiny on future submissions, creating accountability for credible business cases.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Product Governance & Initiative Execution
    • Own end-to-end PDLC governance for Delivery-originated requests across all phases: Articulate & Prioritize → Discovery → Solution & Size → Design & Build → Test → Release & Validate
    • Own the review of incoming delivery requests in partnership with the Product Operations team; validate problem statements, opportunity costs, and success criteria before requests advance
    • Translate strategic themes into initiative plans with detailed milestones, deliverables, and accountable owners
    • Lead end-to-end execution across multiple workstreams, guiding cross-functional teams through delivery
    • Apply PDLC governance standards consistently; track progress, risks, issues, and outcomes with structured methods
    • Own the weekly Product + Delivery alignment forum and deployment readiness cadence; deliver executive-ready status reporting
  • Value Measurement & Realization
    • Own the initiative KPI framework linking financial and operational outcomes to BPaaS operational metrics (e.g., FTE staffing requirements, time per transaction, SLA compliance rates)
    • Define and track both input metrics (e.g., share of requests with validated problem statements, PDLC cycle time per phase, estimate accuracy rate by requestor) and output metrics (e.g., FTE reduction, transaction time, SLA attainment) – and hold the distinction between the two clearly in all reporting

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Consumer CRM team delivers billions of messages a year across email, push, SMS, and in-app, and Q4 is our busiest stretch of the year. We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator to be the execution backbone of our CRM programs, building, QA'ing, and launching campaigns accurately and on time so Lifecycle Managers can focus on strategy and experimentation. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on campaign production and cross-functional coordination, and the person who fills it will see how their work shapes the customer journey and drives growth. A year from now, the team will launch more priority campaigns and run more experiments because this person is in the seat.

  • Created more capacity for growth by taking meaningful execution work off Lifecycle Managers' plates, enabling the team to launch more priority campaigns and experiments.

  • Turned campaign learnings into business improvements by spotting opportunities in results and execution insights, helping the team fix underperforming campaigns, expand what works, and prioritize work with greater impact.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

You take pride in delivering accurate, effective campaigns and genuinely enjoy the hands-on work of building and launching them. You're technically curious, quick to learn new tools, and bring an analytical mindset: you ask thoughtful questions about what drives campaign performance and want to learn how to turn results into improvements. You communicate proactively, keep many moving pieces on track, and flag blockers early.

  • Organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once and keep work moving
  • Proactive communication: clear status updates, coordination with partners, and early flagging of blockers
  • Technical curiosity and analytical thinking, including comfort learning new tools, troubleshooting issues, and asking questions about campaign performance

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Braze experience, helping you ramp quickly on our platform
  • Exposure to segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing, plus basic campaign reporting and interpreting results to identify improvements
  • Experience supporting automated lifecycle journeys (onboarding, retention, win-back), ideally in a consumer app or e-commerce business with recurring customer engagement

jobs.description:

Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term.

As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment.

We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. 

What the work looks like for our data team: 

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement
  • Serve as technical partner to program teams
  • Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies
  • Load-test our systems to prepare for elections 
  • Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching
  • Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness
  • Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting

Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar.

This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date.

Responsibilities
  • Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar
  • Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts
  • Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones
  • Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review
  • Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers
  • Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles
  • Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power
  • 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow
  • A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end
  • Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them
  • Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers
  • Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data
  • Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters
  • Experience on Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers

We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply.

    • Base salary of $90,000-$150,000
    • Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off
    • Remote first culture with teammates all around the country.
    • This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible.

Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time.

Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com.

Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States
URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling

SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.

About the role

We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.

This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.

What you will do

  • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

  • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

  • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

  • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

  • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

  • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

  • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

  • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

  • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

  • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

  • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

  • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

  • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

  • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

  • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

  • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

  1. Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

  2. Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

  3. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

  4. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

  5. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Switzerland | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.

A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
  • Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility
  • Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
  • Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape
  • Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers
  • Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material

What Makes you a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience
  • Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
  • You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
  • You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
  • You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically.
  • Must be located in Switzerland

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage
  • Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus

Compensation & Rewards

In Switzerland, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is CHF 206,000 - CHF 246,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Contracts - Data Center
jobs.description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function:

As a member of the Supply Chain team, the Senior Manager Contracts will play a critical role in the contractual strategy and execution for large-scale data center projects. This role will manage the development, negotiation, and administration of EPC, design-build, and related contractual agreements, supporting projects from RFP through close-out. The position requires an expert capable of optimizing risk allocation, compliance, schedule, and cost outcomes, representing ownership interests in all external and internal contractual matters.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead creation, issuance, and full-cycle management of RFPs for EPC, design-build, professional services, OFCI (owner-furnished contractor-installed) equipment, and major supply agreements.​
  • Negotiate and execute complex contract documents (EPC, design-build, LLE procurement) ensuring risk, schedule, and cost objectives are met.​
  • Develop, standardize, and update contract templates, terms, and negotiation playbooks tailored to fast-paced data center project delivery.​
  • Collaborate with legal, procurement, project management, engineering, and finance to ensure contractual compliance, scope clarity, and coordinated project delivery.​
  • Support the Project Team with change orders, claims, extensions, close-outs, and dispute resolution to minimize commercial impacts and maintain project momentum.​
  • Oversee vendor prequalification, bid evaluation, and long-lead equipment procurement processes.​
  • Track contract obligations, critical milestones, notice periods, and deliverables to ensure adherence to owner objectives.​
  • Report regularly on contracting activities, risk exposure, and project commitments to leadership.​

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, law, or a related field; Master’s or JD preferred.​
  • 5+ years of contract management experience within the data center, mission-critical infrastructure, or large-scale construction projects.​
  • Demonstrated success negotiating and administering EPC, design-build, and procurement contracts (including LLE/OFCI scopes) for data center projects.​
  • Strong working knowledge of contract law, construction regulations, commercial risk allocation, and claims/dispute management.​
  • Proficiency with contract management and document control software (Procore, MS Office, Adobe).​
  • Exceptional organizational, negotiation, problem-solving, interpersonal, and communications skills.​
  • Adept at managing multiple simultaneous priorities, deadlines, and high-value contracts in a fast-paced development environment.​
  • Experience with the full project lifecycle, from initial RFP through construction and close-out, for hyperscale or colocation data center assets is highly valued

If you are a highly motivated and detail-oriented professional with a passion for data centers and renewable energy, we invite you to apply for the Senior Manager Contracts position. Join our team and contribute to the success of our exciting projects in the sustainable energy industry.

Location: San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, CA, Denver, CO, Phoenix, AZ, Houston, TX or Remote.

The position could require up to 20% domestic travel (once normal travel requirements resume).

Base Pay - $160,000 - $190,000

The pay range mentioned above is a guideline. We tailor each offer based on your unique skills, experience, location, and market benchmarks—while ensuring internal parity across our teams. The compensation range provided reflects base pay. Total rewards may also include performance-based bonuses, equity grants, and a market leading comprehensive health and wellness benefits package. Final details will be discussed during the later stages of the hiring process.

Our Health & Wellness Benefits

At SB Energy, we invest in our people and their families with benefits designed for flexibility, support, and peace of mind. Full-time employees enjoy:

  • 100% Company-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision (for employees and dependents)
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Generous Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Holidays
  • 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Life, AD&D & Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for Medical, Dependent Care, Transit & Parking (with company contributions)
  • Mental, Physical & Social Wellness Support (with company contributions)
  • Flexible Work Arrangements & Hybrid Office Setup Benefits
  • Monthly Reimbursement for Phone, Internet & Data
  • Optional Legal & Pet Insurance Plans
  • Device Purchase Support

At SB Energy, the success of our projects is driven by a desire to see our projects benefit as many people as possible. We work to serve local communities through volunteering, fundraising, and much more. For example, we’re proud to support access and opportunity in engineering and clean energy through impactful mentorship programs and workforce training. When you join SB Energy, you can become a part of these efforts, collaborating with team members who share a vision of building a better future now!

SB Energy is built on a foundation of collaboration and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Director, GTM Operations
jobs.description:
AI at Zapier

At Zapier, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Zapier is the most connected AI orchestration platform, and the way companies discover, adopt and buy it is changing. Work increasingly starts with an agent that picks Zapier, proves itself in production and grows into a company-wide standard. I’m hiring a Director of GTM Operations to reimagine how our go-to-market operates as that shift happens, and to expand Zapier on Zapier, so our own teams showcase what AI orchestration can do at scale.

You’ll own GTM Operations end to end, leading about five direct reports across strategy, program management, and systems and platform architecture, plus operators embedded across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Partnerships. You’ll build a lot of the systems yourself, direct bigger builds through your team and our engineering partners, and own what you ship after launch. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Technical Operations and Automation Platform, and work directly with our CRO, Sales and Marketing leaders, Finance and our COO.

Our Sales and Marketing leaders set the targets and the strategy, and Finance owns comp and commissions. You own the systems, data and operating rhythm behind that strategy, and you’re accountable for whether it succeeds. You show leaders what’s working, tell them when the numbers point somewhere else, and bring them proposals for what should change, with the trade-offs laid out.

This is an AI transformation role for GTM. With agents handling more of the routine work, our teams can reach more customers, act faster when prospects show interest, and spend their time where a human makes the difference. You’ll lead that shift: start from what already exists, decide where agents have the most impact, build or direct them, and prove it’s working.

  • Our Commitment to Applicants

  • Culture and Values at Zapier

  • Zapier Guide to Remote Work

  • Zapier Code of Conduct

  • Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier

About You

  • You focus on business outcomes. You know the revenue targets, and measure your work by its impact.

  • You see across all of GTM. You look across the business, not just one team’s work. When several teams are solving the same problem in different ways, you notice, and drive alignment.

  • You build with AI and plan for what comes after launch. You’ve built or led the build of agents, automations and GTM systems such as routing, lead scoring or attribution. You can show what changed as a result. You design for scale from the start: who owns it, how it’s maintained, how it stays secure, and what governance it needs. You build small things yourself, and you understand larger builds well enough to direct engineering and judge whether they’ll hold up.

  • You decide what not to build. You start from the business goal and work back to what’s needed. You’d rather do fewer things well, and you retire what isn’t working instead of building around it.

  • You’ve owned GTM outcomes in a sales-led business. You’ve been accountable for how leads, pipeline, routing and revenue connect, and measured the results. That experience could come from RevOps, GTM engineering, pre- or post sales, or marketing leadership.

  • You’ve supported more than one sales motion at once. For example: self-serve, mid-market and enterprise. Ideally you’ve been through a shift from product-led to sales-led growth. You know where the rules need to differ between motions.

  • You work hands-on with data and systems. You write your own SQL, and you’ve worked in HubSpot or Salesforce and a data warehouse such as Databricks or Snowflake. You question numbers that look wrong, and when the data doesn’t support the plan, you say so.

  • You influence senior leaders. You’ve worked directly with VP- and executive-level leaders who wanted different things. You’ve laid out the options and trade-offs, helped them reach a decision, and secured people and budget through written proposals.

  • You lead distributed teams. You’ve managed people across time zones, including senior individual contributors. You address performance issues early, delegate ownership clearly, and make sure every system other teams rely on has a named owner, regular reviews and a plan for when it fails.

  • You drive adoption, not just delivery. You help leaders use their own data and test their own ideas, and you measure whether what you shipped is actually being used.

  • You’re comfortable with work that’s still taking shape. Parts of our GTM are experimental. You can support that without locking it into a fixed process too early.

Nice to have

  • You’ve got an engineering background. You’ve worked as a software or data engineer, so building and debugging come naturally to you.

  • You’ve seen a shift from PLG to SLG. You know what changes when a self-serve business shifts to Enterprise.

  • You’ve built lead scoring or prioritisation. You’ve designed ways to rank leads or accounts so reps know where to spend their time and what to do next.

  • You’ve used modern GTM tools. You’ve worked hands-on with tools like Clay, Gong or data enrichment platforms, and you know where they help and where they don’t.

What you'll do

  • Start with an audit. Review what already exists, including programs that have stalled, underutilized or abandoned tools, and reports and workflows that no longer serve the strategy. Once leaders agree, retire them, so new work isn’t built on top of old problems.

  • Reimagine GTM work with agents. Find where agents would make the biggest difference, build or direct them, measure what changes, and own them after launch, including maintenance, security and governance.

  • Own lead flow end to end. Make routing clear and reliable. Be the person who can explain how it works, and change it quickly when needed to drive outcomes. Define what counts as a misrouted lead, and track it weekly.

  • Deliver real-time lead routing and prioritization as your first major project. Every new lead gets sorted in real time so it reaches the right team for its likely deal size, and ranked so reps know which leads to act on first.

  • Own target account lists. Take the criteria Sales and Marketing leaders set, work with our data and enrichment vendors to build the lists, and keep them current.

  • Create one trusted set of GTM numbers. Build a standard set of metrics, with filters and drill-downs, that Sales and Marketing leaders use in their own business reviews.

  • Show what’s working. Build attribution across GTM so we can see what a deal was worth at the start, what changed, who worked on it, and which tactics made the difference.

  • Measure experiments. When a team tries something new, set up a simple way to tell whether it worked, and make sure the results reach the people who need them.

  • Turn decisions into delivery. When GTM leaders have agreed on what to do and how they’ll measure it, get it built through your team. You own the GTM Operations roadmap.

  • Run intake across GTM. Every request has a clear owner, a priority and a path. Balance day-to-day requests, larger roadmap projects and quick experiments so nothing important stalls.

  • Lead GTM Operations. Manage about five direct reports across strategy, program management, and systems and platform architecture, plus operators embedded across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Partnerships. Set direction, remove blockers and develop the team.

  • Partner across teams. Work with our AI engineering team on larger builds, a dedicated data partner on analysis, Revenue Enablement on rep coaching, and Finance and Business Operations on comp, commissions and deal desk.

  • Work transparently. Document decisions and trade-offs, and write the proposals that get leaders to agree and commit people and budget.

Impact matters more than tenure. You’ve led people, whether as a manager or a hands-on lead. You’ve set clear direction, made ownership clear, helped people grow, and addressed performance when it mattered. Beyond that, show us the best thing you’ve built or led with AI. Tell us what business problem it solved and why it was the right thing to build, including what you chose not to build. Tell us how you designed it to scale: who owns it, how it’s maintained and secured, and how it’s governed. And tell us what changed for the business, who uses it, and how you know it’s working.

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

Application Deadline:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Client Success
jobs.description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

Maven is looking for a high-energy, passionate, and detail-oriented Senior Associate to join our Client Success Team. As part of Maven’s Client Resources Team, you will play a critical role in supporting Maven’s rapidly growing SMB segment, a high-volume book of business with a high level of responsibility and visibility across the organization. You will partner with employers who come to Maven through our Channel partnerships or Direct, serving as the face of Maven for their ongoing needs by delivering thoughtful, speedy responses to inbound client requests, supporting engagement goals, performing utilization reviews, discussing communications strategies, and building relationships that turn satisfied clients into long-term advocates. You will also serve as the voice of the client internally, bringing insights that shape our product and program marketing.

As a Senior Client Success Associate at Maven, you will:

  • Serve as a member of the account team which manages our high-volume book of Small and Medium size Businesses (SMB)
  • Partner with your peers to deliver quick follow up to inbound questions, providing comprehensive, thoughtful, and speedy insights to our clients
  • Be the face of Maven for all client-related needs for ongoing relationship management and serve as the voice of the client internally by bringing insights to enhance product development and program marketing efforts
  • Help maintain happy and healthy business relationships with clients and channel partners; capture and own client issues to ensure customer success and loyalty
  • Maintain high level of client engagement, satisfaction and loyalty, as measured by high client satisfaction scores
  • Manage client issues and escalations, collaborate with partner teams such as member support, operations, analytics, product, and sales as required
  • Collaborate with channel contacts to build a strategic support model, leveraging Maven and channel partner expertise to forge a stronger client experience
  • Collaborate with health plan client executives and Maven internal sales team, to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio
  • Own communications to meet mutually agreed upon goals, including but not limited to external client meetings and other project plans; be prompt, responsive, and professional in all client-facing communications and interactions
  • Convert clients into Maven advocates, leveraging their successes for references, case studies, blogs, etc.

We’re looking for you to bring:

  • 2+ years experience in account management or client services role in digital health, healthcare, benefits or SaaS companies
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks; strong track record of high client satisfaction ratings and proven renewal success
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong interpersonal skills; must be able to develop and grow relationships with clients
  • Experience in working with the full lifecycle of customer success post sales (driving adoption, trainings/webinars, upsells, and account management)
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
  • Attention to detail and high degree of accuracy in task management and follow-up
  • Ability to identify systematic issues based on your experience working directly with clients and bring to appropriate cross-functional teams to identify and solve with process improvements

Helpful experiences and skills (if you don’t have them, you can learn them with us!):

  • Experience using tools including Salesforce, Looker (or other data visualization tools); attention to detail and CRM data entry hygiene

Experience with channel partners is preferred

  • Background in a healthcare-related field
  • Background in communications or digital marketing

The base salary range for this role is $85,000 - 95,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

jobs.title: Clinical Growth SDR
jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and is at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 1,000+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About Prosper Health

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults. We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We're growing 3x year over year, at high-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 600+ clinicians - and our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindness, and high performance, integrating perspectives from clinicians and autistic self-advocates.

Four of our favorite principles we operate by: Clients First (choose what makes life better for the client, even when it's harder for us), Find a Way (ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination), Raise the Bar (grow deliberately; give and seek feedback), and Be a Good Person (kind, honest, and tell the truth even when it's uncomfortable).

Why this role matters to the mission

Demand for our care is growing fast, and we’re scaling our clinical team alongside it. This means every psychologist you bring in translates to more neurodivergent adults who get care. This role is the front door to growing the team that delivers Prosper’s mission. Your job is to reach qualified licensed psychologists, spark interest, and hand warm candidates to our clinical recruiting team for interviews.

The role

A fast-paced, phone-forward outreach role, but not a cold-calling grind. You'll work from Scout, our internal sourcing platform, which hands you a daily list of strong-fit psychologists and runs the sequencing, scheduling, and tracking. No list-building or chasing dead numbers. You're starting real conversations with clinicians about an opportunity many of them want (flexible, remote, insurance handled, steady referrals, mission-aligned) and booking the interested ones to meet our clinical team. We brought an all-star SDR onto the team earlier this year to build and prove this out - we are now looking to grow the team!

The people who thrive in this role enjoy connecting with people all day, stay energetic through many conversations, and are motivated by the bigger picture: every yes is another clinician helping autistic adults get care.

Commitment & Schedule

  • 40 hours/week, remote (US)
  • Contractor part-time to start, with a path to permanent based on performance
  • Target start: late-Oct 2026.
  • When you'll work: Weekday daytime, roughly 9AM to 5 PM ET, but open to timezone preferences (e.g., working PT hours)

What you'll do

  • Run ~600 outbound calls and ~1,000 emails per week through Scout's worklist (you make the calls/leave voicemails, emails are automated)
  • Have warm, consultative first conversations with licensed psychologists
  • Book interested candidates into interviews; log every outcome
  • Hit weekly activity and booking targets (live-connect rate, interviews booked)
  • Give us feedback on what's landing and what isn't with actionable notes, so we improve the message

Compensation

  • Expected annualized compensation of ~$80,000. Structured as a $25/hour base plus a performance bonus for every psychologist hired from your outreach. On-target performance lands you at $80k, with room for material upside above that. The bonus is uncapped and largely in your hands.

What we're looking for

  • 1–3 years in a high-volume outbound role: SDR/BDR, inside sales, or phone-based fundraising
  • Comfortable on the phone
  • Organized and consistent; you can run the same sequence 100x/week without dropping follow-ups
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Coachable and metrics-driven; you want to see your numbers and smash them
  • Bonus: experience recruiting clinicians, healthcare; familiarity with a CRM/sequencing tool

Nice to have (not required)

  • Exposure to healthcare, behavioral health, or clinical hiring

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindness, and high performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients First - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant

Overview

Smartling is an AI-native translation platform that's redefining how the world's biggest brands go global — ranked #3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list. We're growing rapidly at scale and are backed by Battery Ventures, a global technology-focused investment firm. While most companies are still figuring out how to use AI, we've spent years building it into the core of our platform — and we're just getting started.

This person would work as part of the Sales team to surpass our revenue goals by driving the successful adoption of Smartling solutions while building great customer relationships. In addition, the Solution Consultant would contribute to tools and process improvements, as well as play a key role in account management and overall customer satisfaction and growth.

  • Create custom demonstrations based on customer needs
  • Demonstrate Smartling solutions
  • Manage pilot implementations with proven project management skills
  • Work with internal resources to solve customer issues
  • Build and sustain great customer relationships
  • Work with clients to identify business needs beyond the initial pilot phase
  • Provide customer support as needed
  • Develop new tools and process improvements
  • Contribute new feature requests and be a conduit for customer feedback

You Have

  • Comfortable with website technology, such as HTML/CSS, XML, JavaScript, etc
  • Proficient with CMS systems and website creation
  • Experience with databases and RESTful API integrations
  • Relevant work with SaaS/Hosted Solutions strongly preferred
  • Experience with mobile application development is a plus
  • Practiced Solution Selling or equivalent

You Will Enjoy

  • Freedom 🏡 - we are remote-first
  • Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career
  • Wealth 💰 - we offer a competitive salary and 401(k) + company match

jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The AVP, Suitability Review, leads the team responsible for evaluating and supporting suitability decisions across ESI. This highly visible role brings together sound judgment, regulatory discipline, operational leadership, and people development to ensure suitability reviews are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

Success in this role requires building a highly capable and engaged team that demonstrates critical problem solving/prevention in suitability review. The leader ensures that all work is processed timely, accurately and in accordance with applicable rules, regulations and Company requirements. Additionally, the leader ensures that stakeholders are kept pro-actively informed during the process and that decisions are communicated in an effective manner. This leader will cultivate a culture of continuous learning and process improvement and will inspire the department to expand their teams’ capabilities. The successful candidate will empower their leaders and associates and build trust with them to deliver on the promise our company represents. This role will report to the Senior Vice President, ESI Operations.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Provide vision, strategic planning insight and thoughtful solutioning expertise for the enterprise and functional group in a collaborative and positively differentiating way
  • Support the development of direct reports by fostering and supporting career development, motivating, engaging and capitalizing on employee strengths
  • Oversee the ESI Suitability Review unit, including responsibility for ensuring the firm’s Written Supervisory Procedures are followed regarding the review and acceptance of new accounts and daily transactions.
  • Build cross-functional partnerships with other business units and teams throughout the organization, including Distribution, Compliance, Legal, Technology, CIG, ESI New Business, ESI Brokerage, to deliver on business results and manage risk.
  • Establish a highly effective and highly engaged team, with positive morale
  • Work in partnership with members of ESI senior leadership team to ensure priorities are clear and are in line with business strategies
  • Provides direction on issue resolution and coaches on complex decisions with a bias towards root cause analysis
  • Prioritize, manage and oversee technology and other projects to improve departmental efficiency. Work closely with technology and service vendors to ensure requirements and service standards and are met.
  • Direct the amendment and creation of ESI forms related to new business and ongoing transactions, necessary to demonstrate compliance with rules, regulations and Company policies.
  • Serve as a point of escalation for jumbo cases, complex suitability issues and field conflict situations. Serve as back-up for the review and principal approval of new accounts and transactions, as necessary.

Job Requirements

  • A high level of attention to detail and strong people skills
  • Must be able to manage competing demands while being extremely adaptable and flexible

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.
