jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About Makai

Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. Our Makai Automation Platform consists of a library of pre-built components and modules to facilitate enterprise automation via a unified human-machine teaming interface. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people as technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions, as they serve as the final firewall for accuracy and quality.

About the role

Makai Labs is seeking a talented and highly adaptable Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting several areas of our lifecycle with new clients:

  • You will support the initial discovery process to understand how our clients do their work currently, capturing interview notes and parsing through their existing documentation, as well as documenting their present-day workflows and any associated files and data into comprehensive process diagrams.

  • During discovery, you will support the engineering team in understanding and documenting the current IT infrastructure and systems that our clients’ employees use to do their work. If the opportunity presents itself, you will also have the ability to assist the engineering team in building prototypes that align with the early vision of a business solution.

  • Once discovery is completed, you will support the team in solutions design and the testing and refinement of these new features with a select group of representative users.

  • Once the build is ready to pilot, you will participate in training new users on how to use the platform and capturing any feedback from users as they interact with it for the first time, owning a living roadmap of the build.

  • Once the solution launches, you will provide support for quickly resolving any issues our users encounter, as well as add items to the product backlog for any enhancements that can deliver better usability and functionality for our clients’ teams.

As a key player in these engagements, you will work closely with engineers, designers, product managers, and other stakeholders—both internal and client-facing—to drive innovation and problem-solving.

This role is an excellent fit for someone aspiring to grow into a Product Manager position, offering an opportunity to expand your skillset and impact the development of a new product.

The ideal candidate will be able to:

  • Exhibit strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex issues and data in a clear, concise manner.

  • Show excellence in documenting workflows into comprehensive process diagrams, with process mining experience being a huge plus.

  • Demonstrate experience in creating functional specifications for software development projects.

  • Think critically and creatively, using data to inform decisions and build impactful solutions.

  • Work in an agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and improve processes.

  • Display project management skills, with the ability to self-manage, prioritize and juggle multiple tasks effectively.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and analyze the user journey of our clients, creating process flows to identify areas of opportunity for improvement and enhancement.

  • Work to integrate existing technology developed by Makai into new client processes where applicable.

  • Collaborate with designers and product managers to develop and refine product ideas and features.

  • Lead client meetings, ensuring clear communication and follow-ups to address evolving needs and requirements.

  • Create and write functional specifications for all phases of the software development lifecycle.

  • Effectively communicate complex problems and analysis in both written and verbal forms, offering clear and actionable recommendations.

  • Develop and implement testing initiatives for product features, assessing their performance against core KPIs that align with business goals.

  • Maintain clear communication with internal teams and external partners to provide product support and meet internal deadlines.

  • Handle ad-hoc high-priority requests and work cross-functionally to meet tight deadlines and provide top-tier user support.

  • Adapt to fast-paced environments, demonstrating a willingness to take on various roles as needed.

  • Utilize creative thinking, combining quantitative and qualitative data to contribute to innovative solutions.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in a business analyst, financial analyst, or computer science role

  • Experience working in Jira or Azure DevOps (or similar platforms) within an Agile framework

  • The ability to prioritize quickly in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency in product lifecycle management processes and tools

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Operate with a sense of urgency and accountability

  • Possess a curiosity around the growing technology landscape

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SaaS, AI, or ML projects and/or experience with technical implementation

Core values for Makai employees

  • Have a strong work ethic. As a member of a fully remote team, it is very important that you can self-manage and drive your own work towards consistent excellence in a timely manner.

  • Be self-sufficient and self-driven with an ownership mentality, no matter your role

  • Be a flexible thinker

  • Be congenial and a team player

  • Always be of service to each other and our clients, partners, and neighbors

Benefits

  • Fully remote role

  • Opportunities to work in-person with local colleagues

  • Generous PTO

  • Full health insurance premium reimbursement

  • 401(k) matching

  • Career growth & development opportunities

jobs.title: Principal Enterprise Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What you’ll do:

As a Principal Onboarding Manager on the Success and Implementation team, you’ll own implementation, onboarding, and adoption across our enterprise accounts. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for district leaders, translating their goals, timelines, and needs into coordinated implementation plans, technical readiness, and strategies for sustained state-wide, district-wide, and school-level adoption. You’ll drive execution to ensure projects stay on track, stakeholders remain aligned, and districts are equipped to realize the full value of ClassDojo at scale.

You’ll bring deep expertise in how large districts plan, implement, and adopt technology. You know how to translate high-level goals and complex organizational needs into actionable project timelines, professional development recommendations, and communication plans. You’ll track progress through shared timelines and data, anticipate challenges, and identify opportunities for intervention to keep implementations moving forward. You’re highly detail-oriented, reliable, and an exceptional executive-level communicator who can coordinate across multiple departments, technical systems, and stakeholders.

You’ll work closely with leads in Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, and Technical Implementation to ensure partner needs are represented and coordinated internally. You proactively leverage emerging technologies and AI to work more effectively, strengthen collaboration, and deliver consistently exceptional partner experiences.

This is a full-time, remote position reporting to the Principal District Partnerships Manager with an expected start in early 2027.

Responsibilities:

Owning implementation at scale

  • Lead end-to-end district onboarding and project management across a portfolio of up to 20 enterprise districts, ensuring projects are delivered on time, accurately and in alignment with multi-stakeholder goals.

  • Co-develop district rollout and year-round professional development plans, and manage district-specific communication strategies, including co-branded communications.

  • Report to key internal stakeholders consistently, and proactively share mitigation and acceleration steps.

Driving adoption through testing and refining

  • Be creative in how you drive school-level adoption: build relationships with school-level champions, gather school leader feedback, and share insights with district leaders to inform your recommendations.

  • Design curated enablement experiences that reflect each district's technology ecosystem, and create custom PD pathways and communications that address adoption barriers.

  • Test and define new adoption strategies within partner districts using usage and engagement data, then scale what works.

Leading across teams and partners

  • Partner with the segment’s District Partnerships Manager and Account Executives to facilitate kickoffs and align stakeholders, making sure every participating department is represented.

  • Coordinate between district IT teams and internal technical specialists on SSO, roster integrations, and data validation and accuracy.

  • Serve as the liaison between the enterprise segment and ClassDojo’s Engineering and Product teams, translating enterprise needs into prioritized work that moves districts forward.

  • Continuously improve onboarding systems, processes, and workflows with the broader Success and Implementation team, and guide partners in maximizing ClassDojo's products and services.

Requirements:

  • Senior-level project management experience (5+ years) in a K-12 SaaS environment, with a record of running enterprise-scale projects to deadline

  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple complex, high-stakes projects on tight deadlines with a high level of organization and accuracy

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience synthesizing implementation data into executive-ready summaries and recommendations

  • High empathy and emotional intelligence: ability to understand customer goals and find workable solutions to their needs.

  • Experience working on cross functional projects with multiple internal stakeholders

  • Experience in edtech, working with K-12 schools and districts, and/or working on products for kids or educators

  • Ability to learn new technology and products quickly

  • Familiarity with using organization and design tools such as: Asana, Smartsheet, Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, Notion, Claude

  • Ability to use data and timelines together to track progress and adjust an implementation strategy as it evolves

  • Experience building relationships with senior, multi-department stakeholders and executive leaders, with the executive presence to lead conversations with district and company leadership

  • Comfort with technical topics such as SSO, rostering, and data integrations, and the ability to partner with technical specialists and district IT teams

  • Willingness to travel in person to visit district partners at least 1 time per year, such as kickoffs and strategic planning sessions

  • Experience working in a customer-facing capacity with K-12 district leaders and/or working directly in a district setting

Bonus:

  • Project management certifications (e.g., Six Sigma/Lean, PMP, PPM, CSPO, CSM, SAFe)

  • Experience in high growth organizations

  • Experience working directly in a district setting

[1] Some more context:

  • TechCrunch Article: Second Act comes with First Profits

Click here if you're interested in learning more about what we've been up to.

We are happy to accommodate any disabilities or special needs. We are a distributed company, so we hire regardless of location, as long as you are willing to have significant hours overlap with one of the Americas time zones.

jobs.title: Regional Clinical Advisor
jobs.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Regional Clinical Advisor (RCA) provides relevant and timely clinical and technical expertise cross-functionally at Kestra to meet business objectives. The RCA supports regional market development, medical education, and training activities. They serve as the regional customer and field technical resource and provide expertise and leadership in the areas of customer education and clinical evidence interpretation. Responsible for developing key customer relationships and serving as the primary contact based on region-specific needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Partner with Territory Managers and the Marketing/Training/Clinical/MedEd team to execute regional market development plans, including developing target accounts, educating referral sources, and supporting growth opportunities.
  • Build and maintain relationships with regional key opinion leaders, physicians, and clinical champions to expand Kestra’s presence and influence.
  • Share regional market intelligence and competitive insights with Marketing and Training to inform strategy, messaging, and training.
  • Stay current on publications and clinical evidence in the cardiac space to build awareness and drive adoption of Kestra therapies among prescribers and care teams.
  • Support Territory Managers and Marketing/Training/MedEd team with critical customer meetings and activitiesServe as technical resource to customers and sales team for complex cases. Provide highly technical explanation of and demonstration of products to customers
  • Support clinical and technical aspects of training programs for new hires and advanced education of existing team members to build competency and drive market adoption of Kestra therapies.
  • Adhere to Pledge of Confidentiality
    • Information regarding a patient of this company shall not be released to any source outside of this company without the signed permission of the patient. Furthermore, information will only be released internally on a need-to-know basis. All Team Members will not discuss patient cases outside the office or with anyone not employed by this company unless they are directly involved with the patient’s case.

COMPETENCIES

  • Passion: Contagious excitement about the company – sense of urgency. Commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Integrity: Commitment, accountability, and dedication to the highest ethical standards.
  • Collaboration/Teamwork: Inclusion of Team Member regardless of geography, position, and product or service; team-oriented approach
  • Action/Results: High energy, decisive planning, timely execution.
  • Innovation: Generation of new ideas from original thinking
  • Customer Focus: Exceed customer expectations, quality of products, services, and experience always present of mind.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Recognizes, understands, manages one’s own emotions and is able to influence others. A critical skill for pressure situations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to communicate with and assist clinicians providing care for patients.
  • Interest and desire for life-long learning and continuous improvement.
  • Market Development: Proactively identifies opportunities to expand awareness and adoption of Kestra therapies.
  • Project management and ability to work with multiple co-occurring projects

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience Required:

  • Bachelors degree
  • 3+ years of clinical experience in electrophysiology, cardiology, nursing, and/or the medical device field
  • Direct cardiac patient care experience – RN, RT, CVIS, Paramedic, CRM
  • Experience in patient, clinician, and internal company education
  • Proven examples in development and execution of clinical training programs
  • Excellent presentation and public speaking skills; Ability to provide instruction and instill confidence in Assure patients with demonstrated patient care skills
  • Ability to understand and contribute to commercial goals within the assigned region and nationally
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new market opportunities, relationships, and clinical champions
  • Valid driver’s license in state of residence with a satisfactory driving record

    • Documentation of vaccination and immunization status
    • Passing of a background check
    • Passing of a drug screening test
    • Reviewing and agreeing to hospital policies and procedures

Preferred:

  • Bachelors degree, specifically in nursing, sciences, or engineering
  • Knowledge of MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Teams
  • Experience working in sales, market development, or a sales support role

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORK ENVIRONMENT

OTHER DUTIES

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

About the role

The Sales Development Representative generates qualified sales opportunities with organizations in an assigned territory or segment: either government grantmaking or a hybrid segment for corporate CSR and enterprise nonprofit grantmakers. The role researches target accounts, identifies the stakeholders responsible for grant and application programs or CSR initiatives, starts and nurtures conversations with them, and schedules qualified meetings for Account Executives.

The role works closely with Account Executives on account plans and follow-up, including prospects with longer buying cycles. Accurate qualification and timely, relevant outreach help organizations find better ways to run the programs that serve their communities.

Key responsibilities

  • Prospect into target organizations in the assigned territory or segment, researching each account to identify the stakeholders most likely to own grant, funding, or application program needs.
  • Run outbound outreach by phone, email, and social channels to start conversations with target stakeholders, working toward the activity and meeting goals set for the role.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s program challenges, and qualify opportunities against Submittable’s criteria before scheduling meetings for Account Executives.
  • Nurture prospects who are not yet ready to engage or who have longer buying processes, following plans agreed with Account Executives so follow-up stays timely and consistent.
  • Answer prospect questions promptly and accurately, and bring in an Account Executive when a question goes beyond the role’s scope.
  • Build and maintain working knowledge of Submittable’s platform and how its features address prospects’ needs.
  • Keep prospect, account, and activity records accurate and current in the CRM and sales engagement tools to support pipeline tracking and smooth handoffs.
  • Share prospect feedback and suggest improvements to messaging, outreach sequences, and processes with the Sales Development team.

Skills & Competencies

  • 1+ year of experience in sales development, business development, inside sales, or a similar role with outbound prospecting and meeting goals.
  • Working experience with a CRM and a sales engagement platform; experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, and Gong preferred.
  • Familiarity with the industries in the assigned territory or segment and how organizations in them make purchasing decisions, preferred. Please identify in your application if you have experience with government, NPO, or corporate CSR markets.
  • Prospecting and qualification: researches accounts to find the right stakeholders, asks discovery questions that uncover a prospect’s needs, and books meetings that meet agreed qualification criteria.
  • Communication: writes clear, concise outreach and holds phone conversations tailored to each prospect’s role and organization.
  • Handling objections: responds to questions and concerns with accurate information, and follows up on anything that can’t be answered right away.
  • Collaboration: works with Account Executives on account plans, shares complete notes at each handoff, and follows through on agreed next steps.
  • Organization: manages a high volume of outreach and follow-up across many accounts, prioritizes by account potential and timing, and tracks commitments to completion.
  • Learning and feedback: asks for feedback, applies it, and adjusts outreach based on results.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation: The on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are $70,000–$90,000, which includes base salary plus variable compensation tied to performance. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official submittable.com email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to people@submittable.com. (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)

Why Submittable?

Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.

At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!

Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:

  • Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
  • 401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
  • Equity stock options to share in our success
  • Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
  • Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
  • Professional development stipends to support your career growth
  • Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
  • Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture.

We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good.

As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background.

About Our Process

Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly.

Let's Talk About AI:

Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process: At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know.

For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please click here.

We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.

jobs.title: Senior Programmatic Trader (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Programmatic Trader (m/f/d)

Berlin, Bangalore, Remote

________________________

Hello👋I am Willian, Trading and Analytics Lead at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Senior Programmatic Trader to join our team 🙌

About Kayzen

Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. Available through self-serve and managed services, Kayzen combines machine-learning optimisation with bid - and impression-level transparency, granular control over buying decisions, and AI capabilities that connect campaign data to the AI assistants teams already use. Kayzen’s vision is to democratise programmatic marketing by making it accessible to every team. Headquartered in Berlin, Kayzen operates globally.

The Team

The Trading team is responsible for creating growth through the management and optimization of mobile performance advertising campaigns for clients utilizing the managed service offering. The goal of the team is to deliver on the client's objectives through established or new trading best practices and communicate account status regularly and effectively with their CSM counterparts.

Why this role

In this role, you will own and grow a portfolio of mobile programmatic campaigns (UA/RT) across verticals including gaming, fintech, betting, and CTV, delivering CPA/ROAS targets while scaling FCT and protecting contribution margin. You'll pair deep trading skills with analytics (SQL must have / Python desirable. What matters most: the analytical instinct to ask the right questions and the resourcefulness to find answers, whether through code or AI tools) and LLM-accelerated workflows to move faster than a traditional desk. You won't just optimize campaigns, you'll shape the tools, analytical frameworks, and trading playbooks the team uses to win.

What you’ll do

Trading excellence

  • Own end-to-end campaign delivery across multiple advertisers; hit KPI targets (CPA, ROAS, retention) and scale when unit economics allow.
  • Develop audience targeting strategies and supply-side optimization (audience, publisher selection, bid shading, dayparting) across ad formats (banner, video, native, CTV) to unlock incremental scale.
  • Build and execute testing roadmaps (optimization models, bids, budgets, frequency, creatives, geos, etc.) to drive incremental lift.
  • Manage pacing, budget allocation, and risk across an account book, proactively mitigating under-delivery.
  • Understand mobile attribution dynamics (postback flows, attribution windows, deterministic vs probabilistic matching, iOS privacy frameworks) and how they shape bidding strategy, audience targeting, and performance interpretation across MMPs.
  • Champion process improvements, author tools/queries, and mentor juniors to raise team throughput.

Analytics & automation

  • Dive into log-level and aggregated data to diagnose performance; write production-grade SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions) and Python/pandas analyses (or sharp use of AI)
  • Design and interpret tests, translating findings into the Trading Playbook.
  • Leverage LLMs (GPT/Claude) to automate recurring analyses (bid curves, cohort reads, anomaly triage), create data briefs, and draft experiments.
  • Contribute to internal dashboards and trading intelligence tools that accelerate decision-making across the team.

Cross-functional impact

  • Partner with CSM/Sales on growth plans and QBRs; influence Product with crisp, quantified feedback; collaborate with Supply on inventory quality.
  • Work with DS/DA on model inputs, new testing hypotheses or model improvements, and with Product Support to quickly unblock delivery.

Since I am based in Argentina and other key product and customer success team members are located mostly across EMEA and India, we are open to a remote setup of this position. For optimal overlap with customers’ time zones and internal teams your main working location should preferably be close to the CET time zone.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of programmatic ad buying experience; mobile in-app DSP experience preferred.
  • Hands-on with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular), postback flows, fraud detection, and reporting tools.
  • Data-driven decision making; comfortable building and modifying SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions a plus). Familiarity with BI tools. Familiarity with AI is a must.
  • Nice-to-have: Python/pandas for ad-hoc analyses and light automation; experience is a plus but not required.
  • Nice-to-have: CTV/OTT programmatic buying experience.
  • Solution orientation and drive to succeed.
  • Communication: crisp written analysis and cross-team collaboration. Client-facing confidence preferred.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive compensation with a performance-based component
  • Exceptional career growth. Shape trading playbooks, product, mentor junior traders, and influence the tools and analytical frameworks the team builds around you.
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market

About the role

The Mid-Market Account Executive drives new business and expansion revenue for Submittable's grants management and corporate social responsibility (CSR) software with mid-sized organizations, including foundations, nonprofits, and corporations. The role manages the full sales cycle, from building pipeline through closing, and is accountable for achieving monthly, quarterly and annual quota and KPIs.

  • Respond promptly and accurately to prospect and customer questions, partnering with Solutions Engineering and other teams when a deal needs specialist input.
  • Review sales metrics with the Sales Manager, share customer and vertical insights with Marketing and Sales, and suggest improvements to sales plays and processes.
  • Maintain current Submittable Sales certifications and complete required training.

Skills & Competencies

  • 3+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, including closing new business through a full sales cycle.
  • Experience qualifying and managing deals with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. Why Submittable?

Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.

Whether the outcomes they look for are app installs, new customers, purchases and repeat purchases or upper funnel goals like engagement and brand lift.

Requirements

What do we offer?

  • Competitive fixed compensation (+ variable compensation tied to revenue goals)

  • Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, UK, India and many more countries, soon the US

jobs.title: Sustainment Training Analyst
jobs.description:
VA EHR Modernization – EHRM SISS | Full-time | Remote

SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission-focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector. Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success.

At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem-solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.

Position Overview

SteerBridge is seeking a data-driven Sustainment Training Analyst to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) program. Working with our program partners and the Post Implementation Training team, this remote position manages the transition from EHR deployment training to ongoing sustainment and measures whether that training is working.

The analyst owns training data end to end: defining outcome measures, collecting and analyzing results, and building dashboards and visualizations that give program leadership a clear view of training effectiveness, readiness, and risk. The role also carries real project management responsibility within the training team, including plans, schedules, dependencies, and deliverables across VA, vendor, and site stakeholders. Success requires an analytical, organized professional who can turn data into decisions and keep complex, multi-party training work on track.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Training Data, Measurement & Analytics

  • Design and apply methods to measure and evaluate training outcomes (e.g., completion, proficiency, knowledge retention, post-training performance, and user adoption), using frameworks such as the Kirkpatrick Model.
  • Collect, clean, validate, and analyze training data from LMS reports, surveys, assessments, ServiceNow tickets, and other program sources.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and data visualizations (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel) that track training readiness, completions, effectiveness, and trends across sites and user roles.
  • Translate analysis into clear findings and recommendations that drive curriculum updates, targeted retraining, and continuous improvement.
  • Present training metrics and program status to leadership in executive-ready briefings and reports.

Project Management

  • Plan and manage sustainment training workstreams, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, resources, and deliverables.
  • Lead coordination among VA stakeholders, EHR vendor training teams, site leads, and program partners to transition deployment training into sustainable post-implementation operations.
  • Track assignments, open issues, risks, and action items; identify gaps early and drive them to resolution.
  • Facilitate stakeholder meetings, document decisions and action items, and communicate progress, dependencies, and risks to program leadership.
  • Coordinate updates to training materials and communications tied to EHR software releases, workflow changes, and program priorities.

Reporting, Documentation & Support

  • Prepare accurate weekly status reports, PMO updates, leadership briefings, PowerPoint presentations, and client-facing communications.
  • Support development and maintenance of SOPs, process documentation, training guidance, and transition or handoff materials.
  • Triage and track training-related inquiries, incidents, and ad hoc requests using ServiceNow or comparable tools.
  • Provide program leadership with accurate information and materials for VA client requests and authorized external inquiries.

Required Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, education, information systems, data analytics, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in training operations, learning analytics, IT program coordination, or a related analyst role.
  • Demonstrated experience measuring and evaluating training outcomes, including defining metrics, collecting data, and reporting on training effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing and visualizing data, including building and maintaining dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel (PivotTables, Power Query, charts), or comparable tools.
  • Solid project management experience—planning, scheduling, tracking risks and dependencies, and delivering on deadlines—ideally within a training or learning and development team.
  • Experience preparing professional PowerPoint presentations, concise status reports, and executive-ready summaries.
  • Ability to coordinate with government or enterprise clients, vendors, program managers, and cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
  • Working knowledge of training delivery, adult learning principles, and ongoing user support for enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or comparable issue-tracking or service-management systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and analytical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting VA EHR Modernization, healthcare IT, electronic health record systems, or federal health programs.
  • Experience with training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick, Phillips ROI) and learning analytics.
  • Experience pulling and reporting data from learning management systems; SQL or similar query skills a plus.
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, or Agile/Scrum) or formal PM training.
  • Experience supporting post-go-live training, sustainment transitions, organizational change management, or enterprise software releases.
  • Background in federal consulting, PMO reporting, or large-scale technology modernization.
  • Experience developing job aids, quick reference guides, SOPs, or training plans.

Compensation

The posted compensation range reflects the scope and requirements of this position. A final offer will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and work location, along with the responsibilities of the position. Where applicable, contract requirements, wage determinations, and federal contract labor categories may also inform the offer.

SteerBridge also offers benefits that may include health and life insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, disability coverage, retirement savings, and professional development opportunities. Benefits vary by position and eligibility.

Additional Information

SteerBridge is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants and employees are treated with respect and dignity—regardless of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We also provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require assistance during the application process, we encourage you to reach out so we can support your needs.

The Enterprise Account Executive, State Government, leads new business sales of Submittable's grants management and application software to state agencies and large local government organizations. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis.
  • Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes.
  • Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems.
  • Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements.
  • Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making.
  • Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods.
  • Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain.
  • Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems.
  • Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals.
  • Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation.
  • Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data.
  • Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability.
  • Experience building field-failure analysis, anomaly detection, predictive-maintenance, or early-warning systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware development and launch processes, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and field-test programs.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Oura scales and prepares for life as a public company, equity compensation and non-routine technical accounting questions are becoming larger and more complex. We’re looking for a Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting to own stock-based compensation accounting and equity reporting end to end, and to serve as a technical accounting resource on complex and non-recurring transactions.You’ll own ASC 718 accounting and the equity roll-forwards, reconciliations, footnotes, and disclosures that flow from it; work through the accounting for share repurchases; document accounting positions in clear memos; and build SOX-ready processes and controls. You’ll partner closely with Legal, Stock Administration, Payroll, Tax, Corporate Finance, FP&A, Business Systems, and our external auditors.

What You Will Do:

Stock-based compensation accounting (ASC 718)

  • Own the monthly stock-based compensation close: validate grant, vesting, forfeiture, and termination data, calculate and record expense by function, and prepare the related journal entries.
  • Review valuation inputs and assumptions (e.g., Black-Scholes, 409A) with valuation specialists and support the related audit evidence.
  • Account for modifications, cancellations, repurchases, and settlement mechanics, including net share settlement.
  • Reconcile the cap table and equity administration platform to the general ledger, and resolve differences promptly.

Equity reporting and disclosures

  • Prepare and review equity roll-forwards, APIC and stockholders’ equity activity, and stock-based compensation disclosures for quarterly and annual financial statements.
  • Maintain audit-ready support and tie-outs for every equity figure in the financial statements and disclosures.

Liquidity events and capital structure

  • Lead the accounting analysis for tender offers, secondary transactions, IPO-related events, and corporate reorganizations as they affect employee equity.
  • Lead the modeling process around the expected financial statement impact of an IPO on equity awards, including expense recognition, net settlement, and tax withholding, and keep the model current as timing and terms evolve.

Technical accounting and policy

  • Research complex accounting questions under US GAAP and write clear, well-supported technical memos that document facts, guidance, analysis, and conclusions.
  • Serve as a technical resource on non-routine transactions beyond equity, as needed - areas could include: debt vs. equity accounting (ASC 480), debt (ASC 470), leases (ASC 842), business combinations (ASC 805), and global entity matters.
  • Assist with drafting, updating, and maintaining accounting policies, and monitor new standards and SEC guidance for their impact on Oura.

Controls and audit

  • Design, document, and operate key controls over equity and technical accounting in partnership with the SOX team, and remediate gaps promptly.
  • Serve as a primary contact for external auditors on equity and technical accounting, including walkthroughs, PBC requests, and technical discussions.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including Big 4 or national firm experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on expertise in ASC 718, including options, RSUs, performance-condition awards, modifications, repurchases and tender offers.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting, with experience in ASC 718.
  • Experience producing equity roll-forwards, footnotes, and disclosures for audited financial statements, and reconciling an equity administration platform (e.g., Carta, Shareworks) to the general ledger.
  • Demonstrated ability to research complex technical matters independently and write defensible accounting memos.
  • Experience designing and operating SOX or other internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex topics to non-accounting partners, and a record of mentoring or managing others.

Nice to have:

  • Public company or IPO-readiness experience.
  • Workiva and Shareworks experience.
  • Experience in consumer hardware, health technology, or subscription businesses.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
jobs.description:
As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise.

This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first
  • Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket
  • Lead discovery inside flat, engineering-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on
  • Run full-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely
  • Act as an extension of the customer’s engineering/observability team rather than an external operator - this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break
  • Work Slack-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask
  • Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near-real-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it
  • Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second - savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener
  • Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last
  • Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome
  • Hands-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each
  • Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP)
  • Comfortable in flat organizations - able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy
  • Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits
  • Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth - scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly
  • Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt
  • Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one
  • Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement
  • Willing to travel for multi-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

$149,000—$198,000 USD

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for an IT Engineer to design the systems behind how people at Baseten get access, stay secure, and move through their time here. This role builds the controls and automation that our IT Operations team runs every day across identity, client platforms, SaaS, and cloud access.

The goal is a corporate environment that’s secure by default and easy to use: access that’s right from day one, removed when it should be, and provable at any time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strengthen our identity platform with strong authentication, clean access models, and least privilege as the default.

  • Automate the workforce lifecycle so that joining, changing roles, and leaving Baseten are fast, consistent, and need little manual work.

  • Build reliable pipelines for OS updates, patching, and software deployment that keep the fleet current without disrupting people’s work.

  • Connect device health to access decisions, so a compliant device is what earns access to sensitive systems.

  • Recommend identity and security standards for our SaaS and AI tools, and make the secure configuration the easy path for teams adopting new ones.

  • Bring governance to non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, AI agents) and replace long-lived credentials with better options wherever possible.

  • Manage configuration as code across identity and endpoints to reduce drift, so audit readiness comes from the systems themselves instead of a separate workstream.

  • Give IT Operations well-designed tools and guardrails, so they can handle more requests on their own, safely.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in IT engineering or corporate security engineering, ideally at a cloud-native company.

  • Strong grounding in identity: SSO, MFA, provisioning, and the protocols behind them.

  • Hands-on experience engineering macOS fleets at scale: MDM, configuration profiles, app packaging and deployment, and endpoint visibility and EDR tooling.

  • Experience automating real workflows in code (Python, Bash, or similar), and comfort with infrastructure-as-code.

  • A working understanding of SaaS and cloud access risks, and how to reduce them without blocking the business.

  • Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to leave something alone.

  • Clear writing, and a track record of working across IT, People, Engineering, Legal, GRC and Security.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - FedD180/FedD181
jobs.description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE AN ACTIVE SECRET CLEARANCE TO APPLY.

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Platform Engineer to join our platform team — a combined DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering team responsible for the development, maintenance, and reliability of a cloud-based platform environment. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver with hands-on experience in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD, and is motivated by building and improving the systems that other teams depend on.

In this role, you will work across infrastructure as code, automated deployments, identity and access management, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines. You will serve as a bridge between application teams and the platform, advocating best practices and helping ensure that the platform is reliable, secure, and scalable. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, contributing to documentation and standards where they exist, and building them where they don’t.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve Kubernetes clusters and containerized application deployments across cloud environments (AWS, EKS, RKE2)
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision and configure platform resources consistently and repeatably
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, including GitLab CI configuration, runner deployments, and automated build and deployment workflows
  • Support identity and access management through tools such as Keycloak, including user onboarding, role configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging to ensure platform health and support incident investigation
  • Manage certificate lifecycle operations, including renewal of public certificates and related automation
  • Contribute to platform security posture through container security practices, Iron Bank image compliance, and support for ATO processes
  • Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, broken pipelines, and platform integration problems
  • Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, architecture decision records (ADRs), and operational standards
  • Influence the strategic vision by contributing to the strategic planning that aligns technological advancements with the mission objectives.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support platform incidents in a tier 2 role
  • Mentor and support junior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 5-10%

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance to start
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deploying, managing, and troubleshooting clusters and workloads)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tooling, particularly GitLab CI or equivalent pipeline platforms
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and command-line administration
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC)
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, container image builds, registry management)
  • Ability to read and write YAML fluently for Kubernetes manifests, CRDs, Helm charts, and pipeline configurations
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
  • Possess or ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT II certification (e.g., Security+ CE)

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience with UDS Core, Iron Bank, and/or Continuous Authority to Operate (C-ATO) processes
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Keycloak or similar
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Go, Python, or Bash scripting)
  • Experience working in a DevSecOps model with secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation
  • Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools (e.g., Flux, ArgoCD)
  • Department of Defense experience, specifically working on a production ATO’d system
  • Experience with distributed architectures and everything-as-code approaches

Mid Platform Engineer: $123,250 - $166,750

Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises.
