jobs.title: Senior / Lead Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is looking for a Senior / Lead Program Manager to help develop and execute our asset-light model for expanding AI infrastructure through partnerships.

You will work at the intersection of strategy, finance, commercial negotiations and execution. Your focus will be to turn complex partnership opportunities into clear business cases, workable commercial terms and agreements that support the needs of Nebius, our partners and our customers.

This role suits someone who combines structured problem-solving with strong financial understanding and the ability to move work forward across multiple teams. You should be comfortable assessing commercial trade-offs, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and taking responsibility for progress.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional responsibility. You will lead projects and influence stakeholders without direct line-management responsibility.

What you’ll do

  • Develop commercial frameworks and term sheets. Define proposed terms for asset-light partnerships, balancing financial returns, risk, responsibilities and the interests of Nebius and its partners.
  • Support the partnership team. Build the operational framework, track and report progress, develop commercial guidelines
  • Build business cases with Finance. Coordinate the analysis supporting partnership proposals, working through financial models, testing assumptions and assessing how different commercial terms affect the economics.
  • Shape contractual and legal structures. Partner with Legal and relevant business teams to translate the commercial model into practical structures and agreements for partners and customers.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Bring together Finance, Legal, commercial, technical and operational stakeholders, establishing clear ownership, resolving dependencies and maintaining momentum.
  • Prepare decisions and recommendations. Turn complex information into clear options, explain trade-offs and help stakeholders reach informed decisions.
  • Develop repeatable ways of working. Capture lessons from individual partnerships and improve the frameworks, templates and processes that support the model as it grows.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in management consulting or a strategy and operations role within a technology business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down unfamiliar, complex problems and develop practical recommendations.
  • Financial fluency: you can read and work with financial models, challenge assumptions and explain the commercial implications of the numbers. A specialist financial analyst background is not required.
  • Experience developing business cases, assessing commercial opportunities or supporting complex transactions and partnerships.
  • Confidence working with commercial terms and contracts alongside finance and legal specialists.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align teams with different priorities and influence without formal authority.
  • The initiative and judgment to drive projects independently, manage ambiguity and recognise when a decision needs wider input.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, particularly when presenting analysis and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Revenue operations background: Supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.

Experience that would be valuable

  • Work on large, complex projects in data centres, digital infrastructure, real estate, power or related sectors.
  • Revenue operations background: supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.
  • Exposure to partnership models, infrastructure economics or arrangements involving several commercial counterparties.
  • Experience taking a strategic recommendation through negotiation and into implementation.
  • Sector experience is valuable, but we are also interested in strong generalists who can learn a new business model quickly and apply sound commercial judgment.

Why join Nebius

Nebius is scaling a new generation of AI infrastructure across EMEA. You will have genuine ownership of how that infrastructure is designed, standardised and delivered, working on complex projects where technical judgement has a direct impact on speed, capacity and long-term operational performance.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Career growth and continuous learning
  • Flexibility, trust and real ownership
  • An international environment with highly experienced technical teams
  • The opportunity to shape infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI

Equal opportunity

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Please tell us if you need an accommodation during the application process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Technical Lead - Golang
jobs.description:
This is a permanent, full-time remote opportunity open to candidates based in the UK. While the role is primarily remote, occasional travel to client sites across the UK may be required to attend meetings, workshops and other project-related activities.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.

Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering as either a Senior Engineer leading projects and mentoring or as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, you will ideally be using Golang, experience with additional other languages such as JavaScript or Python would be desirable.
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills
  • Financial services industry experience

Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins, Zoom)
A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:

Architecture Design – We want to see how you approach a high level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
Technical Implementation – How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
Code Standards and Feedback – We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (Europe)
jobs.description:
About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

About the Role:

We are looking for a seasoned Enterprise Account Executive to lead our expansion in the European market. In this role, you will be responsible for navigating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles with some of the largest chemical and manufacturing enterprises in the region.

You will act as a strategic partner to procurement leaders and supply chain executives, helping them modernize their sourcing operations through Valdera’s cutting-edge technology. This is a high-impact role for a consultative seller who understands the intricacies of industrial supply chains and can navigate large organizations to close significant deals.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for large enterprise accounts across Europe, with a specific focus on the industrial hubs within the DACH region.
  • Navigate complex organizations by building consensus across multiple stakeholders, including CPO (Chief Procurement Officers), R&D heads, Supply Chain leads, and IT/Digital Transformation directors.
  • Go beyond transactional sales; diagnose deep-seated supply chain inefficiencies and present Valdera as a strategic solution for resilience, cost savings, and speed-to-market.
  • Act as the "boots on the ground" for our European expansion, providing feedback to Product and Leadership teams on regional market nuances, regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH), and customer needs.
  • Rigorously manage your pipeline and forecast with accuracy, ensuring a consistent flow of new business opportunities.
  • Proactively iterate on and improve Valdera’s sales playbook and process, including lead generation, discovery, follow-up messaging, negotiations, and closing strategies.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: 5–10 years of total working experience.
  • Sales Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of closing experience in enterprise sales (Global 2000), specifically managing multi-threaded deals with average contract values (ACV) that require executive-level sign-off.
  • English: Native or professional fluency is required.
  • German: Business fluency is highly preferred to effectively manage relationships with key stakeholders in the DACH region.
  • Highly Desirable: Experience selling into the Chemicals, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain/Procurement sectors. You understand the language of BOMs, RFQs, and raw material sourcing.
  • Acceptable: A strong background in Management Consulting (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG) focused on operations/supply chain, combined with proven sales experience.
  • Enterprise DNA: You have experience navigating the bureaucracy of large enterprises and have the patience and grit to drive deals to completion.
  • Location: Remote within Europe. Living in the DACH region is preferred.

Characteristics that Win

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You genuinely want to understand how things are made and the chemistry behind the products we use every day.
  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you see a problem, and you solve it. You are comfortable working with ambiguity in a high-growth startup environment.
  • Consultative Mindset: You don't just sell software; you sell a transformation in how companies operate.
  • Builder Mentality: You love building a business and shaping processes; you don’t wait for it to show up.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Valdera?

Ownership: Founding member of our European GTM team with significant autonomy. Opportunity to grow into Sales Management.

Impact: We are not just optimizing clicks; we are fixing the physical supply chain that the world relies on.

Growth: Work alongside a world-class team from top tech and industrial backgrounds in an environment that prioritizes rapid career acceleration.a

Salary Range:

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the role's requirements. We will make a compelling offer for the right candidate.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full-time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided with a more detailed breakdown of your options before joining Valdera.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

Please note that Valdera uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

jobs.title: Senior AP Accountant
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior AP Accountant you will own the most complex and business-critical AP activities within your scope. You will be a senior point of contact for business stakeholders, apply judgment to non-standard situations that have no established precedent, and actively support the development of the broader team. You will also be a hands-on contributor to continuous improvement - bringing operational knowledge to improvement projects led by the Continuous Improvement Specialist.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the most complex or business-critical AP activities within your assigned scope, end-to-end
  • Exercise senior judgment on escalations, non-standard cases and situations with no established precedent
  • Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders on operational AP matters - resolving issues and managing expectations
  • Manage complex vendor relationships including dispute resolution, payment negotiations and escalation handling
  • Support month-end close at a senior level - reconciliations, AP aging, intercompany and balance sheet review within your scope
  • Provide consistent guidance and day-to-day support to AP Accountant I and II colleagues
  • Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives - surface operational issues, challenge existing processes and contribute hands-on knowledge to projects led by the Continuous Improvement Specialist
  • Support audit and control activities within assigned entities, including documentation and query resolution

We expect you to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in Accounts Payable or Finance Operations, including experience with complex or business-critical entities
  • Demonstrated ability to handle non-standard situations independently and apply senior judgment
  • Experience as a point of contact for business stakeholders - comfortable managing expectations and resolving operational issues directly
  • Strong experience with month-end close, reconciliations and AP controls
  • Solid working knowledge of NetSuite and Blackline; familiarity with Zip is a strong advantage
  • Experience in multi-currency, multi-entity or multi-country AP environments
  • Track record of informally developing or mentoring more junior colleagues
  • Excellent written and verbal English - English is our primary working language and the expected standard of communication throughout the team

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience supporting external audits and working with auditors directly
  • Exposure to process improvement projects or a continuous improvement methodology
  • Additional European language skills

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Major Account Executive | Remote | Sweden
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for a Major Account Executive based in Sweden who will be responsible for managing some of our largest enterprise accounts in the Nordics region. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities within your assigned install base, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals

  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)

  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise

  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 6+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & Swedish or Danish or Norwegian or Finnish.

Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Reward

In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 2,985,000 - SEK 3,090,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

jobs.title: Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
jobs.description:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

About the diploma

  • A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online.

  • Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision.

  • Full course fees funded by Montu UK.

  • Two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales.

Eligibility

  • A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu.

  • Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

What will you be doing?

  • Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions.

  • Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management.

  • Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing.

  • Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate.

  • Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice.

  • Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Completing the sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management alongside clinical responsibilities.

  • Participating in ongoing training and professional development, including specialist training in cannabis-based prescription medicines.

What you need

  • Full GMC registration with a current licence to practise.

  • Completion of specialist training in Anaesthesia (CCT/CCST) or equivalent.

  • Entry on the GMC Specialist Register for Anaesthesia.

  • Strong knowledge of analgesic pharmacology, pain management and safe prescribing.

  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach to care.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary clinical team.

  • A strong interest in chronic pain and alternative treatment options.

  • Willingness to participate in clinical outcome data collection and reporting.

  • Ability to commit to a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

Previous chronic pain experience is welcome but not essential, as the sponsored diploma and comprehensive in-house training will support professional development.

Why join us?

  • Competitive Salary: £170,000 FTE, pro rata for contracted hours.

  • Funded Postgraduate Diploma: Full course fees for the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, plus two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

  • Flexible Working: Fully remote working with flexible clinical sessions and a minimum commitment of 24 hours per week.

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for work undertaken within the role.

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on-call requirements.

  • Specialist Training: Access to CPD-accredited medical cannabis education and specialist training from experienced clinicians.

  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals.

  • Professional Development: Build expertise in chronic pain management and contribute to an evolving area of medicine.

Training & Development

  • Fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales.

  • Regular CPD sessions to support ongoing professional development, appraisal and revalidation.

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training in clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's clinical systems.

  • Appraisal and revalidation support where Montu is the main employer.

Working arrangements

  • Remote Role: Fully remote working with flexibility around working days and hours.

  • Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 24 hours per week, consisting of 22 hours of clinical work and two hours of protected, paid study time.

  • Sessions: Standard clinical sessions consist of four hours of patient consultations, with flexibility to arrange sessions around preferred working days and hours.

  • Appointment Durations: 15 minutes for new and existing patients.

  • Multidisciplinary Support: Nurses and pharmacists support pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing and patient care.

Our multidisciplinary model enables consultants to focus on their clinical expertise while benefiting from the support of an experienced wider healthcare team.

What we offer

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year two) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

Postgraduate Diploma Sponsorship Terms and Conditions

As Montu is fully funding the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, sponsorship is subject to a separate training agreement.

  • A minimum commitment of 24 hours per week is required throughout the diploma programme.

  • Two hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week is required for the duration of the diploma.

  • If employment ends before completing the diploma or within 12 months of completion, repayment of the course fees will be required.

Full repayment terms will be outlined in a separate training agreement, which must be reviewed and signed before enrolment.

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

Do you want to save lives with every clinic that you onboard?

Please note that as this role may involve site work and on-site support for our users, we can only consider your application if you are based in the UK. You will not be able to complete our screening task if you are not based in the UK, so please bear this in mind when submitting your application. We hope to welcome you to the team soon!

Join Anima, and you'll use your influence and people skills to get Anima into clinics and entire regions: an urgently needed product that saves lives amid critical levels of patient demand, with healthcare systems in crisis across the globe.

Since launching in the UK, we're now used in by GP practices, primary care networks and federations across the country who collectively provide care for over 2 million patients.

Have amazing stakeholder conversations with users who fanatically love the product, and steer our product direction

Our current distribution team have said that one of the biggest perks of working at Anima is seeing the delight and disbelief on people’s faces when we show them our demo, something that is truly a 10x generational leap. Here’s what some of our users have been saying:

*“I sent a plan to the patient and it’s incredible, within a few minutes they’re coming back to me saying that they can make the appointment!”

"I would call that next generation, I think you have that badge"

”Sometimes you need to stop driving a Fiesta and buy a Mercedes"*

Lots of us went into medicine because we wanted to maximise our positive impact. At Anima, we understand that distribution is the other half of a legendary product. Here are incredible things we’ve built as a result of our fullstack sales team:

  • A Clinical Director at one of our practices wanted to streamline multiple access channels and make access equitable and fair. After some great discovery and deep listening, the AM together with the customer suggested we build something called ‘proxy requests’, which would allow the reception team at a clinic to complete Anima requests on behalf of a patient who was on a landline call - this made it possible to give someone with no internet or mobile phone the same access to care. This is now one of our most popular features that has led to viral referrals and fanatical users.

  • One of our fullstack account manager, realised that adding a configurable feature that allows patients to self-book appointments directly into the electronic health record calendar would be critical to closing large enterprise accounts. By deeply understanding the pain points and anxieties underlying the feature, Anima built the feature in 9 days, to the great excitement of users at demo calls and $1m+ ACV meetings.

  • Off the back of fanatical referrals from our existing users, the team was invited to present to NHS England at national and regional level, and we’ve been helping to shape the future of the primary care market through an upcoming $1bn+ procurement framework.

Does this sound like you?

  • Hungry and wants their shot to change the world - a force of nature when empowered with the tools, resources and development to do it.

  • Exceptional communicator, able to distill complex information into clear and concise bullets without jargon. An excellent conduit between users and the rest of the company.

  • Able to execute a high sigma discovery process and in combination with incisive people intuition, elucidate deep pain points and opportunities to excite within minutes of the first call.

  • Has incredibly high standards for themselves and an unshakeable growth mindset: able to challenge themselves and those around them to push to do things better.

  • Exceptionally organised: able to build & maintain multiple relationships across a diverse range of organisations, and consistently execute on plans to onboard and retain users. Reliably follows up on 100% of qualified leads at optimal intervals.

  • A gifted relationship builder, able to quickly build rapport and emotional anchors with almost anyone and any persona.

  • Pragmatic rather than dogmatic in decision making: able to weigh real world data appropriately, changing course when necessary towards optimal outcomes for patients and clinicians.

  • Keen to understand the big picture & entire context of the company and vertical; impatient to grow towards a senior executive role.

  • Seeks to maximise combined team productivity, communicating the right things at the right time through the right channels.

  • Intellectually curious and loves learning - able to tackle entirely novel challenges that lack prior precedent through first principles thinking, creatively using the right pragmatic approach, with an understanding of alternatives and trade offs.

It's helpful to have B2B/SaaS experience, generating leads of $10k+ ACV, but not mandatory - we will make exceptions if you’re a high performing BDR. You need to have demonstrated a high growth mindset and potential for rapid skill development through past projects. For this role, you will need to be based in the UK.

Our current users & what to expect from the role

We're live with GP teams across the country, being used by teams across the NHS. Over the rest of 2024, we're continuing to onboard teams that want to build the future of healthcare, and will be working with the NHS to deploy Anima at regional & national level. We’ll also be identifying international partners to power Anima’s next stage of growth.

We’re looking to add talented account executives who understand the urgency and importance of what we’re doing for society and are hungry to make impact.

Our VP Sales has a 90%+ e2e close rate, and the distro org averages about 80%. Our CAC payback, gross margin, retention are all world class and you'll be joining an exceptional team with top metrics for SaaS, despite being in a traditionally slower vertical.

First month - some examples of what to expect:

  • Participate in user discovery & demo calls to develop a deep understanding of their fundamental motivations and needs/pain points, translating these insights into optimal feature roadmaps.

  • Source leads and execute campaigns. Get as much exposure as possible to developing the full lifecycle of an opportunity from lead through to closure.

  • Join the team at events & conferences, speaking to potential users, conducting demos and converting leads.

Next 6 months - some examples of what to expect:

  • Build domain expertise to scale our prospecting, identifying the teams in the most pain who are likely to become fanatical users of Anima.

  • Become the central point of contact for assigned GP practices and PCNs. Your job is to maximise discounted fanaticism, doing whatever is necessary to help practices start - and continue - using Anima.

  • Work with customer success colleagues to maximise virality and fanaticism across your accounts, doing whatever is needed to ensure every account leads to the maximum number of fanatical referrals.

6+ months - some examples of what to expect:

  • Potential to transition into a Strategic Enterprise AE, with managerial responsibility for junior AEs joining the team.

  • Take on account management responsibility for larger accounts e.g. GP federations and ICSs (covering 1m+ patients).

  • Work with the team to scale our sales & marketing, including working with NHS leaders to identify and secure regional & national-level procurement opportunities, including those beyond primary care.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

  • Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

  • Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Threat Research Engineer, Security Factory: Threat Research
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What you’ll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
  • Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Ads Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.

Reddit is where people come to discover, research, and discuss products that inform their purchasing decisions. Shopping, across advertising and organic experiences, is a high priority for the company, and product catalogs are foundational to that work.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Reddit’s Product Catalogs team. You will lead a full-stack engineering team responsible for the infrastructure and advertiser-facing experiences that help thousands of advertisers onboard, organize, and manage millions of products. Your team will build intuitive UIs, robust APIs, and scalable backend systems for catalog ingestion, storage, and product data management.

These systems power Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) and organic shopping, connecting users with relevant products in the context of their interests and conversations. Someone browsing r/golf might discover popular golf clubs, while someone reading a discussion about sunglasses in r/BuyItForLife might see the exact models being discussed. Your team will make it easier for advertisers to bring their products to Reddit and participate in these moments of discovery.

In this role, you will set technical direction, develop engineers, and drive execution across the catalog platform and advertiser experience. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to understand customer needs and make catalog onboarding and management seamless. You will also partner with Reddit’s Knowledge Graph teams to support organic shopping experiences.

This role calls for strong technical judgment, people leadership, and a focus on customer needs. It is based in Reddit’s Amsterdam or London office, with a team working across European time zones.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.
  • Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match
  • Private Medical and Dental Scheme
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Bike to Work scheme
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description:
This is a permanent full-time remote opportunity for those based in Ireland.

About Nearform
Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Delivery Management function, you will help our clients build solutions and platforms, launch new product ventures, and fundamentally change how they operate.

You will work as part of a highly skilled, multidisciplinary team, typically consisting of designers, developers, DevOps engineers, and members of the client team.

Whether you’re a Delivery Manager, Technical Lead, or Technical Director, you will act as the bridge between client needs and timelines, ensuring the delivery of innovative, scalable solutions.

About the Technical Director role

As a Technical Director at Nearform, you will provide strategic and technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with business goals while fostering innovation and excellence. Your role will involve technical vision-setting, client engagement, and team leadership to drive both project success and long-term growth.

  • Technical Strategy & Leadership – Define and communicate a clear technical vision, ensuring best practices in architecture, software development, and emerging technologies. Act as the final authority in critical design and delivery decisions.
  • Client Engagement & Advisory – Serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and senior stakeholders. Lead discovery workshops, translate business objectives into technical strategies, and develop tailored solution proposals.
  • Project Execution & Delivery – Oversee technical execution, ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability. Monitor project health, identify risks, and ensure successful outcomes through proactive leadership.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development – Work with resourcing teams to ensure the right talent is staffed on projects. Foster a culture of excellence, mentorship, and innovation across teams.
  • Financial & Operational Oversight – Manage project burn-down, optimize resource allocation, and identify revenue growth opportunities while maintaining financial accountability.
  • Industry Influence & Thought Leadership – Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to open-source projects, and engage in public speaking, blog writing, and mentorship. Champion Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and sustainability initiatives within Nearform.

What we are looking for in this person

  • 15+ years of technical leadership experience, ideally within consulting, SaaS, or large-scale digital transformation projects.
  • Deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, and modern development practices.
  • A strong track record of guiding technical decisions on complex, high-impact projects.
  • Experience leading pre-sales, discovery, and solution design discussions.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A consultative mindset, able to align business needs with technical strategies.
  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills to influence at all levels.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, databases, distributed systems, and modern software engineering best practices.
  • Experience leading and mentoring senior software development teams
  • A passion for continuous learning, innovation, and professional excellence.

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience working in a fully remote, globally distributed environment.
  • Background in financial oversight of technology projects.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or technical thought leadership.
  • Prior exposure to AI-driven solutions and emerging technologies.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 24 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance of up to €1000 you can use to upskill yourself.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins, Zoom)
    An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour, Zoom)
    A conversation with the Head of Delivery or CTO focused on your approach to delivery management, client collaboration, and technical problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.
  • Panel Interview (1.5 hours, Zoom)
    A discussion with 2 Technical Directors focusing on your team leadership and delivery management approach in more detail. This includes scenario-based questions on team management, delivering technical work, and client collaboration, assessing how you drive success in an enterprise development environment.
  • Final Interview (45 mins, Zoom)
    A final chat with the Managing Director for the region to discuss the plans for this role, Nearform’s strategy, and any questions you may have.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.

jobs.title: Chemical Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

Role Description:

We are hiring a Chemicals Procurement Specialist to lead the engagement with specialty chemical and raw material suppliers and to deliver exceptional outcomes for the buyers on Valdera’s procurement platform.

Suppliers play a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect high-quality quotes. Delivering that quality depends on identifying the right suppliers—and on our ability to motivate their active participation on Valdera’s procurement platform. This requires a strong understanding of chemical markets and a proactive approach towards supplier outreach.

You will take ownership of supplier engagement, including the simultaneous management of multiple buyer-initiated Requests for Quotes (RFQs). You’re energized by applying your expertise in chemicals, conducting in-depth supply market assessments, and confidently engaging with suppliers across the globe. As a customer-obsessed professional, you are dedicated to delivering exceptional outcomes for our buyers.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Own and manage a high volume of Request for Quotes (RFQs) for buyers, ensuring timely delivery of multiple high-quality quotes for each requested material
  • Assess supplier landscape to identify and select appropriate suppliers for requested materials
  • Engage with new suppliers to confirm material availability and secure competitive quotes
  • Facilitate communication between suppliers and buyers regarding product specifications, samples and delivery terms
  • Validate the quality and accuracy of quotes and supplier-submitted data
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers already active on the Valdera platform
  • Onboard new suppliers onto the Valdera platform ensuring a smooth and frictionless integration experience
  • Maintain thorough documentation of product availability, supplier communication and sourcing activity

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the chemical industry
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or natural science
  • 5+ years of experience in sourcing, technical sales, business development, partnership, or management consulting
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct supply market assessments and identify suppliers for specific chemicals / raw materials
  • Extensive knowledge of chemicals / raw materials and relevant technical expertise in reviewing RFQs (TDS, SDS, COA, etc.). 
  • Ability to identify alternate or offset materials by reviewing technical documentation and product chemistry.
  • Experience in establishing and managing strong supplier relationships
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build trust and rapport with suppliers
  • Capable of creating structured plans, tracking steps, and managing multiple priorities effectively

Compensation

Additional Information

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: Intercompany Accountant
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an Intercompany Accountant to support the Group's intercompany accounting processes across our international group, with a focus on cost-plus calculations, intercompany reconciliations, and period-end close.

This is a hands-on accounting role suited to someone who enjoys working with detailed financial data and resolving discrepancies. The role works closely with local finance teams and other Group Finance stakeholders across entities and time zones.

The role is responsible for the accurate, complete, and timely delivery of assigned intercompany accounting activities, from source-data validation and cost-plus calculations through posting, reconciliation, issue resolution, and close support. The position operates within approved accounting policies, intercompany agreements, methodologies, and control requirements, escalating material or unusual matters to the Intercompany Manager.

Work Location: Hybrid (Netherlands or United Kingdom) | Remote (other European countries)

Your responsibilities will include:

Cost-plus calculations and agreement support

  • Prepare end-to-end cost-plus calculations in accordance with approved intercompany agreements, methodologies, and mark-up rates.
  • Extract and validate cost data, identify eligible costs, and apply agreed allocation keys, exclusions, and mark-ups.
  • Maintain detailed calculation schedules, ensuring traceability to source accounting records and supporting documentation.
  • Calculate periodic intercompany charges and true-ups, and prepare the related journal entries for review and approval.
  • Coordinate with local finance teams to confirm cost inputs and ensure timely recording of charges by both counterparties.
  • Reconcile calculated charges to invoiced and recorded amounts, investigate differences, and prepare proposed corrections.
  • Support the maintenance of documentation required to evidence the application of approved intercompany agreements and cost-plus methodologies.

Reconciliations and discrepancy follow-up

  • Help with monthly intercompany profit-and-loss reconciliations and quarterly balance-sheet reconciliations using NetSuite reports and established templates.
  • Match transactions and balances between group entities by counterparty and currency.
  • Investigate differences arising from timing, foreign exchange, missing entries, incorrect coding, or other posting issues.
  • Follow up with local finance teams to obtain supporting information and track outstanding items through resolution.
  • Prepare proposed correcting entries for review and post approved adjustments.
  • Identify recurring mismatch patterns and communicate root causes and practical remediation actions to the Intercompany Manager.

Period-end close and reporting

  • Complete assigned intercompany close activities within agreed deadlines and in line with the Group close calendar.
  • Keep reconciliation trackers up to date, clearly documenting unresolved differences, follow-up actions, owners, and dependencies.
  • Provide clear explanations and supporting evidence for external audits, internal reviews, and other finance queries.
  • Communicate potential close risks early when required inputs, confirmations, or corrections are not received on time.

SOX and internal controls

  • Prepare and document a defined sub-set of the FSCP-REP control series related to intercompany processes

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in accounting, preferably intercompany accounting or general ledger within an international or multi-entity organisation.
  • Practical experience preparing cost allocations, intercompany recharges, or cost-plus calculations is an advantage.
  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system; NetSuite experience is an advantage.
  • A degree or equivalent qualification in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Strong written and spoken English for communication with international finance teams.
  • Strong understanding of journal entries, account reconciliations, foreign currency (FX), and month-end close processes.
  • Ability to work confidently with large financial datasets, identify patterns in reconciliation differences, and document clear root-cause analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to repetitive, deadline-driven accounting work.
  • Comfort working in a fast-changing, international and post-IPO environment where processes and responsibilities may evolve as the Group grows.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across entities and time zones.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.description:

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Opportunity
