jobs.title: Founding Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Sales Engineer (NY, NY or US Remote)

Why we're hiring

Tracebit is helping some of the world's best security teams at Snyk, Docker, Riot Games and many more to achieve an 'assume breach' strategy at scale. Tracebit detects intrusions in critical environments using canaries - decoy assets deployed to deceive attackers.

We're at a massive inflection point and there has never been a more exciting time to join us:

  • We've built a product that security teams love. You'll be our founding Sales Engineer (a key part of our Customer Engineering team), helping build the technical foundation for how we grow our customer base and deliver outcomes at scale.

  • We are backed by some of the best investors in the space (Accel, FirstMark and more).

  • We are growing very quickly (we doubled ARR last quarter), having recently closed some incredible customers that we can't disclose publicly!

  • We are one of the most exciting startups to be part of in cybersecurity, have seen some great feedback from the market and are ready for explosive growth.

  • We have strong traction in the US (80% of our customer base and forward-looking business). We've hit product-market fit and it's time to accelerate our growth by building our US presence.

  • Regularly featured on top startup lists from industry veterans... Creandum's Euro Seed top 50 list, Sifted's 2025 London Startups To Watch, Notions Cloud Top 100, AlbionVC's NHI Breakdown, MMCs Proactive Security Analysis, Accel's Euroscape Top Startups 2024, etc.

  • Trusted by teams at Docker, Chainguard, Xbow, Riot Games, Snyk and more.

  • Our research has recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

Who we're looking for

You have strong technical sales experience. You've spent 3-5 years in a customer-facing technical role at a B2B SaaS company, ideally in cybersecurity or developer tooling. You don't need to code, but you understand and have experience in areas such as cloud infrastructure or DevOps and can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives.

You learn technical concepts quickly. You can rapidly grasp new technical concepts and translate them into clear value propositions. You're comfortable diving into technical documentation and asking smart questions to fill knowledge gaps.

You work well with GTM teams. You understand the sales process and know when to lead technical discussions versus when to support account executives. You can identify technical blockers and work collaboratively to overcome them.

You're comfortable in startup environments. You've experienced the pace of an early-stage company and this pace excites you. You can handle ambiguity, build processes from scratch, and adapt quickly as priorities shift.

About the role

You'll report directly to Bryan O’Neil, our Director of Customer Engineering. You'll partner closely with sales, product, engineering, and directly with our customers to ensure successful evaluations and wider outcomes via our platform.

Your core focus:

  • Run discovery calls and product demos. Partner with sales to understand prospect requirements and deliver tailored demos that showcase how Tracebit solves their specific challenges. Adjust your approach based on whether you're talking to a CISO or a security engineer.

  • Design and execute PoVs. Scope Proof-of-Values that demonstrate clear alignment within prospect environments. Guide customers through setup, monitor progress, and ensure successful outcomes and technical wins.

  • Build technical sales collateral. Input on demo scripts, technical one-pagers, architecture diagrams, and FAQ documents that help prospects understand our platform. Make it easy for AEs to have informed technical conversations.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout the sales cycle. Address questions about security, compliance, and integrations. Work with engineering when deeper expertise is needed. You will be a Tracebit SME.

  • Feed product insights back to the team. Bring customer feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence to product discussions. Help shape what we build based on market needs.

  • Represent Tracebit at events. Attend key cybersecurity conferences to run technical demos, answer questions, and build relationships with prospects.

FAQs

Where is the office?

We're establishing our New York office in Manhattan. You'll work closely with our London team and other US team members as we grow.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

This role can be based either in our New York office or fully remote in the US. To best support our teams in NY and London, remote locations should be in Eastern or Central US timezones.

We are an office-first company - all of our team works together in the office 5 days a week. However, we're making an exception for this role given the nature of the work and the need to hire the best talent in this space.

If you're based in New York, you'll work from our office. If you're remote, we expect you to come to the office at least quarterly to collaborate with the team in person.

What are the working hours like?

We think 9am-6pm will bring a great cadence to work. As a founding team member, there will definitely be times you need to pick up work outside of these hours, we're keen to limit this where we can but also offer flexibility in return.

Can you sponsor visas?

You must have the right to work in the US.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: US-based, remote, covering AMER customers.

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • You have found and qualified new opportunities inside your existing customers, and converted or handed off a good number of them

  • Your customers are live and ramping volume, with their executive sponsors still engaged

  • Customers come to you first, on their compliance programme and on their commercial relationship with us

What you will be doing:

  • Owning enterprise customers from signature onward: implementation, adoption, business reviews, renewal and expansion

  • Mapping each customer for growth across adjacent business units, entities, regions and products, and working with Sales to close the net-new ones

  • Running your own renewals and upsells, including pricing, commitments and the conversation with the economic buyer

  • Running business reviews early enough to shape the renewal outcome

  • Working directly with customer integration teams: API documentation, test calls, transaction and webhook data, and a clear diagnosis when something is stuck

  • Guiding customers through their Travel Rule programmes and their stablecoin payment products

  • Keeping long implementations on track. FIs take months to go live and ramp slowly, and executive attention has to be held for all of it

  • Building relationships across compliance, operations, engineering and the C-suite, so the relationship never rests on one contact

  • Bringing customer and competitor insight back to product, sales and marketing

  • Keeping records current in HubSpot

  • Some on-call duty outside office hours

What you bring:

  • Based in the US, able to cover AMER customers

  • Senior experience in Customer Success or Account Management at a crypto, fintech or regtech SaaS company, or in another complex technical market, owning enterprise customers

  • Comfort with technical products. You can work through API documentation, read a request and response, form a view on why an integration is behaving the way it is, and hold that conversation with a customer's engineers

  • Commercial ownership. You have run your own renewals and upsells, negotiated pricing and carried a retention or expansion number

  • A history of growing customers you already had, and comfort working with Sales on what you surface

  • A doer. You own the detail yourself, and you move without waiting for a process to exist

  • Patience for enterprise: long cycles, slow ramps, decisions made by committee

  • Experience across the full lifecycle, from onboarding through to expansion

  • Good judgement with people and real interest in solving their problems

  • Credibility with an integration engineer and with a CFO

  • Comfortable working autonomously and getting stuck in

Nice to Have

  • Travel Rule, stablecoin payments or digital asset compliance experience

  • Time at a company that moved up-market into enterprise

  • Solutions engineering, implementation or technical account management background

  • Experience with banks and regulated financial institutions entering digital assets

  • Having built Customer Success processes and playbooks from scratch

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

  • Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

  • Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

  • Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

  • Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

  • Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

  • Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

  • Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

  • Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

  • Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

  • Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

  • Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

  • Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

  • Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Bridge the customer and engineering

  • Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.

  • Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.

  • Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.

  • Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

Use AI tooling to scale your work

  • Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.

  • Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

Essential

  • Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.

  • Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.

  • Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.

  • Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.

  • Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.

  • API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.

  • Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.

  • Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.

  • Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.

  • Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to cybersecurity, risk management or security-tool integrations (for example, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, asset inventories or identity providers).

  • Bash or PowerShell.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (forward deployed, solutions, customer or support engineering) at a SaaS or enterprise software company.

  • Experience working in distributed, multi-time-zone teams.

Why this role is exciting:

  • Own customer outcomes at the point where SAFE meets real enterprise environments.

  • Work with engineering, product and customer teams on problems that shape the platform.

  • Build creative solutions to problems, both customer facing and internal

  • Learn cyber risk, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), a growing part of cybersecurity.

  • Use Python, APIs and AI tooling to remove manual work for yourself and the team.

Compensation

Additional Information

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Wurl, LLC.

At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.

In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

Staff Platform Engineer:

Wurl is seeking a Staff Platform Engineer to build and operate the systems that power our ad-serving and streaming platforms. You’ll be the key technical leader driving the vision and evolution of the infrastructure foundation that enables our teams to deploy, scale, and observe high-throughput, low-latency workloads serving hundreds of thousands of requests per second.

You’ll own the platform layer, ensuring it’s reliable, cost-efficient, and measurable, while enabling multiple engineering teams to deliver world-class video and advertising experiences.

Responsibilities

Platform Infrastructure & Automation

  • Define, architect, and set standards for composable IaC (CDK or Terraform) patterns for Cloud Infrastructure (EKS).
  • Drive the adoption and implement composable, idempotent, multi-environment GitOps workflows.
  • Optimize scalability and cost-per-performance using metrics-driven automation and autoscaling technologies such as Karpenter.

Observability & Reliability

  • Develop and maintain observability across the platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with application teams to define SLOs and capacity models for mission-critical services.
  • Lead major production incident response efforts, drive blameless postmortems, and mentor other engineers on production incident response, postmortems, and reliability reviews.

Delivery & Culture

  • Create and operate resilient CI/CD pipelines for safe, rapid deployments and rollbacks.
  • Champion automation, low-toil operations, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Develop agentic workflows utilizing the team-wide context layer and operational data to accelerate development without compromising reliability.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor to elevate the team, with a strong ability to listen, evaluate, and give constructive feedback on ideas.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in architecting, deploying, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in cloud production environments, ideally in Platform, SRE, or DevOps roles. Prior ownership of a stateful deployment
  • Deep expertise in systems-level coding skills for automation and systems development (Go, Python, or TypeScript).
  • Proven experience operating Kubernetes at scale (EKS preferred) and applying IaC patterns (CDK, Terraform).
  • Working knowledge of GitOps and reconciliation loops in Kubernetes controllers.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline)

Operational Excellence

  • Expert in defining, designing, and optimizing global monitoring and alerting pipelines (PromQL, metrics correlation, alert noise reduction).
  • Experience with large-scale streaming or ad-serving workloads, including HTTP-based delivery (oRTB, VAST), event streaming (Kafka), and AWS network architecture (VPC, load balancers, peering)
  • Understanding of cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption, network segmentation, zero trust).
  • Proven ability to conduct deep performance analysis, tuning, and optimization across the entire infrastructure stack to achieve optimal cost-per-performance and latency targets.

A Plus if you have:

  • Experience with advanced GitOps patterns using Github Workflows.
  • Exposure to extended observability tools such as Loki or Tempo
  • Experience designing or operating distributed, high-throughput stateful data pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient data flow.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Bonus
  • Strong Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits, 100% paid by Wurl
  • Remote first policy
  • Flexible Time Off
  • 10 US Holidays
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Pre-Tax Savings Plans, HSA & FSA

  • OneMedical subscription for 24/7 convenient medical care
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave for all family additions
  • Discounted PetPlan and easy at home access to Covid testing with empowerDX

Few companies allow you to thrive like you will at Wurl. Join us to revolutionize the way the world watches television while enjoying mentorship, collaboration, and innovation.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist

The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of accounting, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of transactions while maintaining accurate financial records. This individual will partner cross-functionally to improve processes, strengthen client relationships, and support an efficient month-end close.

You Will Be

  • Managing high-volume client billing, invoice processing, and account maintenance to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

  • Reconciling client accounts, researching discrepancies, and resolving billing issues and short payments.

  • Partnering with Client Services and internal Finance teams to address client inquiries and resolve account discrepancies.

  • Managing client billing setup and updates to ensure accurate invoicing and account records.

  • Supporting month-end close through accurate invoicing, reconciliations and journal entries,

  • Identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, strengthen internal controls, and improve AR processes and reporting.

  • Maintaining thorough documentation and supporting internal and external audits as needed.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Finance Manager to be the finance partner to the people who run our manufacturing network. You’ll own the financial picture for our manufacturing sites and our third-party lab network, and help operators fully understand their cost structure and identify opportunities.

This is a role for someone who wants to be close to the physical business. You’ll spend real time in the details of overhead absorption, cost per unit, and vendor economics, and you’ll also be in the room when we decide whether to buy a piece of equipment, open or consolidate a site, or bring work in-house. It’s a high-ownership seat with visibility across Operations and Finance leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Manufacturing Site Leads. Own the finance relationship with each site. Make sure every site lead knows their budget cold, understands what’s driving their variances, and has what they need to act on it. Be the person they call before they make a decision, not after.

  • Partner with the 3P Labs team. Bring financial clarity to the routing decisions this team owns. Build the analysis that shows what each routing choice costs us, and make sure the trade-offs are understood in real time — not discovered at close.

  • Run the operations monthly close. Lead pre-close and prelim close meetings with site leads: align with Cost Accounting in advance, set clear expectations with attendees, drive follow-ups to completion, and ensure every variance explanation is properly quantified and owned.

  • Own the accuracy of manufacturing COGS. Perform expense detail review on fixed overhead COGS to confirm costs are booked correctly. Analyze third-party lab costs to validate routing. Run gold and precious metals margin analyses to confirm we’re pricing to our markup targets.

  • Make the process better every month. This close is not in its final form. We want someone who treats each cycle as an opportunity to remove manual work, tighten timelines, and raise the quality of what comes out the other side.

  • Support strategic decisions. Build the analysis behind manufacturing equipment purchases, manufacturing footprint decisions, and insource vs. outsource evaluations — and have a point of view on the answer, not just the model.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of finance experience, including meaningful time in a physical-product business in a high growth environment

  • Demonstrated success partnering with operators. You’ve built strong working relationships with operators and can translate between operational reality and financial impact in both directions.

  • Strong ownership of recurring processes. You’ve run a close, a forecast cycle, or a reporting cadence and left it better than you found it.

  • Excellent modeling skills - proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and also comfort w/ automating spreadsheet work with Claude Co-Work or other AI tools. Comfortable getting into large, messy datasets.

  • Exceptional communication skills — able to distill complex analysis into a clear recommendation for an executive audience.

  • Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. You’re willing to have backbone with senior stakeholders and push for the right answer.

Req ID: J-1224

jobs.title: Junior Expansion Account Executive
jobs.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Drive Customer Growth. Deliver Better Outcomes.

As an Junior Expansion Account Executive, you’ll drive revenue growth within Nextiva’s existing small business customer base. This is a high-velocity sales role where you’ll proactively reach out to customers, uncover opportunities, and deliver solutions by connecting customer challenges to the value of Nextiva's AI-Powered Platform. How You’ll Make an Impact

What You'll Bring

Compensation & Growth

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
ReSpark - Field Implementation Manager

Location: Remote

The opportunity:

ReSpark is a fast-growing start-up pioneering the future of the industrial scrap recycling industry ($120bn and growing!). We serve the world's leading industrial recyclers, helping them transform industrial and consumer scrap into new, usable materials. Our platform modernizes end-to-end workflows within the scrap recycling industry and is the core solution on which their business runs.

We are seeking a proactive Field Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience Team. This role will help drive progress on customer implementations including hardware configuration, end-user training, and workflow recommendations.

There will be travel involved (~30%) to visit customer sites and drive in-person hardware configuration and product training required for going live on the platform. This is a remote position.

About ReSpark

ReSpark is a venture-backed SaaS company formed through the merger of GreenSpark Software and ReMatter — the two leading modern operations platforms for metal recyclers. Together, we serve over 1,200 metal recycling facilities around the world.

Despite being a crucial part of the recycling ecosystem, the $120B+ scrap metal industry has long lacked intuitive, modern software for managing metal transactions, inventory, and yard operations. ReSpark exists to change that. With 12 years of combined production experience, our platform follows the metal all the way through the yard — from point of purchase through ultimate sale — all under one roof.

Today, we're building the AI-first operations layer for the recycling industry: an agentic platform that doesn't just digitize scrap yard workflows, but actively runs them.

We're a mission-driven team of innovators built on principles of competitive greatness, autonomy, and collaboration. Our culture is one of transparency, mutual respect, and constructive feedback — all aimed at collective progress and a brighter, more sustainable future.

As an Implementation Manager, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end software implementations for new ReSpark customers
  • Travel to scrap yards for in-person go-lives and training on a regular basis
  • Become an expert on the ReSpark product, its use cases for recyclers, and how ReSpark helps recyclers operate more efficiently and improve business outcomes
  • Configure customer hardware supporting ReSpark’s software platform such as IP cameras, scales, and printers
  • Lead virtual and live end-user trainings during and after onboarding
  • Hone your customer experience skill-set including clear communication, expectation-setting, problem-solving, and more

We’re looking for someone that has:

  • 4+ years of prior success in a customer-facing role, preferably in training, support, or a related function in a SaaS environment
  • Prior work experience with Windows operating system, remote desktop software, and other software/IT programs
  • Experience installing and setting up hardware (E.g. cameras, scales)
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • A positive attitude and can-do mindset
  • Strong self-motivation, grit, and a competitive spirit
  • A customer-first mindset and bias towards action
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment

Nice to have:

  • Fluent Spanish is a huge plus!

Benefits:

  • Flexible time off policy to balance your work and life
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k)
  • Great start-up culture

ReSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ReSpark’s employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Compensation Range: $85,000-$95,000

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Manawatu-Whanganui)
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Farmers with Halter are writing the playbook for a world-first farming system, they are paving a new way of managing their land and animals, and in doing so, are unlocking more productive and sustainable uses of the world's agricultural land along with driving optimal profitability outcomes.

We've more recently launched into the Beef Market! This is an opportunity to build a new market from the bottom up. The Beef industry has not had a disruptive and influential product in years and this is your chance to make a huge impact.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is based in the Manawatu-Whanganui region. Applicants must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily.


Who are we looking for

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You will be a high-performing value-based salesperson, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

  • Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

  • Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

  • Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Our Benefits

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Lead, Virtual Events & Launch Programs
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Lead, Virtual Events & Launch Programs to build and run UpGuard's global digital event and launch programs: Summit, our quarterly product launch broadcast, plus a year round series and on-demand content engine that keeps security and risk leaders engaged between launches.

You’ll set the strategy for how we use virtual events to reach security and risk leaders, and run the program that delivers it: webinars, virtual roundtables, and digital event series for audiences in North America, EMEA, and APAC, including our quarterly launch event (Summit), where we showcase what’s new across the UpGuard platform. Your job is to make sure every event reaches the right people, gives attendees something worth their time, and creates pipeline for our revenue teams..

You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, partner marketing, regional marketing leads, and our executive team, and you’ll be the go-to expert on virtual events across the business. Because our audience is global, some events will run outside Australian business hours, and we’ll work with you on a schedule that makes that sustainable.

What will you do?

  • Set the strategy and annual plan for UpGuard’s virtual event program, aligned to marketing and pipeline goals, and decide which formats, topics, and audiences to invest in.

  • Act as executive producer for Summit, our quarterly launch broadcast: shape the launch narrative with Product and Product Marketing, build the run of show, and deliver a multi-speaker live production to broadcast standard

  • Own each event end to end: topic and format, agenda, speaker sourcing and preparation, run sheets, platform setup, rehearsals, live production, and on-demand publishing.

  • Work with product marketing and leadership to shape content around product launches, customer stories, and the topics security and risk leaders care about most.

  • Build and run UpGuard's speaker program: recruit, brief, coach and rehearse executives, customers, analysts and industry experts, and develop a bench of repeat speakers

  • Brief demand gen, content and design on each event's audience, positioning and assets so promotion lands with the right buyers.

  • Own the virtual event platform end to end, including administration, integration with CRM, data quality and attribution setup, so every registration and attendance is captured and routed correctly

  • Own the KPIs for Summit and our virtual program: registration-to-attendance rate, live and on-demand engagement, post-launch feature awareness and adoption, pipeline from the on-demand library, and attendee and speaker satisfaction. Report results to marketing leadership and use them to improve formats and decide what we run next.

  • Own UpGuard's on-demand event library: repurpose sessions into clips, series and follow-up assets, grow a returning audience, and report on content performance long after the live event.

  • Own the virtual events tech stack, vendor relationships, and program budget.

  • Guide and coordinate the contractors, agencies, and colleagues who support event delivery, and set the standard for production quality across the program.

What will you bring?

  • 7+ years in B2B event or content marketing, including ownership of a global virtual event program and a recurring flagship virtual launch event at scale.

  • A track record of virtual events that drove measurable registration, attendance, and pipeline, including large sessions with multiple speakers.

  • Experience setting event strategy and making investment decisions based on results.

  • Hands-on live production experience: building run-of-show, directing multi-speaker broadcasts, managing studio, AV, and streaming setups, and recovering a live event when something goes wrong.

  • Administrator-level experience running an enterprise virtual event platform (e.g. ON24, Goldcast, or BrightTALK) integrated with HubSpot or Salesforce, including data flows and attribution.

  • Experience managing event budgets, external vendors, and production agencies.

  • Excellent project management across many concurrent events and stakeholders in multiple regions.

  • Confidence working with executives, customers, and external speakers.

  • Flexibility to run some live events in North American and European time zones.

  • Experience in video editing and content repurposing.

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience marketing to security, IT, risk, or compliance audiences, or managing direct reports.

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.title: Junior Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Junior Media Specialist (JMS) owns the visual assets required for a client website—from market and brand research to cohesive imagery and production-ready logos. The JMS ensures assets are accurate, compliant, organized, and ready for the Website Builder and Data Specialist to use without additional handoffs.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Website Image Curation

  • Research client and brokerage websites and social media profiles to identify relevant imagery and curate stock image folders aligned with LP best practices and design standards.

  • Maintain the internal image library, adding or updating labels as needed to ensure assets are properly organized and easy to find.

Logo Creation

  • Source the correct client and brokerage logos from the internal library.

  • Use the Logo Tool to efficiently create branded logo packages for website implementation including logo lockups when needed.

  • Verify brokerage compliance requirements are met.

Recurring Feedback and Reporting

  • Escalate unclear compliance requirements or complex logo reconstruction needs to the Team Leader.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Fresh graduates with a background in graphic design, fine arts, web design are strongly encouraged to apply — full training is provided.

  • Impeccable eye for design + strong knowledge of imagery best practices.

  • Meticulous attention to detail.

  • Resourcefulness and updated on imagery best practices and SOPs.

  • Understanding of main US markets and interior/exterior design styles.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a current resident of the Philippines

  • Willing to work graveyard hours, 5 days a week, 9 hours a day (with a one-hour meal break)

  • Own a laptop or desktop

  • Have a valid government ID

  • Have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired

  • Have a stable internet connection that is at least 25 mbps and have a back-up connection too

  • Live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work.   • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (Product & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role

This is UpGuard's first dedicated product security hire. You'll have significant ownership over the direction of product security at UpGuard as we scale. You won't be inheriting someone else's decisions. You'll be defining the security standards, tooling, and practices that protect UpGuard's products and infrastructure for years to come.

In this role, you'll work across our product and production environments: performing security reviews, managing vulnerabilities, and running detection and response operations in our cloud-native infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with our product engineering and platform teams to secure our products, CI/CD pipelines, and production systems, and to embed security into how we build from the ground up.

The full remit of product security is broad, so we've been deliberate about sequencing. In your first 6–12 months you'll:

  • Refresh threat modelling and security review as a standard part of how we ship.

  • Figure out where AI actually helps in AppSec (code review, triage, coverage) and build what works

  • Harden our GCP and Kubernetes baseline and get secure-by-default configs into infrastructure-as-code

The function sits at the heart of our engineering organisation, and you'll have genuine autonomy and influence: defining the security roadmap, driving best practices, and scaling our security posture as we grow.

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role.

What you'll do

  • Lead threat modelling and security reviews across UpGuard's product portfolio and cloud infrastructure, proactively surfacing attack vectors and designing mitigation strategies that scale with growth.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and AI-driven security tooling that lets product engineering teams "shift left" and embeds security across the SDLC, leveraging agentic workflows to triage, review, and scale the reach of a lean security function.

  • Design and implement secure-by-default configurations for cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure.

  • Own vulnerability management end-to-end, triaging and prioritizing by real risk, driving remediation with engineering teams, and building preventative controls across the software supply chain from development through production.

  • Build scalable detection and response systems that catch malicious activity, triage the noise, and run incidents end to end.

  • Build deep partnerships with our product engineering and platform teams, helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

You'll be building a function, not inheriting one; with real executive backing, at a company where product security is core to the business rather than a cost centre. Our engineering culture values iteration, collaboration, and speed, with a no-ego approach and pragmatic trade-offs. We're fully remote with optional offices in Sydney and Hobart, and no mandatory office attendance.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering and/or software engineering/or security operations, work in cloud environments, with a focus on the below:

  • Cloud security experience (GCP preferred, but AWS or Azure is welcome)

  • Cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and strong container security principles

  • Strong understanding of securing IAM and cloud identities

  • Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, running threat modelling exercises, and turning findings into security controls engineering teams can implement.

  • Strong knowledge of common web application vulnerabilities and how to prevent them (OWASP Top 10 and similar).

  • Hands-on experience with IAC and related tools (preferably Terraform/OpenTofu)

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience as the first security hire or founding member of a security function at a scaling company.

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks (e.g. OWASP LLM Top 10) and securing AI-powered product features.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, particularly in Go

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits from an engineering perspective.

  • Public security research, CVEs, open-source security tooling, or conference talks.

  • Offensive security skills, with the ability to validate findings through hands-on exploitation.

What's in it for you?

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

  • Stock options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager, Contracting
jobs.description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role:

Maven is looking for a Network Operations Manager who will support Maven’s network contracting function and network operations. This is an individual contributor role responsible for managing the full lifecycle of network partnerships—from identifying and vetting new partners to negotiating agreements and ensuring continued amendment management.

You will be the engine behind how Maven evaluates and contracts with network partners, bringing structure and consistency to a function that is critical to our growth. You are a natural relationship builder who is equally comfortable in a contract redline as you are in a partner call, and you know how to balance speed with rigor when building something new. Senior leadership will be available to guide unconventional negotiations, complex rate discussions, and non-standard contract structures, so you can focus on driving the work forward with confidence.

What You’ll Do:

Network Contracting

  • Manage the pipeline of prospective network partners across fertility and ancillary networks, tracking outreach, status, and next steps from initial contract through executed agreement. Maintain an executive dashboard to regularly report on network contracting status.
  • Maintain and enforce a structured framework for evaluating and qualifying new network partners, including criteria related to clinical quality, geographic coverage, capacity, and strategic fit.
  • Nurture relationships with prospective partners throughout the evaluation and contracting process, serving as a trusted point of contact and ambassador for Maven.
  • Lead the contracting process of new clinic contracts and amendments across the fertility clinic and ancillary partner networks, with additional support to global network contracting as needed.
  • Partner with clinical, operations, and finance stakeholders to ensure contract terms align with Maven’s operational and quality standards.
  • Maintain a clear audit trail of contract history, amendments, and communications for each network partner.

Network Operations

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor performance across all network verticals on an ongoing basis.
  • Develop standardized templates, evaluation rubrics, and workflows to support effective network operations with network partners.
  • Partner with network team to supply performance data and analysis that supports network quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and drives ongoing optimization.
  • Bring structure, data, and follow-through to projects that require cross-functional coordination and a bias toward action.
  • Support network product lifecycle—from requirements through implementation and post-launch monitoring—for network-facing tools and integrations.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in network development, provider contracting, partnerships, or a related function in healthcare or digital health
  • Hands-on contracting experience, including drafting, redlining, and negotiating agreements—a legal background is not required
  • Proven ability to build and manage a pipeline of partners or relationships, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proven results in rate negotiations within guardrails and meeting high volume of contracting targets
  • Experience creating or improving processes in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with external partners and align internal stakeholders

The base salary range for this role is $119,000 - $140,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities.
