jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

What You Will Own:

  • Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.

  • Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.

  • The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.

  • Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.

  • Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.

  • Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.

  • Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.

  • Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

  • High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve.

  • Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps.

  • AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint.

  • Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on.

  • Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit.

We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will:

  • Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails.

  • Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change.

  • Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

  • Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one.

  • AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments.

  • A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling.

  • Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud.

  • Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements.

  • Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders.

  • Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases.

  • Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS.

  • Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments.

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores.

  • Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting.

  • Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool.

What We Value:

We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact.

How You Will Work:

You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Expect occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings.

What We Offer:

  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:

With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Predictive Platform
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Product Lead, Predictive Platform

Are you a strategic thinker with a deep background in predictive modeling and a passion for leading teams? At 6sense, our differentiation is built on our ability to accurately predict intent and buyer behavior. We are looking for a Product Lead to own our Predictive Platform—the foundational engine that powers our entire intelligence layer and defines how the world's leading B2B brands identify their next customers.

This is a Player/Coach role. You will be the primary driver of our core predictive foundation and cross-model initiatives while simultaneously serving as the people manager and program leader for a specialized pod of Product Managers. You will oversee the roadmap for how we train, measure, and scale the models that power everything from Fit and Intent to Engagement and Triage.

Why 6sense?

  • AI That Builds Pipe, Not Hype: Our Revenue AI™ identifies accounts ready to buy, crafts the right message, and qualifies meetings automatically. We don’t just surface data—we deliver intelligence and action.
  • Crack the Dark Funnel™: Less than 3% of buyers engage early. We uncover hidden buying signals, decode the “breadcrumb trails,” and help revenue teams connect with buyers in ways they never could before.
  • Orchestrate the Full Journey: From dynamic audience creation to multi-channel engagement, we empower marketers to reach the right accounts, at the right time, with the right message—across advertising, email, web, and sales.
  • Arm Operations Teams: Integrate insights, centralize audience creation, and maximize impact by connecting 6sense with your tech stack. We’re the single canvas for your entire GTM strategy.

Your Impact

As Product Lead, Predictive Platform, you will:

  • Lead and Scale a Specialized Pod. Act as a formal people manager for a pod of Product Managers focused on specialized modeling and intelligence initiatives. You will be responsible for their growth, performance, and alignment with the broader intelligence strategy.
  • Own the Core Predictive Foundation. Personally drive the strategy for our core models. You will define the roadmap for how these models are consumed by downstream applications across the entire 6sense ecosystem.
  • Drive Cross-Model Initiatives. Establish the global standards and methodologies for ongoing model training, feedback loops, and accuracy measurement to ensure our predictions remain the industry benchmark.
  • Maximize Model Leverage. Enforce a "build once, use everywhere" philosophy, ensuring that platform engines provide maximum value to all surface apps and specialized use cases.
  • Be a Strategic Partner to Leadership. Partner directly with the Head of Intelligence Product to align the predictive roadmap with company strategy, surfacing model risks early and identifying opportunities for portfolio tradeoffs.

Strategic Themes You'll Drive

  • Customer Trust and Reliability. Drive the strategy for building high-integrity intelligence that is trusted by enterprise leaders and adapts to a wide range of global business requirements.
  • Leveraged Engine Strategy. Move toward an operating model where core predictive engines are seamlessly consumed by all App teams, reducing duplication and accelerating time-to-market.
  • Data-to-Model Integrity. Ensure the connective tissue between our data foundation and our predictive layer is robust and high performing.

What You'll Bring

  • People Leadership. Proven experience building and leading product teams. You know how to coach PMs through complex roadmaps and create a culture of high accountability.
  • Predictive Product Mastery. Deep expertise in predictive modeling, machine learning lifecycles, and data science collaboration from a product perspective. You have a track record of shipping complex ML-driven products at scale.
  • Operating Rigor. You build operating rhythms that turn messy data and model dependencies into clean execution. You focus on the methodologies that ensure long-term product performance.
  • B2B Mindset. Strong understanding of B2B data models and how predictive scoring drives GTM outcomes.
  • Experience. 8-10+ years in Product Management, with a focus on AI, ML, or Data Science products, including 3-5+ years of formal people management experience.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Impact: Your work creates the Predictive Core for the entire company, ensuring our foundational modeling engines remain the most accurate and trusted in the B2B market.
  • Innovation: You will define the Predictive Lifecycle Strategy, building the architectural leverage that allows our modeling teams to move from discovery to platform-wide deployment with high velocity.
  • Growth: Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
  • Fun: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional ABM meme.

Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. jobs.title: DRG Inpatient Coding Validator
jobs.description:
The Payment Integrity team is a group of innovative thinkers sitting at the intersection of Clover's provider Network, Claims, and Tech teams. The Payment Integrity team ensures that Clover pays claims in an accurate manner, with a particular focus on reducing inappropriate medical spend.

As an DRG Inpatient Coding Validator at Clover Health, you will play a key role ensuring that Clover is able to continue to build and scale a compliant, efficient and profitable program. You will work to ensure quality assurance standards and regulatory policy are reflected in claims processing practices. You will help drive value for every member by ensuring that Clover’s medical claims are paid accurately and recovering overpayments when they are identified. The Associate - Inpatient Coder coordinates the identification of provider DRG denials and upcoding.

As an DRG Inpatient Coding Validator, you will:

  • Partner with Clinical, Claims, and Payment Integrity peers to review claims for DRG related issues on a prospective and retrospective basis that drive inaccurate payments to providers.
  • Proactively identify overpayments to ensure accurate claims payments on inpatient services.

We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team. We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis.

The mission

You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway.

What you'll actually do

  • Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job.
  • Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute.
  • Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality.
  • Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?"
  • Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one.
  • Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall.
  • Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved.
  • A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to.
  • ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy.

This role bends in three directions

We'd rather shape it around you than the other way round.

  • Modelling & data science — features, experiments, and whether the number means anything.
  • ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting.
  • Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost.

Most people lean one way and dip into the others. This opening is centered on the first. If you'd rather own the serving path, latency and reliability, our Senior AI/ML Engineer opening (in Czechia or Slovakia) is the better fit, and applying to both is fine.

What you'll need

  • 5+ years building ML models that shipped and were used by someone other than you — in industry, not only in research or coursework.
  • Strong Python and genuinely strong SQL. You should be comfortable being handed a warehouse and finding your own way around it.
  • Solid grounding in classical ML — tree-based models, regression, classification, clustering — and the judgement to know when the simpler model is the right answer.
  • Real rigour on experiment design and evaluation. You know why a metric moved, and when it didn't move for the reason everyone assumes.
  • Comfort on a cloud data platform — we work in GCP (BigQuery) and Databricks, but the principles transfer.
  • A quantitative degree, or equivalent practical depth.
  • Working English, written and spoken.

Plus real depth in at least one of:

  • Causal inference and uplift modelling — separating who converts because of an intervention from who would have converted anyway.
  • Contextual bandits, sequential decision-making, or off-policy evaluation.
  • Ranking, recommendation or information retrieval.
  • LLM evaluation, or applied work with the GenAI stack.

Also good: you use agentic coding tools daily and have a view on where they help and where they quietly don't. We build agents for a living, and people who use them tend to have better instincts about them.

jobs.title: Growth Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is on a mission to transform hiring into a science. Our vision is to build the most intelligent recruiting platform in the world, where sourcing, screening, outreach, vetting, and hiring for the most ambitious companies on earth happen in one unified system, powered by AI that actually understands hiring. We built Arbi, the first end-to-end AI recruiting platform that connects companies with thousands of specialized recruiters and autonomous AI sourcing agents that work together to fill roles faster and more accurately. Pipeline is compounding. Customers range from startups to enterprises to the federal government. The category is being redrawn in real time, and we intend to own the pen.

About You

You are a person who craves impact. You want to leave a (big) dent on the world. You are generally disappointed in the bar held by most people every day. You feel smarter than everyone around you, yet that doesn't make you happy, it makes you sad that you aren't being pushed to think hard enough. You've sold before, and you've sold well, but you're tired of being a cog in someone else's revenue machine. You want to build the machine. You want your name attached to the deals, the content, the category.

The Role

We are hiring a Growth Account Executive to be a foundational voice of Neuroscale in the market. This is a hybrid role that fuses revenue ownership with content-driven distribution. You will close deals AND build the brand that makes those deals inbound by default.

This is not a traditional AE role. It is not a traditional growth role either. You will own deals through the full motion: converting customers through high-signal content and outbound, running deals end-to-end, and architecting the systems that future hires will run on. You will be a public face of Neuroscale on LinkedIn and across the recruiting community, the person on demos closing deals against legacy ATS and recruiting tech, and the operator who turns chaos into a repeatable engine.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. If you need a playbook handed to you, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Own

  • Sales Execution. Carry a quota and beat it. Run the full cycle: qualification, demo, pilot, close. Convert inbound from free trials, demo requests, and content-driven traffic. Run targeted outbound to in-house TA teams, recruiting agencies, and RPOs that fit our ICP. Manage fast deal cycles across multiple customer types. Out-sell legacy ATS and recruiting tech in competitive evaluations against Greenhouse, Lever, Bullhorn, and the new wave of AI sourcing point solutions.

  • Awareness and Growth Strategy. Strategize and iterate with the founders on the best ways to build awareness of Neuroscale and Arbi. Bring sharp opinions on positioning, narrative, and which channels deserve real investment. Translate strategy into shipped experiments instead of slide decks.

  • Growth Experimentation. Design and run experiments to test new products, messages, and ICPs. Build lead magnets, content, and landing pages to validate hypotheses fast. Measure what works, kill what doesn't, and double down on the winners.

  • Customer Storytelling and Distribution. Surface the amazing hires happening on our platform and turn them into stories the market actually wants to consume. Build a personal and company presence on LinkedIn that Heads of TA, recruiting leaders, and HR operators want to follow. Spread customer wins through video, partner channels, influencers, and the broader recruiting community. Cover the industry's hot debates with a strong, opinionated point of view, and make Neuroscale the default voice in the AI recruiting conversation.

If this isn't you, don't bother applying.

Some Interesting Problems You Will Work On

  • Define how the AI recruiting category gets sold, in a market that didn't exist 24 months ago

  • Build a content engine that makes Neuroscale the most-followed voice in modern recruiting

  • Crack the GTM motion for a hybrid product that serves in-house TA, agencies, and RPOs simultaneously

  • Design the activation and conversion loops for a PLG motion in a space that has historically been sales-led

  • Help build the playbook that the next ten AEs run on

Compensation and Benefits

  1. $350K OTE (base + variable + bonus). Real compensation for people who do real work.

  2. Uncapped commission with aggressive accelerators. You get extra-rewarded as we grow.

  3. Health, Vision, and Dental. 50% reimbursed. We take care of the people who take care of the company.

  4. Generous PTO. We measure output, not hours. Take the trip.

  5. Remote or in-person. We have two modern campuses in Reston and Sterling, Virginia. Northern Virginia is what happens when defense money meets startup ambition. It's the SF of the east coast and we've planted our flag here.

  6. Generous relocation assistance if applicable, available after 90 days of employment.

  7. Direct access to the best. You will work alongside founders, operators, and advisors who have built and scaled real things. The learning curve here is not a perk line item but it might be the most valuable thing on this list.

The Team

  1. We are not a recruiting agency or consulting firm. We are not a "process first" company. We don't have a lot of BS meetings and we don't have a lot of managers. What we do have is a small, hungry, unreasonably talented group of people who move fast, think hard, and genuinely care about building something that matters.

  2. You will not be handed a lead list and a script. You will not be "onboarded" for three weeks. You will be thrown into the fire on day one, working directly with the founding team on positioning, pricing, narrative, and the deals that shape what Neuroscale becomes. You will be the primary commercial voice in customer conversations, one of the public faces on LinkedIn, and the person who makes sure our story actually lands.

  3. We move with urgency. And we hold ourselves to a standard that most people would find uncomfortable. This is not a job. It's a chance to do some of the most important work of your career, earlier than you thought possible, with people who will push you harder than anyone has before.

If that sounds like home, you already know what to do.

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life, including but not limited to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability status.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Analytics
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

The Manager, Business Analytics is a highly technical individual contributor within the Sales Operations & Business Analytics (SOBA) Center of Excellence. You will serve as a strategic analytics partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and other business functions, leveraging advanced analytics, statistical modeling, data science, and automation to improve operational performance, revenue realization, and business decision-making. The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen, translating complex data into actionable insights that influence leadership decisions and drive measurable business outcomes. Working at the intersection of analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, and operational strategy, this individual partners closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to build scalable analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the analytics lead supporting Commercial, Finance, Operations, and related organizational functions.
  • Act as a thought partner to operational and commercial leadership, helping prioritize analytical investments, define success metrics, and measure business outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure analytical solutions are aligned with strategic priorities and deliver measurable value to the business.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Perform statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, hypothesis testing, predictive modeling, and exploratory data analysis to support business planning and operational decision-making.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Master Data Management teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, optimize data pipelines, and enhance enterprise data architecture.
  • Build and maintain semantic data models, reusable datasets, KPI frameworks, and standardized metrics aligned with SOBA governance standards.
  • Support enterprise data governance initiatives by validating source system integrity, documenting metric definitions, monitoring data quality, and promoting reporting consistency.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics techniques where appropriate to improve forecasting accuracy, automate decision support, and uncover new business insights.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 6-8+ years of experience in advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science, revenue analytics, or a similar technical analytical role.
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), query optimization, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong Python programming experience, including the use of libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, StatsModels, Scikit-Learn, and data visualization frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data governance, and data quality management practices, including cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence platforms, including dashboard development and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex datasets and communicate findings through compelling narratives, insights, and recommendations.
  • Ability to independently manage ambiguous problems and deliver high-impact solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within diagnostics, laboratory services, healthcare technology, life sciences, or payer analytics environments.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, generative AI applications, workflow automation platforms, and emerging analytics technologies.
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders to influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights.

#LI-Remote

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$130,000—$145,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Veracyte participates in E-Verify in the United States. View our CCPA Disclosure Notice

If you receive any suspicious alerts or communications through LinkedIn or other online job sites for any position at Veracyte, please exercise caution and promptly report any concerns to careers@veracyte.com

jobs.title: Founding Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is on a mission to fill the world’s most important roles.

Recruiting is a zero-sum game. The best people get hired once, and the teams that move fastest win. We build Arbi, an AI recruiting platform that combines autonomous agents with elite recruiters so world-class companies and federal agencies can hire well and grow fast.

Arbi searches 800M+ profiles, runs outreach, and interviews candidates at scale. Through every search, placement, and interaction on our platform, we capture proprietary hiring data that no one else has at scale, and that data powers the agentic systems we are building to make hiring faster, smarter, and more precise.

We believe AI will create more jobs, not less. As companies move faster with fewer constraints, they will hire more ambitiously and for roles that did not exist before, making the hiring layer more critical than ever.

We hold a USAF SBIR Direct-to-Phase-II contract, sell into federal through Carahsoft, and work with enterprise, federal, and regulated organizations that most AI startups cannot touch. Our second product, Athena, extends the same agent infrastructure into federal agency workflows.

We are a small, founder-led team and this is one of the first engineering seats.

About the Role

You will work directly with the founders on the hardest technical questions in the product:

  • How do we understand the nuance in a hiring requirement well enough to find the person a filter & criteria search never would?

  • How do we interview candidates at scale and turn those conversations into a data edge no public profile can give you?

  • How do agents decide who to reach out to, what to say, and when to hand off to a human?

  • How do we make a recruiter say “wow” in the first five minutes?

You will design, build, and ship features end to end, most of them built on LLMs. Recent work includes agent execution infrastructure, feedback loops that improve search quality from recruiter behavior, and multi-tenant deployment for regulated customers.

Our stack: Next.js + React, Node.js, Python FastAPI, OpenSearch (Elasticsearch), Temporal, and a range of inference providers and models.

About You

  • You have built something from scratch. A startup, a product, a system people depend on.

  • You ship. We care more about what you have built than where you have worked.

  • You are high agency. You find the highest-leverage problem, decide it is yours, and attack it.

  • You have shown excellence somewhere: work, school, open source, a side project that took off.

  • You take asymmetric bets. Joining a founding team is one of them.

  • You have real experience with the core of our stack: Next.js, Node.js, AWS, and search or data infrastructure.

  • Experience with LLM products, voice or conversational AI, or search at scale is a plus, not a filter.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Northern Virginia. We build in person.

Why Founding

  • Direct ownership of core systems from day one. Your decisions become the architecture.

  • Meaningful founding equity. You should share in what you build.

  • Work on problems with real stakes: federal hiring, regulated industries, roles that matter.

  • A front-row seat to going from early traction to category leader.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitve salary plus meaningful founding equity.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Meals provided in office.

  • Relocation support for the right candidate.

Neuroscale AI is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Expansion Account Executive, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're currently looking for an experienced Expansion Account Executive, Mid-Market to join our dynamic sales team. You would play a crucial role in driving sales growth by effectively engaging and managing relationships with customers in the mid-market segment. You will bring your expertise in navigating larger deals and have a proven track record of success in expanding client accounts.

This is a key role within the organization, as MaintainX has seen (and will continue to see) triple-digit, year-over-year growth; thus, creating a need for world-class client care and management.

The ideal Expansion Account Executive, Mid-Market will be fanatical about customer success and growth. This is an exciting opportunity for someone wishing to be a part of both client retention and expansion. This is a difference-making, meaningful, high-responsibility role, and we expect the right candidate to be someone who thinks outside the box, thrives under pressure, and is laser-focused on the client.

What you’ll do:

You would use your B2B sales or account management experience to effectively engage and build relationships with mid-market customers. Know your clients like family and take care of them as such.

  • Document - Exhibit meticulous attention to detail and organizational skills, ensuring accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, deals, and progress.

  • Startup Mentality – You will embrace the entrepreneurial, grind-it-out mentality of building something new.

About you:

  • A minimum of 4 years of sales experience, with a significant portion in account management or a similar role within the mid-market segment.

  • Demonstrated success in expanding client accounts and driving revenue growth in a B2B sales environment.

  • Proficiency in navigating larger deals, understanding complex sales cycles, and managing multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate data-driven insights to both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to conduct engaging product demonstrations and lead impactful quarterly business reviews.

  • Adaptability and comfort in a fast-paced, rapidly changing sales environment.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all documentation and deal management.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal teams.

  • A positive, passionate, and creative mindset, combined with high-character qualities that align with our company values.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in a relevant field.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience with modern sales tech stacks: Salesforce, Salesloft, DiscoverOrg, etc.

  • Experience with startups and entrepreneurial organizations.

  • Experience working in CMMS or facility operations software.

  • Documented success in working in a remote setting.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: IP Counsel
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

Veracyte is seeking an IP Counsel to drive IP risk management, with a focus on freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses, and support technical transactions with significant IP components. This role partners across the business to translate complex IP considerations into practical guidance that supports innovation and strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • IP Risk Identification and Mitigation
    • Drive freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses to identify and mitigate IP risks throughout Veracyte products lifecycle and for strategic business initiatives.
    • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice balancing legal risks with organizational objectives, including design-around opportunities, licensing strategies, and other risk mitigation approaches.
    • Contribute to the implementation of processes for proactive IP risk identification and mitigation.
    • Partner to manage pre-litigation issues, intellectual property disputes, oppositions, and other litigation matters.
  • Technology Transactions Support
    • Facilitate review, negotiations, and drafting of research collaboration, material transfer, technology evaluation, data use, licensing, and other agreements with substantial IP components.
    • Provide IP support for strategic collaborations, partnerships, and business development transactions.
    • Advise on IP ownership, licensing, data rights, publication rights, and other issues in research and development agreements.
  • Growth of Veracyte IP Program
    • Collaborate with other legal team members on development and continued enhancement of the company's IP program—including support for patent prosecution.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
    • Develop and deliver IP education and training programs to increase IP awareness across the organization.
    • Manage outside IP counsel and related legal budgets.

Who You Are:

You’re a strategic thinker business-oriented thinker with a collaborative mindset and infinite curiosity. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are energized by complex challenges and meaningful work.

Required

  • J.D. or equivalent law degree with active bar membership.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantive work in life sciences IP (diagnostics, biotechnology, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, genomics, or related life sciences fields).
  • Demonstrated experience conducting and advising on freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses—and ability to assess complex legal risks and develop practical, solution-oriented business recommendations.
  • Experience and interest in growing skills in transactional practice involving complex agreements with IP components. Interest in patent prosecution support is welcomed.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Scientific degree (including advanced degree) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience managing matters for diagnostics, molecular biology, genomics, or related industries.
  • Law firm training in FTO analysis, opinion work, and patent or technology transactions practice.
  • Patent bar membership.
  • Experience managing outside counsel.

#LI-Remote

For candidates based in our San Diego office, the range is $221,000 - $252,500.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SOCi is the leader in AI-powered marketing solutions for multi-location businesses. With its proprietary Genius AI™ and suite of Genius Agents™, SOCi provides a first-of-its-kind, AI-powered digital workforce capable of handling the workload of 1,000 local marketers™, empowering brands to achieve unmatched digital visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and scale faster than ever before.

SOCi is recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies, and is trusted by nearly 1,000 top brands—including Ford, Ace Hardware, Kumon, Liberty Tax, and more—to automate and optimize local marketing tasks across all locations. Founded in 2012 and backed by leading strategic investors, SOCi is transforming how multi-location brands manage and scale their marketing efforts. You can view our Awards and Accolades here!

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-oriented Revenue Operations Analyst to support our Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing organizations. This role will serve as a key operational partner across the customer lifecycle, helping teams operate efficiently through strong queue management, Salesforce administration and reporting, Customer Success operations, and cross-functional process management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across multiple teams, can translate business needs into operational solutions, and has advanced Salesforce reporting skills. This person should be equally comfortable investigating an operational issue, building an executive-ready dashboard, coordinating a cancellation across multiple departments, and identifying opportunities to improve the underlying process.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Operations Queue Management

  • Own the day-to-day management of the Revenue Operations request queue.
  • Review and triage incoming cases, determine priority and appropriate ownership, and route requests to the correct Revenue Operations team member or functional owner.
  • Manage assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely communication and appropriate follow-up with stakeholders.
  • Monitor queue health, aging, volume, and resolution times to ensure requests are addressed within established service-level expectations.
  • Identify recurring requests and issues that may indicate opportunities for process improvement, automation, documentation, or enablement.
  • Maintain clear documentation of case resolutions and operational changes.

Customer Success Operations

  • Serve as a primary Revenue Operations point of contact and operational partner for the Customer Success organization.
  • Partner with Customer Success leaders and team members to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable processes, reporting, and system improvements.
  • Support changes and enhancements to Salesforce and other Revenue Operations tools used by Customer Success.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success Enablement to ensure alignment and understanding of processes, tools, documentation, and enablement assets impacted by operational changes.
  • Help document and standardize Customer Success operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Support testing and quality assurance for system, workflow, and process changes before deployment.

Cancellation & Offboarding Operations

  • Manage and oversee the end-to-end customer cancellation process.
  • Coordinate across Customer Success, Implementation/Offboarding, Billing, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure cancellations are processed accurately and on time.
  • Perform quality assurance throughout the cancellation process to ensure required information is complete, systems are updated appropriately, and downstream teams receive the information they need.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies or process gaps that could impact customer offboarding, billing, reporting, or revenue data.
  • Maintain documentation and controls to ensure a consistent and auditable cancellation process.
  • Analyze cancellation trends and surface insights or recurring operational issues to Revenue Operations and Customer Success leadership.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into accurate, actionable reporting.
  • Provide Clari and CAP reporting to Customer Success leadership as needed.
  • Build recurring and ad hoc reporting to support leadership decision-making and operational reviews.
  • Perform quality assurance and validation of reporting to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Investigate discrepancies across Salesforce and other revenue systems and partner with appropriate teams to resolve data issues.
  • Help establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key revenue and customer metrics.

Salesforce & Data Management

  • Serve as a Salesforce reporting subject matter expert within Revenue Operations.
  • Build and maintain advanced Salesforce reports, dashboards, report types, filters, formulas, and related reporting solutions.
  • Support data quality initiatives by identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate CRM data.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and system administrators to recommend improvements to Salesforce fields, workflows, processes, and reporting structures.
  • Assist with user acceptance testing and quality assurance for Salesforce enhancements.
  • Help maintain documentation related to Salesforce processes, reporting definitions, and operational workflows.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, requirements, and standard operating procedures.
  • Partner cross-functionally to implement process improvements and measure their effectiveness.
  • Look for opportunities to reduce repetitive requests through automation, self-service reporting, documentation, and enablement.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail while balancing multiple requests, projects, and priorities.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical/operational role.
  • Strong Salesforce experience with an advanced understanding of reports and dashboards.
  • Experience working with CRM data and translating business requirements into reporting or operational solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong project and process management skills with the ability to manage work from intake through completion.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable identifying problems, recommending solutions, and taking ownership through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is building the AI recruiting operating system, one unified platform for your entire talent organization, from first touch to hired. Arbi eliminates fragmented workflows, integrates directly with your ATS, and orchestrates AI agents for sourcing, outreach, screening, and candidate intelligence end-to-end. By combining reasoning-optimized models with deep workflow automation, Arbi helps talent teams win more top candidates with dramatically less friction.

We’re backed by top operators and investors, and we’re growing fast. Our momentum is further fueled by blue-chip partners and programs, including the NVIDIA Inception Program, the HPE Unleash AI Program, and our active DoD SBIR Phase II award and contract.

We are now hiring a Technical Customer Success Manager to own demos, onboarding, and early customer success, and to play a direct role in closing and expanding ARBI deals.

The Role

We are hiring a Technical Customer Success Manager for a highly customer facing, hands on role with one clear objective: help close deals and ensure customers succeed immediately after signature.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. You will partner tightly with Sales to run demos, lead technical validation, and remove implementation friction, then stay involved through onboarding, adoption, and early customer success.

You will own how customers experience Arbi, Athena, and Aurora from first demo through value realization. This role is ideal for someone who blends solutions consulting, technical fluency, and strong storytelling, and who thrives on accountability for customer outcomes.

What You'll Do & Own

  • Own Arbi, Athena, and Aurora demos end to end, including discovery, tailored demo, objections, and next steps

  • Partner with Sales to align demo strategy to buyer pain points, technical requirements, and success criteria

  • Run demos independently for multiple buyer personas including recruiting, operations, leadership, and IT

  • Drive technical confidence during sales cycles and help advance deals toward signature

  • Lead technical validation during trials and POCs by defining success criteria, managing timelines, and removing blockers quickly

  • Troubleshoot issues and guide prospects through real world workflows

  • Support and validate common ATS integration patterns and deployment configurations

  • Own or co own customer onboarding to ensure a smooth handoff from Sales and fast time to value

  • Lead training sessions, onboarding calls, office hours, and enablement initiatives

  • Create and maintain enablement materials, best practices, and usage guidance

  • Monitor usage and adoption to identify risks and expansion opportunities early

  • Support integrations with ATS platforms and related HR systems

  • Work hands on with APIs, webhooks, SSO or SAML, SCIM, data mappings, and CSV based workflows

  • Troubleshoot customer issues and coordinate with Engineering when deeper fixes are required

  • Act as the customer voice internally by gathering concerns, complaints, and feature gaps from customer interactions

  • Synthesize feedback into clear, actionable inputs for Product and Engineering

  • Build a tight feedback loop from customer calls to prioritized product and process improvements

  • Track and report on customer health signals including usage, satisfaction, risks, renewals, and expansion indicators

  • Help define and evolve customer success metrics as the company scales

What Success Looks Like

  • You run demos independently and reliably across multiple buyer personas

  • Implementations and ATS integrations are completed with minimal friction

  • Customers achieve fast time to value and demonstrate strong early adoption

  • Clear customer feedback themes flow consistently into Product and Engineering

  • Sales cycles move faster due to strong technical confidence and execution

Who You Are

  • 3-8+ years in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Technical Customer Success, Implementation or Onboarding, or a similar customer facing role in B2B SaaS

  • Proven experience driving pre sales technical workflows such as demos, trials, and POCs and directly influencing deal progression

  • Strong implementation mindset with the ability to configure, troubleshoot, and support a product in real customer environments

  • Experience integrating SaaS tools using APIs, webhooks, SSO or SAML, SCIM, data mappings, CSV imports or exports, or similar patterns

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with executive presence and strong storytelling ability

  • Thrive in a high-ownership, fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities

Bonus Points

  • Experience with ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, or BambooHR

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, security reviews, and implementation constraints

  • Prior exposure to AI enabled products, automation platforms, or data heavy workflows

What’s in It for You

  • Be a foundational hire shaping how customers experience Neuroscale from day one

  • Work directly with Sales, Product, and Engineering to influence roadmap and growth

  • Zero bureaucracy, high trust, and a strong culture of ownership and execution

  • Base Salary: $100K–$150K

  • Performance bonus: Quarterly bonuses tied to clear milestones (demos, onboarding, etc)

  • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 14-days of PTO accrued annually

  • Learning: At least $2,000 per year for courses, events, books, and growth communities

  • Tools and setup: New macbook, monitor, and a monthly tools budget to run the stack you want

  • Workspace: Monthly co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexibility: Remote-first, flexible hours, and work-from-anywhere (digital nomad)

  • Growth path: Clear, fast-track path to a Head of Customer Success as we scale the team

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life — including but not limited to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability status.
